  • Stringers will be paid Rs. 1,500/- per local coverage of duration less than 6 hours, inclusive of transportation and delivery charges.

  • The final panel of Stringers will be drawn by the Committee based on assessment scale, interview and quality of test coverages, and names of selected Stringers will be published and informed in writing.

Eligibility Criteria

  • For Lower Division Clerk (LDC) - Post Code 2/26:
    • Class XII pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution
    • Typing Speed test of 35 words per minute on computer (35 words per minute corresponds to 10500 Key Depression per hour - KDPH on an average of 5 Key Depression for each word)
  • For Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) - Post Code 3/26:
    • Class XII pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution
    • Typing Speed test of 35 words per minute on computer (35 words per minute corresponds to 10500 Key Depression per hour - KDPH on an average of 5 Key Depression for each word)
  • For Driver - Post Code 4/26:
    • Class X/ITI or equivalent pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution
  • Minimum Qualifying Service for LDC & JSA:
    • Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) of the concerned Department with 8 (Eight) years of regular service in the grade, and possessing Class-XII pass certificate from a recognized Board/Institution, OR
    • Skilled Contingency Staff with minimum of 12 (Twelve) years of continuous service as skilled contingency in the concerned Department/office and possess educational qualification of Class-XII pass certificate from a recognized Board/Institution
  • Minimum Qualifying Service for Driver:
    • Contingency skilled driver who possess Class X/ITI or equivalent pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution with 10 (Ten) years of service in the concerned Department/Office, OR
    • Handyman who possess Class X/ITI or equivalent pass Certificate from a recognized Board/Institution with 6 (Six) years of regular service in the concerned Department/Office
  • General Eligibility:
    • The candidate must be a citizen of India
    • The educational qualification, required length of service, age, category as stipulated shall be determined as on the closing date of submission of application i.e. 25-02-2026
    • The name of the candidate should be in the certified list of eligible candidates submitted by the HoD/HoO
    • Only those candidates who have been certified as eligible by their Head of Department are eligible to apply

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Matrix Level: Level-4
  • Salary Range: Rs. 25,500 - Rs. 81,100 Per Month
  • This pay scale is applicable for all three posts: Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA), and Driver

  • For Driver (Post Code 4/26):
    • Not applicable (eligibility determined by the Departments)

Application Fee

Category Fee Amount
APST Candidates Rs. 150
General Candidates Rs. 200
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) Nil (Exempt)
  • Payment Mode: Online only
  • The application fee is non-refundable

Important Dates

Event Date
Opening Date of Application 12/02/2026 (Thursday)
Closing Date of Application 25/02/2026 (03:00 PM) (Wednesday)
Tentative Date of Written Examination 29/03/2026 (Sunday)

Selection Process

  • For LDC (Post Code 2/26) & JSA (Post Code 3/26):
    • Stage-I (Written Examination): Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions - 200 Marks, Duration: 2 Hours
      • General Awareness: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
      • General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
      • Arithmetical & Numerical Ability: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
      • Test of English Language and Comprehension: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
    • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 33% aggregate marks in the written examination paper
    • Stage-II (Skill Test): Typing Speed Test of 35 words per minute on computer (10500 KDPH). The Typing Test is of qualifying nature only and marks will not be counted for final merit
  • For Driver (Post Code 4/26):
    • Stage-I (Written Examination): Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions - 200 Marks, Duration: 2 Hours
      • General Awareness: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • Arithmetical & Numerical Ability: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • Test of English Language and Comprehension: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • Technical Paper: 100 marks (50 questions of 2 marks each)
    • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 33% aggregate in both the papers separately i.e., for Common Paper and Technical Paper
    • Stage-II (Driving Test): Qualifying nature only. Candidate shall produce a valid Driving License for appearing in the Driving Test
  • Shortlisting for Stage-2: The total number of candidates shortlisted for Stage 2 will be in 1:3 ratio (if total vacancies are 10, then 30 candidates will be shortlisted)
  • Final Merit List: Will be prepared on the basis of marks secured in written examination only. Marks in Skill Test/Driving Test will not be counted but candidates must qualify
  • Note: There is no negative marking in the examination

General Information/Instructions

  • Application Mode: Only online applications will be accepted. Applications received through any other mode shall be summarily rejected
  • Login Credentials: Login credentials will be sent to eligible candidates through e-mail & SMS to their respective e-mail addresses and mobile numbers furnished by their Departments/Offices
  • Eligibility Determination: APSSB will not entertain any representations from candidates with regards to eligibility and the same shall be determined solely by the concerned Head of Department/Office
  • Provisional Candidature: Candidature of applicants shall be purely PROVISIONAL at all stages of the recruitment process
  • Examination Centre: The Centre for the examination will be ITANAGAR
  • ID Proof Requirement: Candidate will have to provide a valid Aadhar Card/Government authorized Photo Identity Card. They will have to carry the same ID card in original along with the admit card to the Examination Centre
  • Prohibited Items: Use of Calculator, Laptop, Palmtop, other digital instrument/Mobile/Cell Phone/Pager/Electronic watches etc. is not allowed. Candidates found in possession of any such gadget will be debarred from examination
  • Admit Card: Individual Admit cards will not be sent to candidates and have to be downloaded from the website www.apssb.nic.in
  • Vacancy Status: The vacancies published are provisional and subject to change. In case the vacancy position is reduced or withdrawn by the user department, the Board shall not be liable to compensate the applicant
  • No Re-evaluation: There is no provision of re-evaluation/re-checking of Answer sheet/Answer scripts
  • Board's Rights: The Board reserves the right to reject candidature at any stage, cancel part or entire examination process, change examination scheme, conduct medical test for PwBD candidates, and make any amendments as deemed necessary
  • Scribe Facility for PwBD: Facility of scribe will be provided to eligible PwBD/PwD candidates as per Government guidelines. Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination will be provided to persons allowed use of scribe
  • Multiple Applications: In case an applicant applies multiple forms for the same post, only the latest application form shall be considered by APSSB
  • Malpractice Action: Candidates found involved in violating guidelines, impersonation, using unfair means, submitting fabricated documents etc. will face strict action including police action, FIR lodging and debarment from all future APSSB examinations
  • Final Selection: The Board makes provisional selection and recommends to the Indenting/User Department. The Appointing Authority verifies and satisfies about authenticity of documents before finally appointing the candidate

How to Apply

  • Eligible departmental candidates are required to apply online only through the website www.apssb.nic.in using their unique login credentials/passwords
  • Login credentials will be sent to eligible candidates' respective mobile numbers & e-mail IDs by their departments
  • Application period: 12-02-2026 to 25-02-2026 (03:00 PM)
  • Only those candidates who have been certified as eligible by their Head of Department are eligible to apply
  • Documents to be scanned and uploaded at time of online application:
    • Scanned signature of the candidate on white paper with black ink pen (10-50 kb in jpg/jpeg/png format)
    • Latest/recent passport size photo (50-100 kb in jpg/jpeg/png format)
  • Documents to be submitted during Document Verification:
    • Recent passport size Photograph (2 copies)
    • Matriculation certificates/II issued by the Board/Institute for proof of date of birth
    • Class XII pass certificate & marksheet issued from a recognized Board/University
    • APST Certificate (if applicable)
    • Valid Driving License (for Driver post)
    • Print out of Admit Card
    • Any other documents as may be relevant
  • Shortlisted candidates will have to produce above-mentioned Certificates/Documents in original during Document Verification failing which candidature will be summarily rejected
  • The applicants are advised to fill up the application form carefully. They will not be allowed to edit/modify the details after the closing date
  • Application with incomplete or invalid details will be summarily rejected
  • Candidates are advised to keep track of the Board website www.apssb.nic.in for any latest information related to the examination

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Academic Qualifications: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised University or any equivalent qualification recognised as such by the Central Government including Integrated Dual Degree (IDD). Candidates possessing qualifications such as Medical, Engineering, Chartered Accountant, Cost Accountant would also be eligible.
  • Experience: Minimum 2 years' experience as on 31.12.2025 as an officer in any Scheduled Commercial Bank or any Regional Rural Bank as listed in Second Schedule of Reserve Bank of India.
  • Salary Requirement: Candidates having experience in Scheduled Commercial Banks other than Public Sector Banks/Regional Rural Banks shall be drawing minimum annual gross salary of Rs. 9.50 lacs for each year and shall provide documentary evidence for their annual gross salary such as Form-16/Annual Income Statement (AIS)/pay slips for last 24 months or certificate from employer.
  • Local Language: Candidates applying for vacancies of a particular Circle should be proficient (reading, writing and understanding) in any one of the specified opted local language of that Circle.
  • Exclusions: Candidates working with subsidiaries of Scheduled Commercial Banks, candidates working in SBI in clerical/supervisory cadre, employees engaged on contract basis, and candidates who have resigned from officer grade in SBI/Associate Banks will not be eligible to apply.
  • CIBIL Status: Candidates who have defaulted in repayment under any lending arrangement with Banks or NBFCs including credit card dues and have not regularised/repaid their outstanding are not eligible for appointment.
  • Character & Antecedents: Candidates against whom there is/are adverse report regarding character & antecedents, moral turpitude are not eligible to apply for the post.

Salary/Stipend

  • Starting basic pay is Rs. 48,480/- in the scale of 48480-2000/7-62480-2340/2-67160-2680/7-85920 applicable to Junior Management Grade Scale-I plus 2 advance increments.
  • The official will also be eligible for D.A, H.R.A/Lease rental, C.C.A, PF, Contributory Pension Fund i.e., NPS, LFC, Medical Facility etc. and other allowances & perquisites as per rules in force from time to time.

Age Limit (as on 31.12.2025)

  • Minimum Age: 21 years (candidates must have been born not later than 31.12.2004)
  • Maximum Age: 30 years (candidates must have been born not earlier than 01.01.1996)
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 Years
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (SC/ST): 15 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (OBC): 13 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (Gen/EWS): 10 Years
  • Age Relaxation for Eligible Ex-Servicemen: 5 Years
  • Note: Cumulative age relaxation will not be available either under the above items or in combination with any other items.

Application Fee

Category Fee Amount
General/EWS/OBC Rs. 750/-
SC/ST/PwBD Nil
  • Fee/charges once paid will NOT be refunded on any account nor can it be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.
  • Payment can be made using debit card/credit card/Internet Banking by providing information as asked on the screen.
  • Transaction charges for online payment, if any, will be borne by the candidates.

Important Dates

Event Date
Online Registration of Application & Payment of Fees Start Date 29/01/2026
Online Registration of Application & Payment of Fees Last Date 18/02/2026
Extended Online Registration of Application 25/02/2026
Download of Call Letter for Online Test March 2026 (Tentative)
Online Test March 2026 (Tentative)

Selection Process

  • Phase 1 - Online Examination: Online test will consist of Objective Tests for 120 marks and Descriptive Test for 50 marks. The duration of objective test is 2 hours consisting of 4 Sections - English Language (30 marks, 30 minutes), Banking Knowledge (40 marks, 40 minutes), General Awareness/Economy (30 marks, 30 minutes), and Computer Aptitude (20 marks, 20 minutes). The Descriptive Test (30 minutes) will be a Test of English Language (Letter Writing & Essay) for total 50 marks.
  • Phase 2 - Screening: The Screening Committee will examine whether candidates fulfil the required eligibility criteria of experience and match the job profile submitted by candidates with the job profile of Scale-I Generalist Officer of State Bank of India. Candidates numbering up to 3 times (approx.) of the Circle wise and Category wise vacancies will be called for interview from the top of the merit list.
  • Phase 3 - Interview: Interview will consist of 50 marks. Candidates will have to score minimum qualifying marks in interview to be considered for final selection.
  • Phase 4 - Local Language Proficiency Test: Test of knowledge of specified opted local language will be conducted for provisionally selected candidates before joining the Bank. Candidates who produce 10th or 12th standard mark sheet/certificate evidencing having studied the specified opted local language will not be required to undergo the language test.
  • Final Selection: Final merit list is prepared based on normalization of marks scored in Online Test and Interview with 75:25 weightage respectively. Marks secured by candidates in Online Test (out of 170 marks) are converted to out of 75 marks and Interview scores (out of 50 marks) are converted to out of 25 marks.
  • Note: There will be no penalty for wrong answers marked in Objective Tests. Sectional marks will not be maintained for Online Examination.

General Information/Instructions

  • The candidate will have to apply for vacancy of one Circle only. A candidate applying against vacancy of one Circle will not be eligible to apply against vacancy of any other Circle.
  • Candidature of the applicant will be considered only against the vacancies in the Circle for which he/she has applied/opted. Merit list will be drawn Circle wise and category wise.
  • Selected candidates will be posted in the Circle against whose vacancy they are selected.
  • The selected candidates will not be entitled for Inter-Circle transfer/Corporate Centre Posting/Corporate Centre Establishment Posting/Foreign Posting up to his/her promotion to SMGS-IV Grade OR 12 years of service, whichever is later.
  • On joining, the selected candidates will be designated as "Circle Based Officers" (CBOs) and will be on probation for a period of 6 months from their joining the Bank.
  • The CBOs will be subjected to continuous assessment during probation period for judging their suitability for confirmation.
  • Reservation for Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) candidates is horizontal and will be guided by various guidelines of Government of India. Only those persons with benchmark disabilities (not less than 40% of a specified disability) would be eligible for reservation.
  • OBC category candidates should submit the OBC certificate on format prescribed by Govt. of India, having "Non-Creamy Layer (NCL)" clause issued during period 01.04.2025 to the date of interview.
  • EWS candidates are required to produce 'Income & Asset Certificate' issued based on gross annual income for the Financial Year 2024-25 and valid for the year 2025-26 at the time of interview.
  • Candidates serving in Government/Quasi Government, Public Sector Undertakings including Nationalised Banks/RRBs are required to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from their employer at the time of interview.
  • Bank will arrange pre-examination training (PET) in online mode for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates in consonance with the guidelines issued by Government of India.
  • Outstation candidates called for interview will be reimbursed Railway AC-III fare for the shortest route in India or actual expenses incurred (whichever is lower) from place of residence/posting to Interview venue.
  • Bank reserves right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement can be instituted only in Mumbai and Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • State Bank of India does not endorse, authorize or associate with any external coaching platform, consultancy, individual or digital channel claiming to provide guaranteed selection, influence in recruitment or insider guidance.

How to Apply

  • Candidates can apply online only from 29.01.2026 to 25.02.2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Candidates should have valid email ID and mobile no. which should be kept active till the declaration of final results.
  • Visit Bank's website https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings and open the Online Application Form available under 'Current Openings'.
  • Fill the application carefully. Once the application is filled completely, candidates should submit the data.
  • After ensuring the correctness of the particulars of the application form, candidate should pay fees through the payment gateway integrated with the application.
  • The payment can be made by using debit card/credit card/Internet Banking by providing information as asked on the screen.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, e-receipt and application form will be generated, which may be printed for record.
  • Before applying online, candidates will be required to have a scanned (digital) image of their photograph, signature, left thumb impression, handwritten declaration, and all relevant documents (ID Proof, Date of Birth Proof, Job Profile, Resume, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificate, Form-16, Salary Slip) as per specifications.
  • Candidates should download their call letter (for Online Exam & Interview) by entering their registration number and password/date of birth from the Bank's website. No hard copy of the call letter will be sent by post.
  • Candidates who are called for online exam/interview will be required to bring one photo identity proof such as Passport/Aadhaar/PAN Card/Driving License/Voter's Id Card/Bank Passbook with duly attested Photograph in original as well as a self-attested photocopy thereof.
  • Not more than one application should be submitted by a candidate. In case of multiple applications, only the last valid (completed) application will be retained.
  • Helpdesk: In case of any problem, queries may be made at telephone no. 022-22820427 (between 11:00 AM to 05:00 PM on working days) or lodge their query on http://cgrs.ibps.in. Candidates should mention 'RECRUITMENT OF CIRCLE BASED OFFICERS IN STATE BANK OF INDIA-2026' in the subject.

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

About the Research Project

The research project focuses on "Quantum Dots integrated titania with plenty of heterojunctions and its utility for green hydrogen production: Beyond Proof of Concept". This cutting-edge project aims to develop advanced nanomaterials and photocatalytic systems for sustainable hydrogen production, which is crucial for clean energy solutions. The selected JRF will be involved in synthesis, characterization, and testing of quantum dots and titania-based heterojunctions for photocatalytic applications.

Job Description

  • Synthesis of Quantum Dots and Titania nanomaterials
  • Development of metal oxide heterojunctions
  • Fabrication of photocatalytic reactors
  • Testing and evaluation for green hydrogen generation
  • Literature review and data analysis
  • Technical report writing and publication support
  • Laboratory maintenance and safety compliance

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational Qualification: Any one of the following:
    • B.S. (4-year programme) with 55% marks minimum
    • B. Pharmacy (B. Pharm) with 55% marks minimum
    • MBBS with 55% marks minimum
    • Integrated BS-MS programme with 55% marks minimum
    • M.Sc. with 55% marks minimum
    • Bachelor of Engineering (BE) with 55% marks minimum
    • B.Tech. or equivalent degree with 55% marks minimum
  • Competitive Examinations: Must have passed either NET (National Eligibility Test) OR GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering)
  • Percentage Criteria: Minimum 55% marks in the qualifying examination (45% for SC/ST/PwD candidates)

Desirable Qualifications

  • M.Sc. Physics with specialization in relevant field
  • Experience in Nanomaterials Synthesis and Characterization
  • Knowledge of photocatalytic techniques
  • Laboratory experience in material science
  • Published research papers or conference presentations

Age Limit

  • Maximum Age Limit: 28 years as on the date of application (05-03-2026)
  • Age Relaxation: Upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for candidates belonging to:
    • SC (Scheduled Caste)
    • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
    • OBC (Other Backward Class)
    • WOMEN candidates
    • PwD (Person with Disability) candidates
  • Calculation: Age will be calculated as on 05-03-2026 (Application deadline date)

Fellowship & Remuneration

  • Monthly Fellowship: ₹37,000/month
  • Nature of Remuneration: Fixed monthly fellowship on contractual basis
  • Duration: 3 years (subject to satisfactory performance)
  • Basis: CSIR norms for JRF fellowship

How to Apply

  1. Download the prescribed application form from the official notification PDF or NIT Silchar website
  2. Fill the application form legibly with all required information
  3. Prepare a comprehensive CV highlighting academic achievements and research interests
  4. Gather all required supporting documents (certificates, marksheets, exam scores, etc.)
  5. Scan all documents clearly (application form, CV, and documents)
  6. Prepare an email with the subject line: "Application for the post of JRF under CSIR project"
  7. Attach all scanned documents to the email
  8. Send the email to the Principal Investigator: [email protected]
  9. Application submission deadline: 05-03-2026

Required Documents

  • Duly filled application form (prescribed format)
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) - comprehensive and detailed
  • Educational certificates and marksheets from Class X onwards
  • NET/GATE Admit Card and Scorecard/Certificate (mandatory)

Selection Process

  1. Application Screening: All applications will be reviewed against eligibility criteria
  2. Shortlisting: Eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on academic performance and NET/GATE scores
  3. Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview (mode to be communicated)
  4. Interview Focus: Subject knowledge, research interest, aptitude for research
  5. Final Selection: Based on interview performance and overall merit
  6. Agreement Signing: Selected candidates must sign the JRF agreement at the time of joining

Important Terms & Conditions

  • Employment Type: Temporary, contractual, time-bound project position
  • Duration: 3 years (May be extended based on project progress and performance)
  • Reporting: To the Principal Investigator (Dr. Ranjith G. Nair), Department of Physics
  • No Objection Certificate: Employed candidates must submit NOC from their employer at the time of interview
  • Institute Rights: The Institute reserves the right to:

  • Agreement Binding: Selected candidates must sign a JRF agreement before joining
  • Compliance: Must adhere to all NIT Silchar rules, regulations, and CSIR guidelines

  • Double-check that copies of all certificates are scanned clearly and legibly

Selection Process

Phases of Recruitment Tests:

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Medical Examination followed by Physical Standard Test (PST)
  • Written Test
  • Walking Test (for Forester Grade-I, Forest Guard & Game Watcher only)
  • Oral/Viva Voce
  • Trade Proficiency Test (for Bandman & Bugler only)
  • Swimming & Boating Test (for Boatman only)

Physical Efficiency Test (PET) - 40 Marks:

For Male Candidates:

  • 3200 meters race to be completed within 14 minutes (840 seconds)
  • Long Jump: Minimum 335 cm (3 chances given, longest valid jump considered)
  • Maximum 20 marks for race (time 600 seconds or less)
  • Maximum 20 marks for long jump (500 cm or more)

For Female Candidates:

  • 1600 meters race to be completed within 8 minutes (480 seconds)
  • Long Jump: Minimum 244 cm (3 chances given, longest valid jump considered)
  • Maximum 20 marks for race (time 330 seconds or less)
  • Maximum 20 marks for long jump (389 cm or more)

Written Test:

For Forester Grade-I (100 Marks):

  • 100 multiple choice questions on OMR sheet
  • Each question carries 1 mark
  • Negative marking: ½ mark for each wrong answer
  • Subjects: Logical reasoning, Aptitude, English Comprehension, History and Culture of Assam and India, General Knowledge

For All Other Posts (50 Marks):

  • 100 multiple choice questions on OMR sheet
  • Each correct answer carries 0.5 marks (Total 50 marks)
  • No negative marking
  • Questions of Class IX and X level
  • Subjects: Elementary Arithmetic, General English, Logical reasoning/Mental ability, Assam's History, Geography, Polity, Economy, General Awareness/GK and current affairs
  • Question paper in Assamese/Bodo/Bengali/English languages

Shortlisting for Written Test:

  • 5 times the number of posts in order of merit based on PET marks
  • If candidates scoring same marks as last selected candidate, they will also be called

Walking Test (Qualifying - No Marks):

  • For Forester Grade-I & Forest Guard only
  • Male: 26 KMs to be covered within 4 hours
  • Female: 16 KMs to be covered within 4 hours

Oral/Viva Voce - 5 Marks:

  • Shortlisting: 2 times number of vacancies based on total marks in PET & Written Test

Swimming & Boating Test - 10 Marks:

  • For Boatman post only
  • Conducted for candidates shortlisted for Oral/Viva Voce

Trade Proficiency Test - 10 Marks:

  • For Bandman & Bugler posts only
  • Conducted for candidates shortlisted for Oral/Viva Voce

NCC Weightage - Maximum 5 Marks:

  • NCC 'C' Certificate: 5 marks
  • NCC 'B' Certificate: 3 marks
  • NCC 'A' Certificate: 2 marks (not applicable for Constable Grade-III, Bandman & Bugler)

Final Merit Calculation:

For Forester Grade-I (Total 150 marks):

  • PET: 40 marks + Written Test: 100 marks + NCC: 5 marks + Oral/Viva Voce: 5 marks

For Most Posts (Total 100 marks):

  • PET: 40 marks + Written Test: 50 marks + NCC: 5 marks + Oral/Viva Voce: 5 marks

For Boatman, Bandman & Bugler (Total 110 marks):

  • PET: 40 marks + Written Test: 50 marks + NCC: 5 marks + Oral/Viva Voce: 5 marks + Swimming/Trade Test: 10 marks

Tie-Breaking:

  • In case of tie, older candidate placed higher
  • If same date of birth, candidate with higher height placed higher in merit

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

General Instructions for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Application Rules:

  • ONE application per candidate - Multiple applications will lead to rejection of ALL applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams
  • Choose only ONE RRB/Railway Zone (cannot be changed later)
  • Indicate post preferences within chosen Railway Zone
  • Partial options allowed (will be considered only for opted posts)
  • No change in preferences after submission
  • Online application only through official RRB websites (listed in Para 24.0)

Identity Authentication:

  • Strongly advised to authenticate using DigiLocker or Aadhaar during account creation
  • Aadhaar-seeded bank account mandatory for fee refund
  • Candidates using alternate Photo IDs will face stricter scrutiny at all stages

Account Creation:

  • If already created account for CEN 2024/2025, use same credentials
  • Valid mobile number and email ID mandatory (will remain unchanged throughout recruitment)
  • Details in 'Create an Account' form CANNOT be modified

Application Modification:

  • Allowed from 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Fee: Rs. 250/- per modification (non-refundable)
  • Can modify any number of times (except 'Create Account' details and Chosen Railway)
  • If changing from SC/ST to UR/OBC/EWS or from ExSM/Female/PwBD to non-reserved: Pay fee difference (Rs. 250/-) in addition to modification fee
  • No modifications entertained after 14.03.2026

Live Photo & Signature Upload:

  • Live Photo: Captured during application (NOT pre-existing photo)
  • Stand/sit in front of camera at eye level, face centered, neutral expression
  • Non-white clothing (preferably dark colors), no cap/mask/glasses
  • Applications with blurred/non-compliant photos liable for rejection
  • Signature: Running handwriting in black ink on white paper (scanned)
  • NO BLOCK/CAPITAL/DISJOINTED LETTERS
  • JPG/JPEG format, 30-49 KB, 140×60 pixels minimum
  • Signature must match at all stages (CBT/DV/ME/Appointment)

Scribe Facility (for eligible PwBD candidates):

  • Eligible: Blindness, Locomotor Disability (Both Arms - BA), Cerebral Palsy
  • Others: Only with certificate from CMO/Civil Surgeon (Annexure V-G)
  • PwBD <40% with writing difficulty: Certificate as per Annexure V-E required
  • Scribe must register at rrbapply.gov.in (One-Time Registration - OTR)
  • Candidate must enter scribe's OTR number during 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026 window
  • Scribe qualification: ONE step below candidate's qualification
  • One scribe per candidate; scribe cannot be a candidate in same CEN
  • Compensatory time: 20 minutes per hour of examination

Examination Centers:

  • Allocated based on technical/logistical feasibility
  • Candidates may have to travel to other cities/states
  • No change of center/date/shift allowed

Banned Items at Exam Center:

  • Mobile phones, pagers, watches, earphones, Bluetooth devices, microphones, health bands
  • Calculators, books, pen, paper, pencil, eraser, pouch, scale, writing pad
  • Belts, handbags, caps, purses, cameras, water bottles, food items
  • ONLY e-call letter allowed inside test center
  • Pen will be provided during exam
  • No cloak room - advised not to bring valuables
  • Do not apply henna on hands/feet (obstructs biometric capture)

Important Warnings:

  • Debarment for life if found using unfair means, impersonation, forgery, misbehavior
  • Provisions of "The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024" applicable
  • Comprehensive post-exam analysis (log analysis, photo/biometric verification, CCTV review)
  • Beware of touts and fake websites - RRBs NEVER appoint agents/coaching centers
  • Selection purely on merit

How to Apply for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Step 1: Create an Account (if not already created)

  • Visit official RRB website from the list at Para 24.0
  • Click on "Create an Account" link
  • Authenticate using DigiLocker/Aadhaar (strongly recommended)
  • Enter valid mobile number and email ID (CANNOT be changed later)
  • Complete OTP verification
  • Create login credentials

Step 2: Fill Online Application

  • Login with created credentials
  • Select CEN 09/2025
  • Choose ONE RRB/Railway Zone (CANNOT be changed)
  • Fill personal details, educational qualifications
  • Select post preferences within chosen Railway
  • Choose examination language (English/Hindi/Regional)
  • Capture live photograph using webcam/mobile camera
  • Upload scanned signature (JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, black ink, running handwriting)
  • Upload SC/ST certificate (if claiming free travel pass)
  • Indicate scribe requirement (if applicable)
  • Verify all details carefully

Step 3: Pay Application Fee

  • Select payment mode: Internet Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI
  • Pay Rs. 500/- (General/EWS/OBC-NCL Male) or Rs. 250/- (SC/ST/PwBD/Female/ExSM/Transgender/Minorities/EBC)
  • Complete payment (all service charges borne by candidate)
  • Save payment receipt

Step 4: Final Submission

  • After successful payment, application will be accepted
  • Receive confirmation via SMS and email
  • Download and save final application form
  • Note Application Number for future reference

Step 5: Modification (if required)

  • Window: 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Login and modify details (except Create Account info & Chosen Railway)
  • Pay Rs. 250/- per modification
  • Pay additional fee if changing from reserved to unreserved category

Step 6: Enter Scribe Details (if applicable)

  • Window: 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026
  • Login to application portal
  • Enter scribe's OTR number
  • Enter OTP sent to scribe's mobile to confirm

Documents to Upload:

  1. Live photograph (captured during application)
  2. Signature (scanned - JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, running handwriting)
  3. SC/ST certificate (PDF, <400 KB) - if claiming free travel pass

Documents Required at DV (Original + 2 self-attested photocopies):

  • 10th/Matriculation certificate (for age & education)
  • ITI/NAC certificate (if applicable)
  • SC/ST certificate (Annexure-I)
  • OBC-NCL certificate (Annexure-II) - issued on/after 01.04.2025
  • OBC-NCL self-declaration (Annexure-II A)
  • EWS certificate (Annexure-III) - valid for 2025-26, based on F.Y. 2024-25
  • EBC certificate (Annexure-III A) / BPL card / Izzat MST (if claimed fee concession)
  • Minority affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper (Annexure-IV)
  • PwBD certificate (Annexure V-A/V-B) with UDID
  • ExSM certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • ExSM declaration (Annexure VI)
  • ExSM NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) - if serving
  • CCAA - NAC certificate from NCVT
  • LASIK declaration (Annexure-VII) - for A2/A3 posts
  • NOC from employer (if Govt. employee)
  • Caste change certificates (if name differs from 10th certificate)
  • Medical certificates (for scribe eligibility - Annexure V-E/V-F/V-G)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Blood Transfusion Officer (Level-11; Age 18–35 years): Recognized medical qualification included in I or II Schedule or Part II of the Third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956; five years’ experience in Blood Bank work after registration as Medical Graduate; registration with a State Medical Council.
  • Store Keeper (Level-6; Age 18–30 years): Bachelor degree in Maths/Economics/Commerce/Statistics and MBA/Postgraduate in Maths/Economics/Commerce/Statistics/Finance from a recognized University with at least 50% marks.
  • Junior Engineer (Civil/Electrical/Refrigeration & Air Conditioning/Horticulture) (Level-6; Age 18–30 years): Degree in respective branch of Engineering OR minimum three years diploma in respective branch of Engineering from a recognized Institute.
  • Pharmacist Grade-II (Level-5; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or its equivalent; Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognized Institution/Board; registered Pharmacist under Pharmacy Act, 1948. Desirable: Degree in Pharmacy and experience in dispensing and/or storage and dispensing of drugs in a reputed hospital/Institution or pharmaceutical concern.
  • Receptionist (Level-5; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Degree from a recognized University; Postgraduate diploma in journalism/Public relations. Desirable: Experience in public relations/publications/printing/publishing; exposure to working on Personal Computer.
  • Sanitary Inspector Grade-II (Level-5; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or equivalent; certificate of Sanitary Inspector course from a recognized Institution; at least four years’ experience in the line preferably in a hospital of repute.
  • Junior Photographer (Level-5; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or equivalent; Diploma in Photography from a recognized Institute; two years’ experience in Photography in a teaching Institute/Hospital OR Matriculation and five years’ experience in Medical Photography in a teaching Institute/Hospital.
  • Dental Mechanic Grade-II (Level-4; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matric with Science; Dental Mechanic course of two years duration from a recognized Dental Institution approved by Dental Council of India. Desirable: Two years’ experience as Dental Mechanic; special training/experience in crown and bridge chrome cobalt, myofunctional orthodontic appliances.
  • Hand Prosthesis Technician (Level-4; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation; Diploma from I.T.I. or equivalent in trade of turner, fitter or metal worker with five years’ experience in making and fitting splints, braces or appliances for disabled people.
  • Dark Room Assistant Grade-III (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or equivalent; Diploma or certificate in Radiography of minimum one year duration from a recognized Institution. Desirable: One year’s experience as Dark Room Assistant in a hospital.
  • Animal Keeper (Level-2; Age 18–30 years): Matric with Science and two years’ experience in breeding and keeping of animals preferably in a medical or research Institution.
  • CSR Assistant Grade-II (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matric with Science and certificate course of Operation Theatre Assistant of one year duration from this Institute. Desirable: Diploma in Operation Theatre Techniques.
  • Technician Grade-IV (Manifold Room/Plant) (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matric/10th Standard with ITI certificate in the respective trade OR Matric with trade certificate from a recognized Institute/Board/authority with five years’ experience in the trade where ITI certificate is not available.
  • Staff Car Driver Ordinary Grade (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or equivalent; valid Driving Licence for driving heavy vehicles; knowledge of motor mechanism and ability to remove minor defects; three years’ experience of driving motor vehicles (including heavy vehicles). Desirable: Three years’ service as Home Guard/Civil Volunteer.
  • Laboratory Attendant Grade-II (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: 10th class pass (with Science as one of the subjects) from a recognized Board. Desirable: Experience in Medical Laboratory.
  • Technician Grade-I (Laundry) (Level-1; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation; ITI in respective trade with two years’ experience in the trade.
  • Security Guard Grade-II (Level-1; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation from a recognized Board/University (relaxable up to Middle Standard pass for certain Ex-servicemen); prescribed physical standards and qualifying Physical Efficiency Test as detailed in the guidelines. Desirable: Service in Armed Forces/Para-Military Forces/Police; experience of performing security duties, preferably in a hospital of repute.

Salary/Stipend

  • Blood Transfusion Officer: Level-11 (Rs. 67,700 – 2,08,700/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Store Keeper and all Junior Engineer posts: Level-6 (Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Pharmacist Grade-II, Receptionist, Sanitary Inspector Grade-II, Junior Photographer: Level-5 (Rs. 29,200 – 92,300/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Dental Mechanic Grade-II and Hand Prosthesis Technician: Level-4 (Rs. 25,500 – 81,100/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Dark Room Assistant Grade-III, Animal Keeper, CSR Assistant Grade-II, Technician Grade-IV (Manifold Room/Plant), Staff Car Driver Ordinary Grade, Laboratory Attendant Grade-II: Level-2 (Rs. 19,900 – 63,200/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Technician Grade-I (Laundry) and Security Guard Grade-II: Level-1 (Rs. 18,000 – 56,900/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.

Age Limit 

  • For Blood Transfusion Officer: 18–35 years.
  • For all other advertised posts: 18–30 years.
  • Upper age limit shall be determined as on the last date of submission of online application form i.e. 16.02.2026.
  • Permissible relaxations in upper age limit for SC/ST, OBC, PwBD, Central Govt. Civilian Employees, Ex-Servicemen, Widows/Divorced women/women judicially separated and not remarried, candidates domiciled in J&K, Defence personnel disabled, Service Clerks and permanent employees of PGIMER are as per detailed table in the guidelines.

Application Fee

  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): Exempted from payment of application fee.
  • SC/ST category candidates: Rs. 800/- plus Transaction Charges as applicable.
  • All others including General/OBC/EWS candidates: Rs. 1500/- plus Transaction Charges as applicable.
  • Application fee is to be deposited through online payment gateway available at the application portal using Debit/Credit Card/Net Banking (payment through UPI may be avoided).
  • The cost of Application Form includes the fee for the Computer Based Test and is non-refundable.

Important Dates

Item / Activity Timeline / Remarks
Opening date for online registration for filling up of online application on PGIMER’s website (Recruitment link at Home Page) 01.01.2026
Closing date for online registration & submission of online applications 16.02.2026
Crucial date for determining eligibility w.r.t. essential qualification(s), age and experience 16.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates who successfully submit online applications will appear in an online Computer Based Test (CBT) conducted in English language only, on an all-India basis.
  • For Group ‘A’ posts: CBT of 85 MCQs (85 marks) and Interview of 15 marks; total 100 marks with minimum qualifying criteria of 40% (General/EWS) and 35% (SC/ST/OBC).
  • For Group ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts: CBT of 100 MCQs (100 marks) with minimum qualifying criteria of 40% (General/EWS) and 35% (SC/ST/OBC); no interview for Group ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts.
  • There will be negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in CBT.
  • Shortlisting will be done post-CBT for scrutiny of applications and document verification, using candidate-wise merit and prescribed ratios (3× or 5× of posts as applicable).
  • For Staff Car Driver Ordinary Grade and Security Guard Grade-II, shortlisted candidates must qualify Trade Test/Physical Efficiency Test as per parameters given in the guidelines.
  • Final selection will be based purely on merit: marks in CBT for Group ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts, and CBT plus Interview for Group ‘A’ posts, subject to verification of documents and eligibility conditions.

General Information/Instructions

  • Information relating to this recruitment including Addendum/Corrigendum, CBT notice, results, eligibility notice, provisional and final results will be displayed only on PGIMER’s website; no individual intimation will be sent.
  • All applicants must read the Guidelines and Help Manual carefully before online registration and ensure that no column is left blank and all entries are correct; once submitted, entries cannot be changed.
  • Candidature of applicants is purely provisional at all stages and may be cancelled if eligibility conditions are not met or incorrect information is found at any stage, even after appointment.
  • Incomplete applications, applications without requisite documents, applications where fee is not paid properly, or where eligibility/age criteria are not met, are liable to be rejected without correspondence.
  • No offline application form or copy of downloaded application form will be accepted by PGIMER.
  • Roll Numbers/Admit Cards for the CBT will be available online only and must be downloaded from the website; they will not be sent by post.
  • No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in document verification or further stages of recruitment.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the applicant; candidates must be in good mental and bodily health as per medical examination requirements.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must visit PGIMER website (www.pgimer.edu.in), check the advertisement and confirm their eligibility before applying online.
  • Applicants should have a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number, which must remain active throughout the recruitment process; these are required for initial registration and communication.
  • Candidates must first complete online registration by filling mandatory details like Advertisement Number, Date, Name (as per Matriculation), Date of Birth, Mobile Number and Email ID; these details cannot be changed once registered.
  • After registration, candidates should log in using their User ID and password, fill the Online Application Form section-wise (personal information, qualifications, experience, and document uploads), and then proceed to fee payment.
  • Application fee must be paid online through Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card using the payment gateway on the application portal; fee is non-refundable.
  • Candidates must upload legible scanned copies of required documents: educational qualifications (from Matric onwards), mark sheets, date of birth proof, category certificates, experience certificates, NOC (if applicable), etc.
  • Photograph must be a clear passport-size coloured photo with light background, in .jpg/.jpeg format, 50–80 KB in size, showing the candidate’s name and date of photograph (snapped on or after 01.10.2025).
  • After final submission and successful fee payment, candidates should take a printout of the completed application form for future reference; no changes are allowed after final submission.

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Educational Qualification

  • ITI Certificate in Cutting & Tailoring / Sewing Technology from a Government-recognized Industrial Training Institute (ITI)
  • Minimum 2 years of working experience as Tailor in any Government / Semi-Government Institution / PSU / Autonomous Body

Desirable Qualification

  • Knowledge of Hindi, Punjabi, and English

Age Limit (as on closing date 02.03.2026)

  • General Category: 18-25 years
  • OBC Category: 18-28 years (3 years age relaxation)
  • Departmental Candidates: Upper age limit relaxable upto 40 years as per Central Government instructions

Physical Fitness & Health

  • Must have sound health both mentally and physically
  • Free from organic defect or bodily infirmity that could interfere with duty performance
  • Weight must be proportionate to height as per medical standards
  • Weight and height will be checked during medical examination

Trade Proficiency Requirements

  • Ability to operate both automatic and manual (foot/hand driven) sewing machines
  • Knowledge of fabric types and human body shapes
  • Knowledge of sewing equipment and tailoring techniques
  • Proficiency in cutting and stitching

Selection Process

Step 1: Written Test (50 marks)

  • 100 Multiple Choice type questions (MCQ)
  • Each correct answer: 0.5 marks
  • Negative marking: 0.25 marks deducted for incorrect answer
  • Question level: Class 10th standard
  • Total marks: 50
  • Subjects covered: Cutting & Tailoring/Sewing Technology, Elementary Arithmetic, General English, Logical Reasoning/Mental Ability, General Awareness/Knowledge and Current Affairs
  • Medium: English, Hindi, Punjabi

Step 2: Trade Proficiency Test (TPT) (50 marks)

  • Practical examination by expert panel
  • Assessment of tailoring skills and sewing machine operation
  • Candidates called: 4 times the number of posts in each category (merit-based)
  • If multiple candidates score same marks, all will be called for TPT
  • Total marks: 50

Final Merit List

  • Based on combined marks: Written Test (50) + TPT (50) = Total 100
  • In case of tie: Older candidate gets higher rank
  • If same age and marks: Ranked by marks percentage

  15. Verify all details carefully before final submission
  16. Submit application before 02.03.2026 at 11:59 PM
  17. Keep printed copy of submitted form and fee receipt

  • Submission of false information or forged documents will lead to disqualification and criminal prosecution

Balodabazar District Child Protection Unit Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must carefully check age, educational qualification, and domicile conditions before applying for the Mission Vatsalya Balodabazar recruitment.

Age Limit (as on 01 January 2026)

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 35 years
  • Maximum age including all applicable relaxations: 45 years (as per Chhattisgarh Government rules)
  • Age relaxation for reserved categories as per Chhattisgarh Government directives and reservation policy.

Educational Qualification

  • Minimum qualification for both posts: 10th Standard Pass from a recognized board/institution.
  • Only full-time qualifications completed on or before the last date of experience period will be considered.
  • All educational certificates must be from recognized boards or institutions.

Residence / Domicile Requirement

  • Applicant must be a local resident of Chhattisgarh.
  • Valid Residence/Domicile Certificate issued by competent authority is mandatory.

Other Important Eligibility Conditions

  • Reserved category candidates must attach permanent caste certificate issued by the competent authority.
  • Candidates who married before attaining the minimum legal marriageable age are not eligible.
  • Government / Semi-government employees must apply through proper channel and enclose a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer.
  • Only full-time, completed educational qualifications and relevant full-time experience will be counted.

Balodabazar District Child Protection Unit Recruitment 2026 – Salary & Benefits

Post Monthly Salary (Consolidated)
Assistant cum Data Entry Operator Rs. 11,916/-
Outreach Worker Rs. 10,592/-

The appointment will be purely contractual for 3 years under Mission Vatsalya Yojana with benefits and terms as per Chhattisgarh Government guidelines.

Balodabazar District Child Protection Unit Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Assistant cum Data Entry Operator

  • Preparation of merit list based on: Educational qualification marks – 80 marks, Experience – up to 10 marks, Skill Test – 10 marks.
  • Top 5 candidates from the merit list will be called for the skill test.
  • Candidates must secure at least 50% marks in the skill test to qualify.

Outreach Worker

  • Merit list based on: Educational qualification – 80 marks, Relevant experience – up to 10 marks, Interview/Skill Test – 10 marks.
  • Candidates will be shortlisted according to merit for interview/skill test as per department decision.

Tie-Breaking Rules

  • If two or more candidates obtain equal total marks, preference will be given to the candidate older in age (based on date of birth).

Experience Requirements

  • Experience certificates must be issued by the employer on official letterhead with office name, registration number, address, post name, nature of work, and duration/period of experience clearly mentioned.
  • Only full-time experience will be considered; voluntary or part-time services will not be counted.
  • Experience marks: 2 marks per completed year of relevant experience, subject to a maximum of 10 marks.

How to Apply for Balodabazar District Child Protection Unit Recruitment 2026

  1. Download the application form: Obtain the prescribed application format from the official Balodabazar district website under the recruitment/notice section of Women and Child Development Department.
  2. Take print and affix photo: Print the application form on A4 size paper and paste a recent passport-size photograph in the given box (upper right corner) with self-attestation across the photo.
  3. Fill all details carefully: Enter personal details, contact information, educational qualifications, experience, reservation category, and post applied for in clear handwriting without overwriting.
  4. Attach mandatory documents: Enclose self-attested copies of residence/domicile certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), all educational certificates and mark sheets, age proof (Birth Certificate or 10th mark sheet), and experience certificates as required.
  5. For government employees: Attach a proper No Objection Certificate (NOC) from your current employer if working in any government/semi-government/PSU organization.
  6. Verify mobile number and email ID: Ensure your active mobile number and email ID are clearly written in the form for communication regarding merit list, skill test, or interview.
  7. Submit the application offline: Put the filled form with all enclosures in an envelope and submit it by post or by hand to the given district office address so that it reaches on or before 16 February 2026 within office hours.

Note: Applications received after the last date, incomplete forms, or forms without required documents are liable to be rejected without any correspondence.

Application Submission Address

Send/submit the application to the following address:
District – Balodabazar-Bhatapara, Chhattisgarh
Phone: As mentioned in the official advertisement.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • All posts are purely contractual for 3 years under Mission Vatsalya Yojana with no claim for permanent government service.
  • Selected candidates must undergo a medical examination within 1 month of selection and submit a health fitness certificate; if found medically unfit, services may be terminated.
  • Selected candidates must join and report with original documents within 15 days from the date of issue of appointment order.
  • Eligible candidates shortlisted on merit will be informed regarding further process through phone and/or email provided in the application form.
  • The decision of the Collector/District authorities will be final and binding in case of any dispute or interpretation regarding recruitment.
  • Age, educational qualification, and experience will be considered strictly as on 01.01.2026.
  • Any form of canvassing, recommendation, or influence will lead to disqualification of the candidate.
  • Reservation will be applicable as per Chhattisgarh Public Service (Reservation) Act, 1994 and related government orders.
  • Only local residents of Chhattisgarh fulfilling domicile conditions are eligible to apply for these posts.

  • Green card holders under family welfare program (Chhattisgarh applicants): 2 years relaxation.

Important Dates

Application Start Date 22 January 2026
Application Last Date 20 February 2026

Selection Process

  • Invite eligible candidates for computer proficiency/skill test.

  • If marks are equal, preference to higher marks in skill test; if still equal, preference based on date of birth (earlier date preferred).
  • Prepare category-wise merit list by adding educational marks and skill test marks for selection.
  • If eligible candidates not available after skill test, prepare provisional list of next 5 times candidates per post from lower merit for document verification and proceed accordingly.

  • Ex-servicemen must attach self-attested copy of discharge book.
  • Applications not accepted before advertisement date or after last date.

  • Selected candidates in government/semi-government service must submit no objection certificate from employer.

  • Details of received applications published on district official website https://kawardha.gov.in.
  • Selected candidates on 3 years probation.
  • In case of any dispute, final decision by appointing authority, i.e., Collector Kabirdham.
  • Any factual/clerical errors in advertisement will be corrected and published on https://kawardha.gov.in.
  • Posting of selected candidate in district office or subordinate project offices.
  • Merit list, objections, document verification, skill test, selection list etc. uploaded on Collector office notice board and https://kawardha.gov.in.
  • All information regarding direct recruitment only through https://kawardha.gov.in; no other correspondence.
  • Ineligibility: Candidate married before minimum marriage age; male with more than one living wife or female married to such male; not medically fit; not suitable after inquiry; convicted of offense against women.

How to Apply

  • Paste recent self-attested passport size photo at designated place in application form.
  • Attach self-attested photocopies of educational qualification, technical qualification, residence certificate, caste certificate, employment registration certificate, and other necessary documents.
  • Send application in prescribed format from 22 January 2026 to 20 February 2026 by 05:30 PM only via registered post or speed post to "Office of District Program Officer, Women and Child Development Department, Kabirdham District (Chhattisgarh) Pin Code-491995".   • Stage 1 - Preliminary Examination: One paper of 100 marks consisting of 100 objective multiple choice questions with 2 hours duration. 40 questions from General Knowledge and Current Affairs, 60 questions from Physics at graduation level.   • No fee is payable for DAPs (Differently Abled Persons).

Important Dates

Notification Date 03/02/2026
Start Date for Submission of Online Application 07/02/2026
Closing Date for Submission of Online Application 28/02/2026
Written Examination (Tentative) 04/04/2026 to 06/04/2026

Selection Process

  • Written Examination
  • Interview

General Information/Instructions

  • Persons suffering from not less than 40% of the relevant disability shall alone be eligible for the benefit of reservation.
  • The candidate should be in possession of disability certificate in the prescribed form issued by the competent authority in this regard.
  • The candidate must be a citizen of India.
  • A candidate must be able to speak Manipuri, Meitei/Meetei Ion or any of the Tribal Dialects of Manipur.
  • A candidate must be a permanent resident of Manipur. Provided that a candidate whose parent or any of his/her ancestors in his/her direct lineage are/were permanent resident of the State, (with proper documentary proof like enrolment in the Electoral Roll and Birth Certificate) then he/she will also be eligible.
  • The date of birth shall be as entered in the Matriculate/High School Leaving Certificate or Secondary School Leaving Certificate or in a certificate recognised by the Indian University as equivalent to Matriculation or in an extract from a Register of Matriculates maintained by a University which extract must be certified by the proper authority of the University or in the Higher secondary or an equivalent examination certificate. No other document relating to age like horoscope, affidavits birth extracts from Municipal Corporation, Service Records and the like will be accepted.
  • Submission of application in any other mode will not be entertained. All applicants should be in possession of the requisite certificates/documents as on the closing date for submission of the online application, i.e. 28th February, 2026.
  • No queries, representations etc. shall be entertained by the Commission in respect of correcting details that are required to be filled up by the candidates by exercising due diligence and caution as the timely completion of examination process is of paramount importance.
  • Candidates should note that payment of examination fee can be made only through online mode as mentioned above. Payment of fee through any other mode is neither valid nor acceptable. Application submitted without prescribed fee/mode shall be summarily rejected.
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances nor can the fee be held in reserve for any other examination or selection.
  • For the Applicants in whose case payments details have not been received from the bank, they will be treated as fictitious payment cases and their applications will be rejected in the first instance. A list of such applicants shall be made available on the Commissions website after the last date of online application. On receipt of documentary proof, genuine fee payment cases will be considered, and their applications will be revived, if they are otherwise eligible.
  • All candidates in service shall submit/upload the “NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE” duly issued by the concerned Department/Authority.
  • The decision of the Commission as to the eligibility or otherwise of a candidate shall be final. If on verification at any stage of the recruitment or after the recruitment, it is found that a candidate does not fulfill any of the eligibility condition, his/her candidature for the Examination will be cancelled by the Commission.
  • The Plan of Examination, Syllabus and venue for Written Examination and Interview will be notified in due course.

How to Apply

  • The online application should be applied at www.empsconline.gov.in w.e.f. 7th February, 2026 to 05:30 PM of 28th February, 2026 after which the link will be disabled.
  • Applications must be submitted online at www.empsconline.gov.in.
  • The application window is open from February 7, 2026, to February 28, 2026, at 05:30 PM.
  • Other submission modes are not accepted.
  • Applicants must possess all required documents by the closing date, February 28, 2026.

Position No. of Posts
