Note: PwD Abbreviations: VH = Visually Handicapped, HH = Hearing Handicapped, MD = Multiple Disabilities, OH = Orthopaedically Handicapped

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Academic level 14 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-10,000)
  • Associate Professor/Deputy Librarian: Academic level 13A with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-9,000)
  • Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian: Academic level 10 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 57,700/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.15,600-39,100 with AGP-6,000)
  • All pay scales are as per UGC/NCERT/Government of India norms and will be applicable as amended from time to time
  • Selected candidates will be entitled to other allowances and benefits as per Government of India/NCERT rules applicable from time to time

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • Age of retirement on superannuation will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • The relaxation in age and percentage of marks to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PWD categories is provided in accordance with the UGC/GOI/NCERT rules
  • Persons with Disability (PWD) having disability less than forty percent will not be considered. The disability certificate shall be from a competent medical board constituted by the central or state Government Hospital
  • Such persons should meet the prescribed criteria of physical disability of the respective category as per the Government of India rules

Application Fee

  • UR/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 1000/- (Rupees One thousand only) through online payment mode only
  • Women applicants and applicants belonging to SC/ST/PWD: Exempted from payment of fee
  • No other mode of payment will be accepted other than online payment mode
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Advertisement Number 177/2026
Commencement of Online Registration on NCERT website 31/01/2026 (10:00 AM)
Extended Last Date of Online Registration and apply online 06/03/2026 (Up to 05:00 PM)
Closing date for eligibility criteria 20/02/2026

Selection Process

  • For Assistant Professor Posts: Up to 50 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for the interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates, which should not be less than academic score of 60 (Sixty) in any case. In case of tie of marks at the 50th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • For Professor and Associate Professor Posts: The existing criterion of minimum academic score as per UGC guidelines will be followed subject to the condition up to 10 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates. In case of tie of marks at the 10th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • The Academic score shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview
  • The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the NCERT website
  • The shortlisted candidates will be allowed to appear for the interview only after verification of their eligibility
  • The registration will be provisional as the eligibility of the shortlisted candidate will be verified at the time of Interview from the original documents
  • All Certificates, Degrees and other documents must be produced in original for verification at the time of interview (if shortlisted), failing which the candidate may not be allowed to appear for the interview
  • Final result of the selected candidates will be displayed on NCERT website
  • The Council will not entertain any correspondence with the candidates about their non-selection in the recruitment
  • The decision of the NCERT in all matters relating to selection and allotment of posts/organizations to selected candidates will be final and binding on the candidates

General Information/Instructions

  • National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) is an apex organization for Educational Research, Teacher Training and Development of Curriculum and Instructional material in school education
  • Positions are available at NCERT, New Delhi and at its constituent units located at Ajmer, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Mysuru and Shillong
  • Only Indian Nationals need to apply
  • Eligible and interested candidates are required to apply online only through the NCERT website www.ncert.nic.in at Announcement-Vacancy-Academic. No other means/mode of submission of applications will be accepted
  • The candidates must have a valid email id and mobile number through which he/she will get registered with the online application portal
  • Candidates should fill in the details to register and then fill the information in the online application form at the appropriate places very carefully
  • Fields with STAR (*) mark are mandatory and essential to be filled in by the candidate
  • After the required information have been provided, click submit button. However, before clicking "Submit" button, candidate must make sure that no changes are required and the information provided is correct and final. After application is submitted, no changes will be entertained
  • Candidates are required to upload their scanned recent/colour passport size photograph, applicant's signature and all the relevant documents. The candidates have to keep a copy of application with documents for record and the same to be produced at the time of verification of document/interview, if shortlisted
  • In case a candidate wishes to apply for more than one post, he/she should submit separate application online along with the requisite fee for each post applied for. All the online applications should be completed in all respects. Only one application for individual post from one applicant will be accepted
  • The candidate should meet the eligibility criteria and provide the information which he/she possesses as on the last date of submission of the application. Candidates who do not possess the requisite educational qualification as on the closing date of receipt of application will not be eligible
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage of recruitment process or even after joining, if any information provided by the candidate is found to be false or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria
  • Candidate must indicate his/her caste/category in the appropriate column of the application form (SC, ST, UR, OBC (NCL) & EWS etc). Leaving the caste column blank would not automatically be assumed as an application for un-reserved category and the application will be rejected as incomplete
  • The OBC-Non Creamy Layer candidates will be required to submit a valid caste certificate for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government from a competent authority along with latest Non Creamy Layer certificate and self-declaration that he/she does not belong to the creamy layer as on the closing date of submission of applications
  • The EWS candidates will be required to submit a valid certificate for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government from a competent authority and self declaration
  • Number of vacancies may vary depending upon the actual requirement. NCERT reserves the right not to fill up any or all the posts or cancel the whole process of recruitment without assigning any reason
  • Mere fulfilling the minimum eligibility requirements does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. NCERT reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates to be called for interview
  • The certificates, which are neither in English nor in Hindi, need to be translated preferably to either in English or in Hindi and the same shall be submitted along with the copy of the certificate in local language
  • The candidate who have received letter grades or grading points instead of marks, should provide conversion chart and percentage equivalent of their respective letter grades, issued by concerned board/university/institution
  • Any subsequent change of address/Telephone No./Email address should be promptly communicated to the Section Officer, Recruitment-1 Section, Room No. 12, 5th Floor, Zakir Hussain Block, NCERT, New Delhi- 110016
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification and the candidature is liable to be summarily rejected
  • In order to avoid last minute rush, the candidates are advised in their own interest to apply well in time
  • All applicants should submit Self Declaration as per prescribed format
  • Applicants serving under Government, Quasi-Government, Public Sector Undertaking and Autonomous Organizations should apply through proper channel and submit at the time of online application the permission letter from their present employer (No Objection Certificate)
  • The shortlisted non-local candidates will be entitled for reimbursement of Train fare restricted up to 3rd AC (except for Special trains like Rajdhani, Shatabadi, etc.) or the actual fare, whichever is less, on submission of tickets
  • Any litigation in the matter will be subject to the Delhi jurisdiction only
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to remain updated with the selection/recruitment process by visiting the website www.ncert.nic.in regularly for any further instruction/information
  • In case of any query related to Advt. No. 177/2026, e-mail id of the section is [email protected]
  • Hindi version of this advertisement is also being published separately. In case of any discrepancies are found in Hindi version, English version will be followed

How to Apply

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates Should Posses 12TH, 10TH, 8TH Pass 

Class 10th /Matric pass with 45% marks in aggregate of five basic subjects and min 33% marks in each of those five subjects. For boards following grading system, grades commensurate to percentages, as above, will be considered. Indian Gorkhas – Class 10th simple pass.

 Age Limit

  • Maximum Age: 22 years

Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

  • Upper Age limit will be relaxable upto 30 years of age (as on date of joining training) in respect of widows of Defence personnel who have died in harness.
  • Note: Women who are widowed, divorced or legally separated are also eligible provided they do not have any children subject to fulfilling all other eligibility criteria. Widows of Defence Personnel who have died in harness will be eligible to apply for enrolment as Women Military Police. Such widows even with children will be, however, eligible only if they have not remarried.

  • Chest Expansion: The candidate should be capable of chest expansion of 05 cms.
  • Weight: Weight standards are based on BMI as per the chart below.

  • Firm dates for online exam will be announced later on the website.

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

  • 1.6 Km Run
    • Group I: Upto 7 Min 45 Secs - Excellent

  • Long Jump: 10 Feet (Need to qualify)

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Paper Subject Type Marks Duration
Paper I General Studies (GS) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II CSAT (Aptitude Test) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

Paper Subject Marks Nature
Paper A Compulsory Indian Language 300 Qualifying
Paper B English 300 Qualifying
Paper I Essay 250 Merit
Paper II General Studies I 250 Merit
Paper III General Studies II 250 Merit
Paper IV General Studies III 250 Merit
Paper V General Studies IV (Ethics) 250 Merit
Paper VI Optional Subject – Paper 1 250 Merit
Paper VII Optional Subject – Paper 2 250 Merit

Main Exam Structure

  • Total Written Papers: 9
  • Qualifying Papers: 2 (Indian Language & English)
  • Merit Papers: 7
  • Total Marks (Written): 1750

Interview / Personality Test

Stage Marks
Personality Test / Interview 275

Final Merit Calculation

  • Written Exam Marks: 1750
  • Interview Marks: 275
  • Total Merit Marks: 2025

Important Notes

  • Prelims marks are used only for qualification, not for final ranking.
  • Mains + Interview marks decide final service allocation.
  • Negative marking applies in Prelims only.
  • Candidates must qualify in both language papers to have their merit papers evaluated.

  2. Candidate should type “Application for the post of Project Technical Support-II or Project Technical Support-III” or Project Research Scientist-I (Medical), Project Research Scientist-III (Medical)” in the subject line while sending their application through e-mail.
  3. The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the website of AIIMS BBSR on 23/02/2026 by 5.00 pm and these candidates will be called for interview/personal discussion as through Walk-In-Interview/Video Conferencing Interview.
  4. Late and incomplete applications or applications not submitted in the prescribed format will not be considered.

  12. Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department/Organizations are not eligible to apply.

  18. The engagement can be terminated at any time by giving one month notice on either side. Contract can be terminated forthwith or before expiry of the notice period by making payment of a sum equivalent to one-month contractual amount. However, you will not be permitted to surrender one-month contractual amount in lieu of the period of notice of unexpired portion thereof and you will be required to serve the full period of notice.

  23. Corrigendum/addendum/further information; if any; in respect of this advertisement, will be published on our website only.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Educational Qualification (Essential): A candidate must hold a Bachelor’s Degree from any University incorporated by an Act of the Central or a State Legislature in India or an Educational Institution established by an Act of Parliament or deemed to be a University under Section-3 of the UGC Act, 1956 or a Foreign University approved by the Central Government from time to time.

Selection Process

  • The Combined Competitive Recruitment Examination shall comprise:
    • Preliminary Examination (Objective type) for selection of candidates for Main Examination.
    • Main Examination (Written) and Interview for Personality Test for selection to various services and posts.
  • Preliminary Examination: Two compulsory papers of Objective Type (Multiple Choice Questions), General Studies Paper-I (200 marks) and General Studies Paper-II (200 marks), each of 2 hours duration.
  • General Studies Paper-II is a qualifying paper with minimum qualifying marks of 33; selection to Main Examination is based on marks in General Studies Paper-I and qualifying the Paper-II as per rules.
  • There shall be negative marking: for each wrong answer, one-third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question shall be deducted; multiple answers to a question are treated as wrong.
  • Main Examination: Written examination consists of nine papers – two qualifying language papers (Odia and English) in Part-I and seven papers in Part-II (Essay, General Studies-I, II, III, IV and two Optional subject papers).
  • Marks obtained in Part-II papers and Interview (Personality Test) are counted for ranking; language papers in Part-I are qualifying in nature.
  • Interview (Personality Test) carries 250 marks; final ranking is based on total marks of Main Written and Interview.
  • Candidates are allotted to various Services based on ranks and service preference.

  • The advertisement does not bind the Government to make appointment; the number of vacancies is subject to change without notice depending on public service requirements.
  • Misrepresentation or suppression of information in the online application will result in cancellation of candidature and penalty as decided by the Commission.
  • Mere empanelment in the select list does not confer any right to appointment unless the Government is satisfied about suitability after necessary enquiry.
  • No request for withdrawal of candidature or change of category will be entertained.
  • Candidates must carefully fill service/post preference; change of preference after submission of online application will not be allowed.
  • Candidates must answer papers in their own handwriting; only PwD candidates with specified disabilities may use a scribe as per rules.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online through the OPSC website (https://opsc.gov.in).

  • The last date for submission of registered online application is 27/02/2026 (5.00 P.M.).
  • Applications received through any mode other than online shall not be accepted and will be summarily rejected.
  • After declaration of result of the Main Written Examination, candidates called for Interview/Personality Test will be required to submit print-out/hard copy of online application along with photocopies of documents as stated in the advertisement on the day of document verification.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry

  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

General Instructions for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Application Rules:

  • ONE application per candidate - Multiple applications will lead to rejection of ALL applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams
  • Choose only ONE RRB/Railway Zone (cannot be changed later)
  • Indicate post preferences within chosen Railway Zone
  • Partial options allowed (will be considered only for opted posts)
  • No change in preferences after submission
  • Online application only through official RRB websites (listed in Para 24.0)

Identity Authentication:

  • Strongly advised to authenticate using DigiLocker or Aadhaar during account creation
  • Aadhaar-seeded bank account mandatory for fee refund
  • Candidates using alternate Photo IDs will face stricter scrutiny at all stages

Account Creation:

  • If already created account for CEN 2024/2025, use same credentials
  • Valid mobile number and email ID mandatory (will remain unchanged throughout recruitment)
  • Details in 'Create an Account' form CANNOT be modified

Application Modification:

  • Allowed from 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Fee: Rs. 250/- per modification (non-refundable)
  • Can modify any number of times (except 'Create Account' details and Chosen Railway)
  • If changing from SC/ST to UR/OBC/EWS or from ExSM/Female/PwBD to non-reserved: Pay fee difference (Rs. 250/-) in addition to modification fee
  • No modifications entertained after 14.03.2026

Live Photo & Signature Upload:

  • Live Photo: Captured during application (NOT pre-existing photo)
  • Stand/sit in front of camera at eye level, face centered, neutral expression
  • Non-white clothing (preferably dark colors), no cap/mask/glasses
  • Applications with blurred/non-compliant photos liable for rejection
  • Signature: Running handwriting in black ink on white paper (scanned)
  • NO BLOCK/CAPITAL/DISJOINTED LETTERS
  • JPG/JPEG format, 30-49 KB, 140×60 pixels minimum
  • Signature must match at all stages (CBT/DV/ME/Appointment)

Scribe Facility (for eligible PwBD candidates):

  • Eligible: Blindness, Locomotor Disability (Both Arms - BA), Cerebral Palsy
  • Others: Only with certificate from CMO/Civil Surgeon (Annexure V-G)
  • PwBD <40% with writing difficulty: Certificate as per Annexure V-E required
  • Scribe must register at rrbapply.gov.in (One-Time Registration - OTR)
  • Candidate must enter scribe's OTR number during 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026 window
  • Scribe qualification: ONE step below candidate's qualification
  • One scribe per candidate; scribe cannot be a candidate in same CEN
  • Compensatory time: 20 minutes per hour of examination

Examination Centers:

  • Allocated based on technical/logistical feasibility
  • Candidates may have to travel to other cities/states
  • No change of center/date/shift allowed

Banned Items at Exam Center:

  • Mobile phones, pagers, watches, earphones, Bluetooth devices, microphones, health bands
  • Calculators, books, pen, paper, pencil, eraser, pouch, scale, writing pad
  • Belts, handbags, caps, purses, cameras, water bottles, food items
  • ONLY e-call letter allowed inside test center
  • Pen will be provided during exam
  • No cloak room - advised not to bring valuables
  • Do not apply henna on hands/feet (obstructs biometric capture)

Important Warnings:

  • Debarment for life if found using unfair means, impersonation, forgery, misbehavior
  • Provisions of "The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024" applicable
  • Comprehensive post-exam analysis (log analysis, photo/biometric verification, CCTV review)
  • Beware of touts and fake websites - RRBs NEVER appoint agents/coaching centers
  • Selection purely on merit

How to Apply for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Step 1: Create an Account (if not already created)

  • Visit official RRB website from the list at Para 24.0
  • Click on "Create an Account" link
  • Authenticate using DigiLocker/Aadhaar (strongly recommended)
  • Enter valid mobile number and email ID (CANNOT be changed later)
  • Complete OTP verification
  • Create login credentials

Step 2: Fill Online Application

  • Login with created credentials
  • Select CEN 09/2025
  • Choose ONE RRB/Railway Zone (CANNOT be changed)
  • Fill personal details, educational qualifications
  • Select post preferences within chosen Railway
  • Choose examination language (English/Hindi/Regional)
  • Capture live photograph using webcam/mobile camera
  • Upload scanned signature (JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, black ink, running handwriting)
  • Upload SC/ST certificate (if claiming free travel pass)
  • Indicate scribe requirement (if applicable)
  • Verify all details carefully

Step 3: Pay Application Fee

  • Select payment mode: Internet Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI
  • Pay Rs. 500/- (General/EWS/OBC-NCL Male) or Rs. 250/- (SC/ST/PwBD/Female/ExSM/Transgender/Minorities/EBC)
  • Complete payment (all service charges borne by candidate)
  • Save payment receipt

Step 4: Final Submission

  • After successful payment, application will be accepted
  • Receive confirmation via SMS and email
  • Download and save final application form
  • Note Application Number for future reference

Step 5: Modification (if required)

  • Window: 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Login and modify details (except Create Account info & Chosen Railway)
  • Pay Rs. 250/- per modification
  • Pay additional fee if changing from reserved to unreserved category

Step 6: Enter Scribe Details (if applicable)

  • Window: 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026
  • Login to application portal
  • Enter scribe's OTR number
  • Enter OTP sent to scribe's mobile to confirm

Documents to Upload:

  1. Live photograph (captured during application)
  2. Signature (scanned - JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, running handwriting)
  3. SC/ST certificate (PDF, <400 KB) - if claiming free travel pass

Documents Required at DV (Original + 2 self-attested photocopies):

  • 10th/Matriculation certificate (for age & education)
  • ITI/NAC certificate (if applicable)
  • SC/ST certificate (Annexure-I)
  • OBC-NCL certificate (Annexure-II) - issued on/after 01.04.2025
  • OBC-NCL self-declaration (Annexure-II A)
  • EWS certificate (Annexure-III) - valid for 2025-26, based on F.Y. 2024-25
  • EBC certificate (Annexure-III A) / BPL card / Izzat MST (if claimed fee concession)
  • Minority affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper (Annexure-IV)
  • PwBD certificate (Annexure V-A/V-B) with UDID
  • ExSM certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • ExSM declaration (Annexure VI)
  • ExSM NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) - if serving
  • CCAA - NAC certificate from NCVT
  • LASIK declaration (Annexure-VII) - for A2/A3 posts

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Secondary School Examination (SSE) pass certificate of 10th standard with passing marks in Mathematics and English conducted by any recognized Board of School Education by the Government of India, State Governments, or Union Territories in India.
  • The applicant should have studied the local language at least up to 10th Standard from a recognized board. Post-wise local language details are given in Annexure-III.
  • Special provisions apply for engagement in Arunachal Pradesh, Goa, and Sikkim regarding local language requirements.

Essential Qualifications

  • Knowledge of computers
  • Knowledge of cycling
  • Adequate means of livelihood

Desirable

  • Candidates applying for BPM posts must be able to arrange accommodation for running the Branch Post Office at their own cost.
  • Ability to work in rural areas
  • Ability to use smartphones, laptops, or computer devices

Salary/Stipend

GDS are paid emoluments in the form of Time Related Continuity Allowance (TRCA), which carry an annual increase of 3 percent, subject to fulfillment of conditions. They are also entitled to Dearness Allowance on TRCA as declared by the Government of India from time to time.

  • Branch Postmaster (BPM): Rs. 12,000 to Rs. 29,380 per month
  • Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM): Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 24,470 per month
  • Dak Sevak: Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 24,470 per month

Additional Benefits:

  • Dearness Allowance on TRCA
  • GDS Gratuity
  • Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (akin to National Pension System)

Age Limit (as on 16/02/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 40 years

Age Relaxation

Category Age Relaxation
SC/ST (Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe) 5 years
OBC (Other Backward Classes) 3 years
EWS (Economically Weaker Sections) No relaxation
PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities) 10 years
PwBD + OBC 13 years
PwBD + SC/ST 15 years

Note: Age will be determined as on the last date of submission of applications (16/02/2026).

Application Fee

  • General/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 100 (Rupees One Hundred only)
  • Fee Exemption for: All female applicants, SC/ST applicants, PwBD applicants, and Transwomen applicants

Payment Mode: Online payment through Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking, or UPI

Important: Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Candidates are advised to ensure their eligibility before making fee payment.

Important Dates

Online One-Time Registration 31/01/2026 14/02/2026 (upto 1700 Hrs)
Submission of Online Applications and Fee Payment 02/02/2026 16/02/2026 (upto 1700 Hrs)
Corrections in Registration/Application Forms (Edit/Correction Window) 18/02/2026 19/02/2026 (upto 1700 Hrs)
Physical Verification of Documents Within 15 days from date of shortlisting
Joining Formalities Within 30 days from offer of provisional engagement
Process of Engagement Closes 30/06/2026

Selection Process

  • Applicants will be shortlisted for engagement on the basis of a system-generated merit list.
  • Merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in Secondary School Examination of 10th standard, aggregated to percentage to the accuracy of 4 decimals.
  • For applicants with grades/points only, subject-wise marks will be arrived at by applying a multiplication factor of 9.5.
  • Where Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) is provided, marks will be arrived at by multiplying the CGPA by 9.5.
  • In case of tie among applicants, priority will be decided based on: DOB (older in age), followed by category order: ST trans-woman, ST female, SC trans-woman, SC female, OBC trans-woman, OBC female, EWS trans-woman, EWS female, UR trans-woman, UR female, and so on.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed through SMS and email on registered mobile number and email address.
  • Physical verification of documents will be conducted by the Divisional/Unit Head of the Division/Unit where the post is notified.
  • Upon successful verification, a system-generated 'Offer of provisional engagement' will be issued immediately.
  • Candidates must complete pre-engagement formalities within 30 days from the date of offer of provisional engagement, including prescribed basic training of 3 days and arrangement of accommodation (for BPM posts).
  • Final order of engagement will be issued after receipt of verification reports from issuing authorities and antecedent reports from Police Authorities.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only one registration is permitted per candidate. Multiple or duplicate registrations/applications are strictly prohibited.
  • Candidates are not required to attach/upload any documents along with the application form except recent photograph and signature.
  • Applications submitted without complete data will be rejected.
  • Applicants should enter all details such as name, date of birth, father's name, and mother's name strictly as per the SSC (Class X) marksheet.
  • Applications with blurred or illegible photographs/signatures will be rejected.
  • GDS are not regular employees of the Department/Central Government. Their service conditions are governed by GDS (Conduct and Engagement) Rules, 2020.
  • GDS are required to work for a minimum of four hours and a maximum of five hours a day.
  • GDS cannot be retained beyond 65 years of age.
  • A Sevak should have another source of income besides the allowances paid by the Government for adequate means of livelihood.
  • Candidates selected as BPM are required to arrange accommodation for running the Branch Post Office at their own cost.
  • The Department reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, or revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason.
  • Candidates who have been dismissed/removed/compulsory retired from Government service/Gramin Dak Sevak in the past as a measure of penalty are barred from applying.
  • No person holding an elective office will be considered for engagement.
  • The applicant selected as GDS shall not engage in any activity with any outside agency detrimental to the business or interest of the Post Office/IPPB.
  • Past experience or service of any kind will not be considered for selection.
  • The Department will verify the authenticity of Secondary Level Marksheets through API SETU Portal/Digi Locker if available online.

How to Apply

  • Applications must be submitted in online mode only at https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement
  • Applications received through any other mode will not be entertained.
  • The application process consists of two parts: (A) One-Time Registration (OTR) and (B) Filling of Online Application
  • Candidates must have their own active email ID and mobile number for registration.
  • Once registered, the same mobile number and email ID will not be allowed for further registrations of any other applicant.
  • Before One-Time Registration, keep ready: Mobile Number (to be verified through OTP), Email ID (to be verified through OTP), and information about Board and Year of Passing Matriculation (10th) Examination.
  • For One-Time Registration, click on "Candidate Login/Register" button, then click on "New Candidate Registration".
  • After registration, a registration number will be generated and sent to registered mobile number and email ID.
  • For submitting the application, log in using Registration Number and password.
  • Fill all details in the online application form including Personal Details, Board/Educational Details, Division selection and Post preference.
  • Upload recent photograph (JPG/JPEG format, 30 KB to 100 KB, 320×400 pixels recommended) and signature (JPG/JPEG format, 20 KB to 100 KB, 300×120 pixels recommended).
  • Preview the application before final submission.
  • Make fee payment if applicable before final submission.
  • Candidates can apply for one or more vacant posts in only one selected Division.
  • On selecting the Division, give preferences for eligible posts based on community, age, PwD status, and local languages studied.
  • If shortlisted for more than one post, only the first post in order of preference will be offered and candidature for remaining posts will be forfeited.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the online application well before the closing date and time.
  • The cut-off time for submission is 17:00 hours on 16/02/2026.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Graduate or higher degree in any field.
  • Essential Qualification: The applicant should only be an Indian national. The applicant must have a graduate or higher degree in any field.
  • Desirable Qualification: Knowledge of Chinese language (HSK level 4 to 6) is desirable. Relevant publications/writings in reputed journals /periodicals.
  • Experience: Previous work experience of handling issues relating to foreign policy/international relations, especially related to China and the party politics in China. Extra credit may be given for experience of work in reputed university, think-tank or research organization in the area of foreign policy, international affairs or China related issues.

Salary/ Stipend

  • The remuneration package will be commensurate with the experience and profile of the selected candidate, subject to a maximum of Rs. 12,00,000/- (Rupees Twelve lakh only) per annum each and deduction of applicable taxes. The amount of consultancy fee so fixed shall remain unchanged during the term of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 03-03-2026)

  • The applicant should not be more than 50 years of age as on the last date of submission of application.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 9 February 2026
Last Date for Receiving Applications 3 March 2026

Selection Process

  • Ministry of External Affairs will review the applications and shortlist the candidates for interview / written test. The shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email.
  • The date, time and venue of the interview will be conveyed through email at the email address provided by the applicants.
  • The decision of the Government regarding selection of candidate will be final.

General Information/ Instructions

  • The engagement will be strictly contractual and will not confer any other benefits to the selected candidate.
  • The Consultant shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc. or any other benefits available to the regular employees of the Ministry.
  • No HRA shall be admissible.
  • The engagement of the Consultant is on full time basis. Normal working hours will be from 0900 to 1730 hrs. Working hours is subject to change from time to time. Saturdays/Sundays will remain closed as weekend off. In exigencies, he/she may be required to work beyond office hours and/or on closed holidays. No extra allowance or remuneration for such work is admissible. He/She shall not accept any other professional appointment, paid or otherwise during the term of engagement with this Ministry.
  • Paid leave of absence may be allowed to the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Accumulation of leave beyond a calendar year may not be allowed. Leave cannot be claimed as a matter of right. Leave will not be allowed for more than 10 days at a time. Discretion is reserved to the Head of Division to refuse or revoke leave in the public interest. Leave encashment will not be permissible on unspent leave. Unspent leave will lapse on commencement of notice period. No other leave of any kind shall be admissible to him/her. In case he/she remains absent from duty beyond entitled leave, a proportionate deduction from the consolidated fee as applicable will be made.
  • In case the Consultant is required to travel as part of his/her duties, the Ministry will take care of his/her travel, accommodation and per-diem costs, as per Ministry’s guidelines.
  • The selected person will be required to enter into a contract with the Ministry in a prescribed format w.e.f. the actual date of engagement as Consultant.
  • Period of Consultancy: 01 (One) year. The contract can be extended further depending on assessment of performance, mutual willingness and the requirement. The contract may be terminated on one month’s notice from either side or on payment of one month’s pay in lieu thereof. Unauthorized absence may lead to termination of the engagement.
  • Job Location: Ministry of External Affairs (South Block, Patiala House, JNB, ISIL Building, SSB, CCS Building), New Delhi.
  • Nature of duties: The Selected Consultant will be required to work in the Centre of Contemporary China Studies (CCCS) in the Ministry. His/Her duties will entail regular monitoring of information relevant to foreign Policy formulation, and providing knowledge-based inputs for the same. He/She will be required to summarize and analyze published material in the areas assigned to them, as it appears in media or academic journals. He/She will be required to undertake translation projects of news reports and other material. He/She will also be required to attend important seminars, meeting and conferences relevant to the work of Ministry, and submit reports on them. He/She time to time, may also be asked to undertake research on specific foreign policy related issues.

How to Apply

  • The applicants who fulfill the eligibility criteria may submit application indicating their interest in working for the Ministry of External Affairs as per proforma at Annexure I.
  • Documents / certificates in support of educational qualifications, experience in Govt. service should be attached with the application.
  • Applications along with supporting documents can be submitted to the Ministry through either of the following modes:
  • OFFLINE MODE:- By registered post in an envelope labelled as “Application for the position of Consultant in CCCS Division of Ministry of External Affairs”. This is to be sent to the following address: Under Secretary (PF&PG) Ministry of External Affairs, Room No. 4071, Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan, 23-D, Janpath, New Delhi-110011
  • ONLINE MODE:- Through email with the subject clearly mentioning the name of the candidate and the name of position against which the application is being submitted. The email is to be sent to the following email address: [email protected]
  • Incomplete application and those received without supporting documents will be summarily rejected.
  • Applicants will have to make their own arrangements to reach the place of interview.
  • No TA/DA will be payable by the Ministry to Applicants for attending interview.

in  Computer Science and Engineering and aligned branches - AI, data science, cybersecurity, IoT, etc., or Information Security, or Electronics & Communication Engineering or Electrical Engineering

 Age Limit and Relaxation

  • Maximum Age limit: 56 Years
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

Upper Age limit will be as specified against each post

Applicants belonging to reserved category (SC/ST/OBC) / physically challenged/Ex-servicemen could be eligible for relaxations according to the ‘Government of India’ norms.

 Government employees on payscale will be eligible for relaxation in age by 5 years including  other  age relaxations as applicable.

 The cut-off date for ascertaining the age and experience will be Last Date of submission of    application.

Candidates seeking age relaxation need to submit a copy of caste certificate when called for document verification.  

 SSLC/SSC/ISC mark sheet/ certificate and any other valid document will be considered as proof of date of birth.

The Economically Weaker Section’s Certificate should be strictly in the format prescribed by DoPT.  The format is available on the website www.persmin.nic.in

The application of the candidates not meeting the prescribed age criteria will be reject/cancelled without any prior intimation.

Candidates belonging to OBC category (Non creamy layer) should produce the certificate issued in prescribed format.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is charged by C-DAC for applying to this advertisement.

Important Dates

  • Notification Release Date: 01-02-2026
  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 01-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 20-02-2026
  • Interview Dates: Will be communicated via email to shortlisted candidates

Selection Process

  • Candidate should meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the advertisement.  
  • The qualification and experience prescribed, are the minimum requirements and possession of the  same does not automatically make the candidates entitled to be called for written test and / or selection processes. 
  • There will be an initial screening based on the academic records and other parameters declared in  the on-line application and only screened-in candidates will be considered for further selection process. 
  • The management reserves the right to increase/alter the minimum eligibility criteria/cut off  limits, in  the event of the number of applicants are more, for any post(s), at its discretion. 
  • Candidates will be selected on the basis of their academic credentials, experience profile, written   test marks (if any), performance in the interview and such other selection processes/parameters, as adopted and deemed fit by management. e. Mere application and fulfilment of the mentioned qualifications etc., does not entitle a candidate  to be called for written/skill test/ interview.
  • C-DAC may restrict the number of candidates to be  called to participate in interview/selection process to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than that of the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. The  candidates should, therefore, furnish all the qualifications and experience possessed in the relevant field, over and above the minimum qualifications prescribed.  
  • The selection process shall be carried out by the respective C-DAC Centre based on its requirements and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further process.
  • All information submitted in the application will be verified with the original documents at the time  of document verification or at any stage of the recruitment process. If any documents/information provided by the candidate is found to be false or incorrect or Non- conformity with the eligibility criteria, then his/her candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at  any stage of the recruitment and selection process without any prior intimation.
  • The candidature is also liable for rejection at any stage if C-DAC comes across any evidence/knowledge that the qualification, experience and any other particulars indicated in the application/other    forms/formats are not recognized/false misleading and/or amounts to suppression of information/particulars which should have been brought to the notice of C-DAC

How to Apply

  • Before filling the online application form, Candidates should read General Terms and Conditions carefully.
  • Candidate should read all the eligibility parameters and ensure that he/she is eligible for the post before starting to apply online.
  • Candidate should have a valid email id and mobile no. which should remain valid & active till the completion of selection process.
  • While applying online Candidates can click on the ‘Apply’ button provided against each position for which he/she wish to apply.
  • The candidate needs to log in with mobile no. and then fill in the OTP received on the said mobile no.
  • On filling the correct OTP, the applicant will be directed to fill in the application form. In case you have filled in an application in our previous advertisement, the applicant will receive a prefilled editable application.
  • Candidates shall check the prefilled application and submit it, after adding additional details by clicking on ‘Submit’ button.
  • Candidates should scan their photograph in .jpg format (not more than 400 KB) and keep it ready before starting to apply online for uploading.
  • Candidate should upload their resume in PDF format (Not more than 500 KB)

UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Paper Subject Type Marks Duration
Paper I General Studies (GS) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II CSAT (Aptitude Test) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

Paper Subject Marks Nature
Paper A Compulsory Indian Language 300 Qualifying
Paper B English 300 Qualifying
Paper I Essay 250 Merit
Paper II General Studies I 250 Merit
Paper III General Studies II 250 Merit
Paper IV General Studies III 250 Merit
Paper V General Studies IV (Ethics) 250 Merit
Paper VI Optional Subject – Paper 1 250 Merit
Paper VII Optional Subject – Paper 2 250 Merit

  • Merit Papers: 7
  • Total Marks (Written): 1750

Interview / Personality Test

Stage Marks

Final Merit Calculation

  • Written Exam Marks: 1750
  • Interview Marks: 275
  • Total Merit Marks: 2025

Important Notes

  • Prelims marks are used only for qualification, not for final ranking.
  • Mains + Interview marks decide final service allocation.
  • Negative marking applies in Prelims only.
  • Candidates must qualify in both language papers to have their merit papers evaluated.

NeGD SIDH Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility & Roles

1. Data & Analytics Lead

Job Title Data & Analytics Lead
Location New Delhi
Project SIDH
Experience 8+ years (with minimum 3 years leading analytics initiatives)
Budget As per market standards

Educational Qualifications

  • B.Tech./M.Tech/M.S./PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or related quantitative field (advanced degree preferred).
  • Minimum 8+ years in data analytics, business intelligence, or quantitative research with at least 3 years leading analytics initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement analytics frameworks for platform performance and user behaviour monitoring aligned with SIDH Digital Public Infrastructure objectives.
  • Oversee real-time dashboards on skill acquisition, certification, employment outcomes, and scheme effectiveness across government programmes.
  • Establish data governance protocols ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act.
  • Drive predictive analytics to forecast skilling demand, optimise resource allocation, and identify emerging skill gaps.
  • Translate complex data insights into policy recommendations for MSDE and stakeholders.
  • Manage data quality assurance across integrated platforms.
  • Develop advanced analytics models for personalised learning pathways and career guidance.
  • Coordinate integration of external systems (Aadhaar eKYC, DigiLocker, PFMS, etc.) into SIDH data lake/warehouse.

Essential Skills

  • Data engineering & orchestration on AWS: Informatica 10.5.4, Airflow, Jenkins, Kafka, PySpark/Spark.
  • Data lakes/warehouses: S3, Redshift/Snowflake, SQL/NoSQL (Postgres, Mongo, Cassandra).
  • BI & Reporting: Power BI.
  • Advanced analytics: Python/R for ML, NLP, forecasting, experimentation.

Desirable Skills

  • Tableau/QuickSight, Elasticsearch; Delta/Iceberg lakehouse, Glue Catalog.
  • MLOps (SageMaker/MLflow), unstructured/NLP analytics.
  • Certifications like AWS Data Analytics, Azure Data Engineer, Power BI, and prior public sector analytics experience.

2. UI/UX Lead

Job Title UI/UX Lead
Location New Delhi
Project SIDH
Experience 8+ years in UI/UX with at least 5 years in a senior designer role
Budget As per market standards

Experience & Role

  • 8+ years in UI/UX design with 5+ years in senior role; experience in large corporations or government IT organisations.
  • Lead design strategy, user research, wireframing, prototyping, and visual design for web and mobile platforms.
  • Work closely with product, development, BA, and stakeholder teams to deliver user-centric solutions.
  • Drive user research, usability testing, heuristic evaluations, and adoption of responsive design frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure adherence to accessibility (WCAG), GIGW 3.0, and design system standards.
  • Translate user and business needs into intuitive, consistent interfaces.
  • Mentor junior UI/UX designers and ensure quality control in all deliverables.
  • Create social media posts, newsletters, banners, and digital creatives.
  • Identify and troubleshoot UX problems; create wireframes, prototypes, storyboards, and user flows.

Tools & Skills

  • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar tools.
  • Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript for better developer collaboration.
  • Familiarity with testing/analytics tools like Hotjar, Maze.
  • Strong grasp of mobile-first, responsive design and visual style standards.

Educational Qualification & Desirables

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Design, HCI, Fine Arts, Visual Design/Communication, Design Computing, or related field.
  • Desirable: Experience in government/large-scale/citizen-facing platforms; agile environment exposure; tools like ClickUp, JIRA, Confluence, Trello; UI/UX/Interaction Design certifications.

NeGD SIDH Contract Jobs 2026 – General Conditions

  • Candidates already in Central/State Govt., PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies should apply through proper channel or submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at application or interview stage.
  • Posts are purely temporary for NeGD/DIC projects; no claim for permanent appointment in NeGD/DIC.
  • NeGD may fill all/some/none of the positions and may terminate appointments with one month’s notice or salary in lieu.
  • Designation mapping will be as per NeGD’s existing designation policy.

How to Apply Online for NeGD SIDH Recruitment 2026

  1. Check eligibility: Confirm that you meet the required qualifications, experience, and age criteria (not more than 55 years on the closing date).
  2. Visit the online application portal: Go to https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ from a desktop or mobile browser.
  3. Register / Login: Create a new user account (if required) with a valid email ID and mobile number, or log in with existing credentials.
  4. Select the post: Choose the relevant position (Data & Analytics Lead or UI/UX Lead) under NeGD SIDH recruitment and open the online form.
  5. Fill the application form: Enter personal details, academic qualifications, total and relevant experience, and project-specific skills accurately; upload your latest CV/resume if required.
  6. Upload documents: Attach necessary documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, and NOC (if employed in Govt./PSU/Autonomous Body), as per portal instructions.
  7. Submit the form: Review all details carefully and submit the online application before the last date; keep a copy/print of the final submitted form or acknowledgment for future reference.

Important: Screening will be based on qualifications, age, and relevant experience, and NeGD may fix higher cut-offs; only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview, and NeGD reserves the right not to select any candidate.

A. Security Architecture and Design

  • Develop and maintain robust cyber security architecture aligned with NIST, ISO 27001 and other industry best practices.

  • Collaborate with IT and OT teams to integrate cyber security controls into existing and upcoming systems.

B. Vulnerability Management

  • Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing of IT and OT systems and networks.
  • Develop and monitor remediation plans for identified vulnerabilities.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and vendors for timely patching and system updates.

C. Threat Detection and Incident Response

  • Implement and continuously monitor security tools (IDS/IPS, SIEM) to detect anomalies and potential threats.

  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and conduct forensic investigations when required.

  • Perform cyber risk assessments to identify threats and evaluate operational impact.

  • Design and deliver cyber security awareness programs for staff, contractors and third-party vendors.

  • Proficiency in risk assessment methodologies and compliance frameworks.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical and incident handling capabilities.

  • Conduct field surveys and data collection for vulnerability assessments
  • Perform statistical analysis and modeling of climate and water resource data
  • Prepare technical reports and research papers for UNFCCC communication
  • Collaborate with other team members and external stakeholders on project activities
  • Contribute to policy recommendations for climate-resilient water resources management
  • Assist in preparing project deliverables and documentation as required
  • Participate in project meetings and progress reviews

  • Contact details (email, phone number, address)
