  • Candidates will appear for Written Test/ CBT at the allotted centre at their own risk and expense; no TA/DA shall be payable for attending Written Test/ CBT.
  • Candidates will be shortlisted in order of merit in the respective category in the ratio of 1:5 for Interview.
  • Document verification will be done before Interview and candidates must carry original certificates; failing this, they will not be allowed to attend the Interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals above 18 years of age are eligible to apply.

  • Experience is counted from the date of assumption of charge; teaching or freelancing experience will not be considered as qualifying experience.
  • No person previously dismissed, removed or compulsorily retired from service of any Government Department, PSU, local authority or autonomous corporation shall be eligible for appointment.

  • While applying online, candidates must upload self-attested copies of 10th Certificate/Birth Certificate, degree certificates (Graduation and Post-Graduation), appointment letters, latest salary slip, APARs (last three years), office orders indicating promotions, experience/service certificates/relieving orders, Form-16/ITR, last 12 months’ bank statement and last 12 months’ salary slips, as applicable.
  • Applications without supporting certificates/documents shall be summarily rejected.
  • After submitting online application, the candidate is required to download the system-generated Application Form with Unique Registration Number, attach supporting documents and send it to Career Cell, HR Department, National Capital Region Transport Corporation, Gatishakti Bhawan, INA Colony, New Delhi – 110023 by hand/Post by 19/02/2026.
  • The envelope containing the application and documents should be superscribed as “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF- ASSISTANT MANAGER (TRANSPORT PLANNER) ON CONTRACT (REGULAR SCALE)- 02/2026”.
  • Candidates should take preview of the application before final submission; once the form is submitted, it cannot be edited.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Paper Subject Type Marks Duration
Paper I General Studies (GS) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II CSAT (Aptitude Test) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

Paper Subject Marks Nature
Paper A Compulsory Indian Language 300 Qualifying
Paper B English 300 Qualifying
Paper I Essay 250 Merit
Paper II General Studies I 250 Merit
Paper III General Studies II 250 Merit
Paper IV General Studies III 250 Merit
Paper V General Studies IV (Ethics) 250 Merit
Paper VI Optional Subject – Paper 1 250 Merit
Paper VII Optional Subject – Paper 2 250 Merit

Main Exam Structure

  • Total Written Papers: 9
  • Qualifying Papers: 2 (Indian Language & English)
  • Merit Papers: 7
  • Total Marks (Written): 1750

Interview / Personality Test

Stage Marks
Personality Test / Interview 275

Final Merit Calculation

  • Written Exam Marks: 1750
  • Interview Marks: 275
  • Total Merit Marks: 2025

Important Notes

  • Prelims marks are used only for qualification, not for final ranking.
  • Mains + Interview marks decide final service allocation.
  • Negative marking applies in Prelims only.
  • Candidates must qualify in both language papers to have their merit papers evaluated.

Selection Process

  • Application Shortlisting: Candidates will be shortlisted for written test and/or interview depending on the number of applications and the post applied for.
  • Written Test / Skill Test: Shortlisted candidates may have to appear for a written or skill test relevant to the respective post.
  • Personal Interview: Qualified candidates will attend a personal interview in hybrid mode (online/offline).
  • Document Verification: Original documents for educational qualifications, experience, caste, and other testimonials will be verified.

Job Profile & Responsibilities

Project Technician III

  • Assemble flexible sensor stacks, connectors, and substrates; assist in PCB layout, fabrication, and rework (SMD, reflow).
  • Integrate microcontrollers/SoCs and power systems for on-body monitoring devices.
  • Assist in writing, flashing, and testing low-power firmware for sensor data acquisition.
  • Support app team for device pairing, data packet validation, and UI/UX feedback.
  • Perform sensor characterization, calibration, and EMC/ESD checks; maintain test jigs and fixtures.
  • Maintain logs, calibration records, SOPs, test reports, and technical notes for IP/patent documentation.
  • Support study visits, demonstrations, consenting, and troubleshooting at study sites.
  • Validate signal quality and organize raw datasets for downstream AI analysis.

Data Entry Operator

  • Enter data into project databases as per defined coding standards and formats.
  • Ingest device output files (JSON/Binary) from acquisition gateways and maintain directory structures with proper naming conventions.
  • Run routine checks for completeness, consistency, duplicates, outliers, and quality control.
  • Maintain participant master log, device assignment log, and session logs.
  • Apply de-identification/pseudonymization rules before sharing data for analysis, following ICMR/Institutional ethics.
  • Follow scheduled backup routines and maintain checksum/transfer logs.
  • Prepare import/export templates and assist with batch uploads and dashboard generation.
  • Coordinate with investigators and project team for timely data receipt and reconciliation.

Vacancy Details

Post Name Inspector of Boiler Grade-2
No of Posts 1

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Degree from a recognized university in Mechanical or Production or Power Plant or Metallurgy Engineering or equivalent.
  • Experience: Two years experience in managerial capacity in the design, construction, erection, operation, testing, repair, maintenance or inspection of boilers or in the implementation of the Boiler Act, 1923 (5 of 1923) and rules and regulations framed thereunder.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Rs. 56100 - 177500 (Matrix 12)

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2027)

  • Minimum 21 years completed but not completed 40 years.
  • Relaxation of 5 years in maximum age limit for Scheduled Tribes, so maximum age limit including all relaxations will be 45 years.

Application Fee

  • For Madhya Pradesh native Scheduled Tribe category candidates: Rs. 250/-
  • Additional Portal fee: Rs. 40/- (including GST)

Important Dates

Online Application Start Date 10 February 2026
Online Application Last Date 9 March 2026
Error Correction Period 15 February 2026 to 11 March 2026
Last Date to Submit Documents with Application in Commission Office 17 March 2026

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on interview.
  • If the number of candidates for the advertised post is less than 500, then based on the marks obtained in the qualifying examination, a total of 12 candidates will be invited for interview in the ratio of the total advertised posts 01, provided eligible candidates are available.
  • Full marks for interview are 100 and minimum passing marks are 41.
  • Final selection will be based on the merit of marks obtained in the interview.
  • If the number of candidates for the advertised post is more than 500, a written examination will be conducted.
  • Based on the marks obtained in the written examination, candidates 3 times the advertised posts in different categories/sub-categories and candidates with equal marks will be invited for interview.
  • Final selection will be based on the merit of the sum of marks obtained in written examination and interview.
  • In case of written examination, there will be no minimum passing marks for interview.

General Information / Instructions

  • The date of birth mentioned in the 10th (High School) mark sheet will be valid for age calculation. Therefore, candidates should mention the name, father's name and date of birth as mentioned in the said mark sheet in the online application form.
  • Applications will be accepted only online. Manual or postal applications will not be accepted.
  • Educational qualification and other qualifications like native/local resident, age, caste etc. must be acquired by the last date of online application 9 March 2026.
  • If the applicant applies even without fulfilling the mandatory educational qualifications/other qualifications mentioned in the advertisement and if it comes to the notice of the Commission at any stage that the applicant has applied without fulfilling the mandatory educational qualifications/other qualifications, then the applicant can be debarred from the Commission's examinations.
  • If the candidate gives wrong/false, erroneous information in the online application form in accordance with the advertisement issued by the Commission or makes more than one application, then on coming to the notice of the Commission at any stage of selection, his/her candidature will be canceled and he/she will be debarred from this examination and other examinations / legal action will be taken. The Commission will have full right. If the Commission asks for any document at any stage of the examination, it will be the responsibility of the candidate to provide them. For this, the candidate will not be able to present any court case.
  • The educational qualification / experience / desirable qualification and advertised vacancies reservation classification etc. mentioned for the posts advertised in the published advertisement has been published on the basis of the requisition of the department, in which the Commission has no role. Therefore, the candidates are directed that complaints received in the Commission in this regard will not be accepted. In this regard, the complainant candidates can send their complaint directly to that department.
  • Any amendments / instructions provided by the Government from time to time regarding selection / examination will be included in the selection result and the selection result will be declared. No objection in this regard will be valid.
  • If the Government makes amendments regarding recruitment rules, age, native resident, employment registration reservation, then after issuing amended information as the case may be, the final selection result will be declared in accordance with the instructions issued by the Government from time to time.
  • Even after the publication of the selection result, if any computer error / clerical error comes to notice, the Commission reserves the right to amend the selection result. The list of selected candidates and waiting list and documents of selected candidates will be sent to the concerned departments by the Commission. Appointment process will be done by the concerned departments of the Government. Candidates in the main list / waiting list should not correspond with the Commission regarding appointment.
  • After the recruitment advertisements published by the Commission, many candidates submit unnecessary complaints on factless grounds without any evidence / documents through any medium, such complaints will not be accepted.
  • The final selection result of the said advertisement will be subject to the final court decision of petition no. SLP 8764/2023, WP5596/2024 and other petitions related to OBC reservation. During the period when petitions related to OBC reservation are pending, the examination / selection result will be issued on the basis of main part 87% and provisional part 13% as per letter no. F 07-46/2021/A.P./One dated 29.09.2022 of General Administration Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh.
  • All necessary information, amendments in reference to the advertisement are made available on the Commission's website www.mppsc.mp.gov.in. Therefore, all candidates should regularly visit the Commission's website and take advantage of the available information. No action will be taken by the Commission regarding emails / correspondence / telephone messages received in this reference.
  • The Commission does not maintain educational qualification, caste certificate, native resident certificate and all other documents of the candidates. The Commission only matches the self-attested documents submitted by the candidates with the original documents at the time of interview. All documents of the candidates listed in the final selection result and waiting list are sent to the departments according to the selection list. The work of verification of documents is done by the department before appointment. Therefore, it is not possible to provide information about the candidates' documents by the Commission. Correspondence of any kind in this reference will not be accepted by the Commission. Applications received under the Right to Information in this reference will be transferred to the concerned departments.
  • Any unnecessary inquiries of candidates other than the published recruitment advertisement will not be accepted through any medium.
  • Necessary information and examination results in reference to the advertisement will be published only on the Commission's website www.mppsc.mp.gov.in. Information can be given by email and SMS on the E-mail Address and mobile number given by the candidate while filling the online application form if necessary. Candidates must mention their E-mail Address and mobile number at the marked place on the online application form for necessary information and keep visiting the Commission's website continuously.
  • The Commission's examination and selection system is fair and transparent. There is no possibility of any person defeating this system and benefiting any person. Therefore, if any person claims to benefit directly or through any other means, it is practically impossible. Therefore, do not fall into the trap of such person and immediately provide complete information about that person to the Commission so that appropriate action can be taken against such person. The name and address of the informant will be kept confidential.

How to Apply

  • Applications will be accepted only online from 10 February 2026 to 9 March 2026 on www.mponline.gov.in and www.mppsc.mp.gov.in.
  • After filling the online application and payment, submit the hard copy with documents to the Commission office by 17 March 2026.

ABV-IIITM Gwalior Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Total

Eligibility Criteria

  • Designation: Assistant Professor (Pay Level 10, Rs. 57,700 – 98,200, minimum salary Rs. 70,900; 7th CPC with admissible allowances).
  • Essential Qualification:
    • Ph.D. in the relevant discipline.
    • All candidates must have first class in the preceding degrees, i.e., from graduation (UG) onwards.
    • If “first class” is not mentioned, candidates should have at least 6.5 CGPA/CPI on a 10-point scale or 60% marks in aggregate; conversions given by the Institute/University may be considered.
    • If CGPA/CPI is on a different scale, a certificate by authorized signatory confirming first class or equivalent 10-point scale conversion must be attached.
    • Degrees must be awarded by recognized Universities/Institutes.
    • At least one degree from graduation onward should be from IISc/IITs/IIITs/NITs/IIMs/ISI/IISERs, or the candidate should be working in regular pay scale at one of these institutions; candidates with degrees from high-ranked foreign institutions (QS/World Ranking preferably up to 500) are also eligible.
  • Relevant Experience: None required (fresh Ph.D. holders are eligible).
  • Other Essential Requirements: None specified beyond academic criteria.
  • Additional Desirable Requirements: At least one publication in an SCI journal.
  • Age and Inbreeding:
    • Fresh appointments beyond 35 years in case of Assistant Professor are discouraged, except for candidates with exceptionally brilliant research career and ongoing or approved externally funded research project.
    • Inbreeding is strictly prohibited for three years: applicants should not have been awarded their highest degree (Ph.D.) from ABV-IIITM Gwalior within three years prior to the last date of application.
  • Reservation-related Eligibility:
    • Reserved category candidates must attach category certificates in prescribed Government of India format issued by competent authority not below Tahsildar or First Class Magistrate.
    • OBC-NCL/EWS certificates must be obtained on or after 01/04/2025, and a latest certificate issued after 01/04/2026 must be produced at interview.
    • PwD candidates must have at least 40% disability in specified categories and produce medical certificate in prescribed form.
    • EWS candidates must meet criteria as per Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment instructions.
  • Department-wise Core & Research Specializations (indicative):
    • Information Technology – Core: Information Technology or Computer Science and Engineering. Required Research: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition, Computer Graphics and Multimedia, Quantum Communication and Sensing, Distributed Computing System Design, Security and Cryptography, Theory of Computing, Big Data Analysis.
    • Engineering Sciences – Core: Scientific Computing and Environmental Science. Required Research: Quantum Computing, Machine Learning, Data Science, Generative AI, Environmental Science.
    • Computer Science and Engineering – Core: Computer Science & Engineering or Information Technology. Required Research: Theoretical Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Artificial Intelligence, Augmented and Virtual Reality, Data Science and Big Data Analytics, Ethical and Trustworthy AI, Generative and Agentic AI, Software Engineering, Distributed Algorithms and Systems.
    • Management Studies – Core: Management, AI & Business Intelligence. Required Research: Indian Culture, Business Communication, Ethics and Moral Values, Indian Knowledge System, Entrepreneurship and Innovation, Managerial Economics, Business Intelligence, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, IT-enabled Management, Public Policy, Behavioral Sciences.

  • Assistant Professor positions are in Pay Level 10 as per 7th CPC: Rs. 57,700 – 98,200 with minimum salary of Rs. 70,900.00.

Eligibility Criteria for MP Apex Bank Recruitment 2026

Essential Qualifications:

Selection Process for MP Apex Bank Recruitment 2026

  • Selection will be based on Online Examination conducted by IBPS Mumbai
  • Online Examination will consist of 200 questions for 200 marks with 120 minutes duration
  • Examination subjects include:
    • Computer Knowledge: 40 questions (20 marks) - 20 minutes
    • Reasoning: 40 questions (50 marks) - 25 minutes
    • English Language: 40 questions (40 marks) - 25 minutes
    • General Awareness: 40 questions (40 marks) - 20 minutes
    • Quantitative Aptitude: 40 questions (50 marks) - 30 minutes
  • Question paper will be objective type multiple choice with 5 alternatives in both English and Hindi (except English Language test)
  • Negative marking: 0.25 marks will be deducted for every wrong answer
  • EWS candidates (MP domicile) will get 10% relaxation in cut-off marks
  • Merit list will be prepared based on total marks obtained in online examination
  • Waiting list will be prepared up to minimum 1 and maximum 50% of total vacant posts
  • Validity of merit list: One year from date of result publication
  • Document Verification for shortlisted candidates
  • Medical Examination
  • Final Selection based on consolidated marks of online examination

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates may apply for only ONE district bank and ONE post of their choice
  • Candidates cannot apply for multiple posts; latest application will be considered if applied more than once
  • Reservation procedure as per Government of Madhya Pradesh norms
  • Reserved category candidates can apply for unreserved posts but will not get age/fee relaxation benefits
  • OBC candidates must submit valid certificate (not from Creamy Layer) dated within one year before last date
  • Reservation and age relaxation benefits only for Madhya Pradesh domicile candidates
  • PwBD candidates must have minimum 40% disability to avail benefits
  • Probation period: 12 months (extendable up to 24 months maximum)
  • Minimum service tenure: 5 years from date of appointment
  • Candidates serving in Government/PSU must produce No Objection Certificate at document verification
  • Family members of Board of Directors of respective DCCBs are not eligible to apply
  • Character verification from Police department required within 90 days of joining
  • Medical fitness certificate mandatory before joining
  • Examination centres: Bhopal, Gwalior, Indore, Jabalpur, Sagar, Ujjain, Satna (Madhya Pradesh)
  • Candidates must select 4 examination centre preferences
  • Minimum 10 times applications required for each post to conduct examination
  • For persons with benchmark disabilities using scribe: 20 minutes compensatory time per hour
  • Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are not valid ID proofs
  • Jurisdiction for any litigation: Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh)

How to Apply for MP Apex Bank Recruitment 2026

  • Visit the official website: www.apexbankmp.bank.in
  • Click on "APPLY ONLINE" option
  • For new registration, click "Click here for New Registration"
  • Enter Name, Contact details, and Email ID to generate Provisional Registration Number and Password
  • Login using Provisional Registration Number and Password
  • Fill in the application form with correct details
  • Upload required documents:
    • Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm, 20-50 KB, JPG/JPEG format)
    • Signature with black ink (140×60 pixels, 10-20 KB)
    • Left thumb impression on white paper with black/blue ink (240×240 pixels, 20-50 KB)
    • Handwritten declaration in English on white paper with black ink (800×400 pixels, 50-100 KB)
  • Declaration text: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."

  • Preview the complete application form before final submission
  • Pay the application fee online (Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking/IMPS/Mobile Wallets)
  • Click on "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" button
  • Submit the application and take printout of e-Receipt and application form for future reference

  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Academic Qualifications: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised University or any equivalent qualification recognised as such by the Central Government including Integrated Dual Degree (IDD). Candidates possessing qualifications such as Medical, Engineering, Chartered Accountant, Cost Accountant would also be eligible.
  • Experience: Minimum 2 years' experience as on 31.12.2025 as an officer in any Scheduled Commercial Bank or any Regional Rural Bank as listed in Second Schedule of Reserve Bank of India.
  • Salary Requirement: Candidates having experience in Scheduled Commercial Banks other than Public Sector Banks/Regional Rural Banks shall be drawing minimum annual gross salary of Rs. 9.50 lacs for each year and shall provide documentary evidence for their annual gross salary such as Form-16/Annual Income Statement (AIS)/pay slips for last 24 months or certificate from employer.
  • Local Language: Candidates applying for vacancies of a particular Circle should be proficient (reading, writing and understanding) in any one of the specified opted local language of that Circle.
  • Exclusions: Candidates working with subsidiaries of Scheduled Commercial Banks, candidates working in SBI in clerical/supervisory cadre, employees engaged on contract basis, and candidates who have resigned from officer grade in SBI/Associate Banks will not be eligible to apply.
  • CIBIL Status: Candidates who have defaulted in repayment under any lending arrangement with Banks or NBFCs including credit card dues and have not regularised/repaid their outstanding are not eligible for appointment.
  • Character & Antecedents: Candidates against whom there is/are adverse report regarding character & antecedents, moral turpitude are not eligible to apply for the post.

Salary/Stipend

  • Starting basic pay is Rs. 48,480/- in the scale of 48480-2000/7-62480-2340/2-67160-2680/7-85920 applicable to Junior Management Grade Scale-I plus 2 advance increments.
  • The official will also be eligible for D.A, H.R.A/Lease rental, C.C.A, PF, Contributory Pension Fund i.e., NPS, LFC, Medical Facility etc. and other allowances & perquisites as per rules in force from time to time.

  • Minimum Age: 21 years (candidates must have been born not later than 31.12.2004)
  • Maximum Age: 30 years (candidates must have been born not earlier than 01.01.1996)
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 Years
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (SC/ST): 15 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (OBC): 13 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (Gen/EWS): 10 Years
  • Age Relaxation for Eligible Ex-Servicemen: 5 Years
  • Note: Cumulative age relaxation will not be available either under the above items or in combination with any other items.

Selection Process

  • Phase 1 - Online Examination: Online test will consist of Objective Tests for 120 marks and Descriptive Test for 50 marks. The duration of objective test is 2 hours consisting of 4 Sections - English Language (30 marks, 30 minutes), Banking Knowledge (40 marks, 40 minutes), General Awareness/Economy (30 marks, 30 minutes), and Computer Aptitude (20 marks, 20 minutes). The Descriptive Test (30 minutes) will be a Test of English Language (Letter Writing & Essay) for total 50 marks.
  • Phase 2 - Screening: The Screening Committee will examine whether candidates fulfil the required eligibility criteria of experience and match the job profile submitted by candidates with the job profile of Scale-I Generalist Officer of State Bank of India. Candidates numbering up to 3 times (approx.) of the Circle wise and Category wise vacancies will be called for interview from the top of the merit list.
  • Phase 3 - Interview: Interview will consist of 50 marks. Candidates will have to score minimum qualifying marks in interview to be considered for final selection.
  • Phase 4 - Local Language Proficiency Test: Test of knowledge of specified opted local language will be conducted for provisionally selected candidates before joining the Bank. Candidates who produce 10th or 12th standard mark sheet/certificate evidencing having studied the specified opted local language will not be required to undergo the language test.
  • Final Selection: Final merit list is prepared based on normalization of marks scored in Online Test and Interview with 75:25 weightage respectively. Marks secured by candidates in Online Test (out of 170 marks) are converted to out of 75 marks and Interview scores (out of 50 marks) are converted to out of 25 marks.
  • Note: There will be no penalty for wrong answers marked in Objective Tests. Sectional marks will not be maintained for Online Examination.

General Information/Instructions

  • The candidate will have to apply for vacancy of one Circle only. A candidate applying against vacancy of one Circle will not be eligible to apply against vacancy of any other Circle.
  • Candidature of the applicant will be considered only against the vacancies in the Circle for which he/she has applied/opted. Merit list will be drawn Circle wise and category wise.
  • Selected candidates will be posted in the Circle against whose vacancy they are selected.
  • The selected candidates will not be entitled for Inter-Circle transfer/Corporate Centre Posting/Corporate Centre Establishment Posting/Foreign Posting up to his/her promotion to SMGS-IV Grade OR 12 years of service, whichever is later.
  • On joining, the selected candidates will be designated as "Circle Based Officers" (CBOs) and will be on probation for a period of 6 months from their joining the Bank.
  • The CBOs will be subjected to continuous assessment during probation period for judging their suitability for confirmation.
  • Reservation for Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) candidates is horizontal and will be guided by various guidelines of Government of India. Only those persons with benchmark disabilities (not less than 40% of a specified disability) would be eligible for reservation.
  • OBC category candidates should submit the OBC certificate on format prescribed by Govt. of India, having "Non-Creamy Layer (NCL)" clause issued during period 01.04.2025 to the date of interview.
  • EWS candidates are required to produce 'Income & Asset Certificate' issued based on gross annual income for the Financial Year 2024-25 and valid for the year 2025-26 at the time of interview.
  • Candidates serving in Government/Quasi Government, Public Sector Undertakings including Nationalised Banks/RRBs are required to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from their employer at the time of interview.
  • Bank will arrange pre-examination training (PET) in online mode for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates in consonance with the guidelines issued by Government of India.
  • Outstation candidates called for interview will be reimbursed Railway AC-III fare for the shortest route in India or actual expenses incurred (whichever is lower) from place of residence/posting to Interview venue.
  • Bank reserves right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement can be instituted only in Mumbai and Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • State Bank of India does not endorse, authorize or associate with any external coaching platform, consultancy, individual or digital channel claiming to provide guaranteed selection, influence in recruitment or insider guidance.

How to Apply

  • Candidates can apply online only from 29.01.2026 to 25.02.2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Candidates should have valid email ID and mobile no. which should be kept active till the declaration of final results.
  • Visit Bank's website https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings and open the Online Application Form available under 'Current Openings'.
  • Fill the application carefully. Once the application is filled completely, candidates should submit the data.
  • After ensuring the correctness of the particulars of the application form, candidate should pay fees through the payment gateway integrated with the application.
  • The payment can be made by using debit card/credit card/Internet Banking by providing information as asked on the screen.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, e-receipt and application form will be generated, which may be printed for record.
  • Before applying online, candidates will be required to have a scanned (digital) image of their photograph, signature, left thumb impression, handwritten declaration, and all relevant documents (ID Proof, Date of Birth Proof, Job Profile, Resume, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificate, Form-16, Salary Slip) as per specifications.
  • Candidates should download their call letter (for Online Exam & Interview) by entering their registration number and password/date of birth from the Bank's website. No hard copy of the call letter will be sent by post.
  • Candidates who are called for online exam/interview will be required to bring one photo identity proof such as Passport/Aadhaar/PAN Card/Driving License/Voter's Id Card/Bank Passbook with duly attested Photograph in original as well as a self-attested photocopy thereof.
  • Not more than one application should be submitted by a candidate. In case of multiple applications, only the last valid (completed) application will be retained.
  • Helpdesk: In case of any problem, queries may be made at telephone no. 022-22820427 (between 11:00 AM to 05:00 PM on working days) or lodge their query on http://cgrs.ibps.in. Candidates should mention 'RECRUITMENT OF CIRCLE BASED OFFICERS IN STATE BANK OF INDIA-2026' in the subject.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Academic level 14 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-10,000)
  • Associate Professor/Deputy Librarian: Academic level 13A with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-9,000)
  • Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian: Academic level 10 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 57,700/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.15,600-39,100 with AGP-6,000)
  • All pay scales are as per UGC/NCERT/Government of India norms and will be applicable as amended from time to time
  • Selected candidates will be entitled to other allowances and benefits as per Government of India/NCERT rules applicable from time to time

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • Age of retirement on superannuation will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • The relaxation in age and percentage of marks to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PWD categories is provided in accordance with the UGC/GOI/NCERT rules
  • Persons with Disability (PWD) having disability less than forty percent will not be considered. The disability certificate shall be from a competent medical board constituted by the central or state Government Hospital
  • Such persons should meet the prescribed criteria of physical disability of the respective category as per the Government of India rules

Application Fee

  • UR/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 1000/- (Rupees One thousand only) through online payment mode only
  • Women applicants and applicants belonging to SC/ST/PWD: Exempted from payment of fee
  • No other mode of payment will be accepted other than online payment mode
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances

Selection Process

  • For Assistant Professor Posts: Up to 50 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for the interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates, which should not be less than academic score of 60 (Sixty) in any case. In case of tie of marks at the 50th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • For Professor and Associate Professor Posts: The existing criterion of minimum academic score as per UGC guidelines will be followed subject to the condition up to 10 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates. In case of tie of marks at the 10th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • The Academic score shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview
  • The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the NCERT website
  • The shortlisted candidates will be allowed to appear for the interview only after verification of their eligibility
  • The registration will be provisional as the eligibility of the shortlisted candidate will be verified at the time of Interview from the original documents
  • All Certificates, Degrees and other documents must be produced in original for verification at the time of interview (if shortlisted), failing which the candidate may not be allowed to appear for the interview
  • Final result of the selected candidates will be displayed on NCERT website
  • The Council will not entertain any correspondence with the candidates about their non-selection in the recruitment
  • The decision of the NCERT in all matters relating to selection and allotment of posts/organizations to selected candidates will be final and binding on the candidates

General Information/Instructions

  • National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) is an apex organization for Educational Research, Teacher Training and Development of Curriculum and Instructional material in school education
  • Positions are available at NCERT, New Delhi and at its constituent units located at Ajmer, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Mysuru and Shillong

  • After the required information have been provided, click submit button. However, before clicking "Submit" button, candidate must make sure that no changes are required and the information provided is correct and final. After application is submitted, no changes will be entertained
  • Candidates are required to upload their scanned recent/colour passport size photograph, applicant's signature and all the relevant documents. The candidates have to keep a copy of application with documents for record and the same to be produced at the time of verification of document/interview, if shortlisted
  • In case a candidate wishes to apply for more than one post, he/she should submit separate application online along with the requisite fee for each post applied for. All the online applications should be completed in all respects. Only one application for individual post from one applicant will be accepted

  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage of recruitment process or even after joining, if any information provided by the candidate is found to be false or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria
  • Candidate must indicate his/her caste/category in the appropriate column of the application form (SC, ST, UR, OBC (NCL) & EWS etc). Leaving the caste column blank would not automatically be assumed as an application for un-reserved category and the application will be rejected as incomplete
  • The OBC-Non Creamy Layer candidates will be required to submit a valid caste certificate for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government from a competent authority along with latest Non Creamy Layer certificate and self-declaration that he/she does not belong to the creamy layer as on the closing date of submission of applications
  • The EWS candidates will be required to submit a valid certificate for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government from a competent authority and self declaration
  • Number of vacancies may vary depending upon the actual requirement. NCERT reserves the right not to fill up any or all the posts or cancel the whole process of recruitment without assigning any reason
  • Mere fulfilling the minimum eligibility requirements does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. NCERT reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates to be called for interview
  • The certificates, which are neither in English nor in Hindi, need to be translated preferably to either in English or in Hindi and the same shall be submitted along with the copy of the certificate in local language

  • They will identify distinguishing facts where applicable and prepare briefing notes and written submissions.
  • They will undertake research/study on specific points as briefed by the CIT(DR)/Sr. DR.

  • Screening and selection will be based on the details provided in the on-line application form, hence it is necessary that only accurate, full and correct information is furnished by the applicants. The candidate has to click on the link provided in the e-mail for activation (example:- Registration Number-A000000000) and thereafter the candidate has to login and complete his profile for confirmation of registration.   • Apprenticeship Opportunities:- After registering online the candidate must click on the Apprenticeship Opportunities Tab section for selecting the desired trade in which Apprenticeship Training is being sought.   • Applications received after the expiry of the due date 28.02.2026 shall not be considered for further scrutiny.

  • Assistant Colliery Engineer (Electrical) (CE-06): Degree in Engineering in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics from Government Approved Institute
  • Assistant Colliery Engineer (Mechanical) (CE-06): Degree in Engineering in Mechanical or Mining Machinery from Government Approved institute
  • Assistant Safety Officer (CE-06): Degree in Mining Engineering from Government Approved institute having 2nd class Mines Manager Certificate (Coal)

  • Assistant Colliery Engineer (Mechanical) (CE-06): Minimum 04 years of post-qualification work experience in repair and maintenance of Heavy Earth Moving Machinery. Work experience in large opencast mines is desirable
  • Assistant Safety Officer (CE-06): Minimum 04 years post qualification experience in open cast coal mines. Candidates who have served in a statutory capacity as Safety Officer in opencast coal mines will be desirable
  • Overman Coal (Safety) (CE-04): Minimum 05 years post qualification work experience in Open cast coal Mine. Candidates with experience as Workmen's Inspector will be considered an added advantage
  • Overman Coal (Production) (CE-04): Minimum 05 years post qualification work experience in Open cast coal Mine in statutory capacity as Overman. Experience in greenfield coal mining projects in India shall be considered an added advantage
  • Overman Coal (Blasting) (CE-04): Minimum 05 years post qualification work experience in Open cast coal Mine in statutory capacity as Blasting Overman. Experience in greenfield coal mining projects in India shall be considered an added advantage
  • Overman Coal (Shift) (CE-04): Minimum 05 years post qualification work experience in Open cast coal Mine in statutory capacity as Overman. Experience in greenfield coal mining projects in India shall be considered an added advantage
  • Wherever applicable, candidates have to produce experience certificate as per DGMS approved format

Desirable

  • Work experience in electrical substation for Assistant Colliery Engineer (Electrical)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Educational Qualification: A person who is appointed as Drug Inspector under the Act shall be a person who has a degree in Pharmacy or Pharmaceutical Sciences or Medicine with Specialization in Clinical Pharmacology or Microbiology from a University established in India by law (as per Rule No. 49 of Drug & Cosmetics Rules 1945).

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: The written examination will be objective type consisting of 5 papers of 200 marks each. Each paper will be of 2 hours duration. Total marks for written examination: 1000 marks.
  • Paper-I: Pharmaceutics for Degree in Pharmacy/Pharmaceutical Sciences; General Medicine for Degree in Medicine with specialization (200 marks)
  • Paper-II: Microbiology (200 marks)
  • Paper-III: Pharmacology (200 marks)
  • Paper-IV: Pharmaceutical Chemistry for Pharmacy degree holders; Biochemistry for Medicine degree holders (200 marks)
  • Paper-V: Pharmaceutical Jurisprudence & Ethics (200 marks)
  • Interview: 100 marks
  • Total Marks: 1100 (1000 Written + 100 Interview)
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks:
    • General Category: 40%
    • Backward Class: 36.5%
    • Backward Class (Category-I): 34%
    • SC/ST and Female Category: 32%
    • Primitive Tribal Group: 30%
    • EWS: 40%
  • Syllabus: The syllabus for written examination is available on the Commission's website www.jpsc.gov.in

General Information/Instructions

  • Post Type: Permanent position with 2 years probation period
  • Department: State Drug Control Directorate, Namkum, Ranchi under Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare Department, Government of Jharkhand
  • Reservation Benefit: Reservation benefit will be given only to permanent residents of Jharkhand State. All categories of candidates claiming reservation must submit Local Resident Certificate. Caste/income and asset certificates issued for educational purposes will not be acceptable for determining reservation category.
  • Caste Certificate: SC/ST candidates of Jharkhand State must submit caste certificate issued by competent authority in prescribed format (Form-5/Form-V for ST and Form-4/Form-IV for SC). Central Format caste certificates are not valid for state government services.
  • OBC Certificate: EBC-I and BC-II category candidates must submit caste certificate in prescribed Format-XI/Form-11 (Non-Creamy Layer) issued by competent authority of Jharkhand State. If the validity of Non-Creamy Layer certificate has expired, candidates must submit self-declaration in Form-XV.
  • EWS Certificate: Economically Weaker Section candidates must submit valid and updated Income & Asset Certificate issued by competent authority of Jharkhand State in prescribed format (Annexure-I).
  • Change of Category: Changes in reservation category claimed in online application cannot be made during the recruitment process.
  • Document Verification: Original certificates of all documents mentioned in application must be presented at the time of document verification before interview, otherwise reservation benefit will not be given.
  • NOC Requirement: Government servants must enter details of No Objection Certificate issued by controlling authority in online application, or if NOC is not issued at that time, must indicate "Applied for NOC" and submit original NOC at time of document verification.
  • Misconduct: Candidates found guilty of misconduct including providing false information, suppressing material information, impersonation, using unfair means, submitting fabricated documents, etc. may be disqualified and debarred from examinations as per Jharkhand Competitive Examination (Prevention and Prohibition of Unfair Means in Recruitment) Act, 2023.
  • Pre-examination Training: Information regarding pre-examination training syllabus is available on Commission's website.
  • Commission's Rights: The Commission reserves the right to postpone or cancel the selection process at any time without assigning any reason.
  • Canvassing: Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate.
  • Final Authority: The decision of the Commission regarding eligibility and other matters will be final.

How to Apply

  • Candidates can apply online only through One Time Registration (OTR) System available on JPSC website www.jpsc.gov.in from 29.01.2026 to 18.02.2026 (05:00 PM).
  • Before filling online application, candidates must read "How to Register for OTR" available on Commission's website.
  • Candidates must have valid email ID and mobile number which should be kept active till final result declaration.
  • Upload clear colored passport size photograph and signature at designated places through OTR System. Application will be rejected if photograph and signature are not uploaded.
  • Fill application form in BLOCK LETTERS (except signature).
  • Write name and father's name spelling exactly as mentioned in Matriculation certificate/mark sheet.
  • Enter date of birth as mentioned in Matriculation certificate/mark sheet.
  • Pay examination fee through Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking/Wallet/Bharat QR/UPI via Payment Gateway.
  • After successful submission, login to dashboard and download filled application from "Download Filled Application Section". Take two printouts.
  • Upload required documents in OTR and also send hard copy of online application along with self-attested copies of all required certificates by Registered Post/Speed Post/Hand Delivery to: Examination Controller, Jharkhand Public Service Commission, Circular Road, Ranchi, 834001 by 05.03.2026 (05:00 PM).
  • Write on envelope: Advertisement No. 12/2025, Post Name: Drug Inspector, OTR No., Registration No. in BOLD letters.
  • Applications received through any other medium or after last date will not be accepted.
  • Documents to be submitted (hard copy with original at time of document verification):

    • Intermediate certificate and mark sheet
    • Degree certificate in Pharmacy/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Medicine with specialization
    • Experience certificate as per eligibility criteria
    • Caste certificate (where applicable)
    • Local Resident certificate (where applicable - mandatory for all categories of women and PwBD for horizontal reservation)
    • Disability certificate issued by Medical Board (where applicable)

PSTET 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Nationality & Age Limit

  • Applicants must be citizens of India to be eligible for PSTET 2026.
  • There is no specified minimum or maximum age limit for appearing in PSTET 2026.

Educational Qualification for Paper 1 (Class 1–5)

Candidates who wish to appear in PSTET Paper 1 for primary teacher eligibility must meet the minimum academic and professional qualifications as prescribed by NCTE and mentioned in the detailed PSTET notification

  • Senior Secondary (10+2) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in final year of 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed) or equivalent teacher training programme.
  • Senior Secondary with minimum 45–50% marks and 2-year D.El.Ed or equivalent, in accordance with NCTE regulations.
  • Graduation with 2-year D.El.Ed or Bachelor of Education (B.Ed) as allowed in the official notification

Educational Qualification for Paper 2 (Class 6–8)

For PSTET Paper 2, candidates must have graduation along with prescribed teacher education qualifications for upper primary level.

  • Graduation and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed).
  • Graduation with at least 50% marks and 1-year Bachelor in Education (B.Ed).
  • 4-year integrated B.El.Ed / B.A.B.Ed / B.Sc.B.Ed or equivalent as specified by NCTE and PSTET notification.

Candidates are advised to carefully read the official PSTET 2026 notification PDF for complete and exact combinations of qualifications and relaxations for reserved categories.

PSTET 2026 Application Form

The PSTET 2026 application form is available only in online mode, and no offline forms will be accepted. The direct registration link is active on the PSTET official website for new registration, login and fee payment.

Direct Apply Online Link

  • Main portal: https://pstet2025.org/
  • Register & Apply: RegisterEmailIDwithOTPNew.aspx
  • Official advertisement PDF: adv_pstet2025.pdf

Steps to Apply Online for PSTET 2026

  1. Visit the official website pstet2025.org and click on the link for “PSTET 2026 Online Application”.
  2. Click on “New Registration” and enter your valid email ID and mobile number to generate OTP.
  3. Verify the OTP received on your mobile/email and create login credentials for PSTET 2026 application.
  4. Login using your registered email ID and password and fill in personal details, address, educational qualifications and other required information correctly.
  5. Select the paper(s) you wish to apply for – Paper 1, Paper 2 or both as per your eligibility.
  6. Upload scanned copies of your recent passport size photograph and signature in the prescribed format and size as mentioned in the instructions.
  7. Pay the required application fee online through debit/credit card, net banking or other available payment gateways.
  8. After successful payment, submit the application form and download/print the confirmation page and fee receipt for future use.

A correction window will be activated between 21 and 23 February 2026 to edit limited fields such as name, date of birth, photograph, signature, contact details and exam centre city, as permitted by the portal.

PSTET 2026 Application Fee

The application fee for PSTET 2026 varies according to category and number of papers applied for. The fee is non-refundable and must be paid through online mode only.

Category Only Paper 1 Only Paper 2 Both Paper 1 & 2
General / OBC / Other States ₹ 1100 ₹ 1100 ₹ 2200
SC / ST / PH ₹ 550 ₹ 550 ₹ 1100
Ex-Servicemen Exempted Exempted Exempted

Candidates are advised to check the fee status after payment and ensure that the application form is finally submitted and not left incomplete.

PSTET 2026 Exam Pattern

PSTET 2026 will be conducted as two separate papers – Paper 1 for primary level and Paper 2 for upper primary level. Both papers will consist of multiple-choice questions and will be conducted in offline mode.

PSTET Paper 1 Exam Pattern (Class 1–5)

Subject No. of Questions Marks
Child Development & Pedagogy 30 30
Language I 30 30
Language II 30 30
Mathematics 30 30
Environmental Studies 30 30
Total 150 150

All questions in Paper 1 will be objective type with four options, and each correct answer will carry 1 mark with no negative marking as per the PSTET pattern.

PSTET Paper 2 Exam Pattern (Class 6–8)

Subject No. of Questions Marks
Child Development & Pedagogy 30 30
Language I 30 30
Language II 30 30
Mathematics & Science (for Maths/Science teacher) OR Social Studies (for Social Studies teacher) OR other subject chosen 60 60
Total 150 150

Paper 2 will also be conducted in offline mode and will test subject knowledge along with pedagogy at the upper primary level.

PSTET 2026 Syllabus (Brief)

The detailed PSTET syllabus is provided in the official notification and on the exam portal, covering child development, languages, mathematics, environmental studies and subject-specific content.

  • Child Development & Pedagogy: Concept of development and learning, inclusive education, understanding children with special needs, pedagogy of learning and teaching at elementary level.
  • Language I & II: Proficiency in the chosen language, comprehension passages, language skills, grammar and pedagogy of language development.
  • Mathematics & Environmental Studies (Paper 1): Basic concepts, problem-solving, teaching-learning strategies and pedagogy relevant to primary level.
  • Subject-specific (Paper 2): Content and pedagogy of Mathematics & Science or Social Studies or other applicable subjects for upper primary classes.

Selection Process

  • Applicants will be shortlisted for engagement on the basis of a system-generated merit list.
  • Merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in Secondary School Examination of 10th standard, aggregated to percentage to the accuracy of 4 decimals.
  • For applicants with grades/points only, subject-wise marks will be arrived at by applying a multiplication factor of 9.5.
  • Where Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) is provided, marks will be arrived at by multiplying the CGPA by 9.5.
  • In case of tie among applicants, priority will be decided based on: DOB (older in age), followed by category order: ST trans-woman, ST female, SC trans-woman, SC female, OBC trans-woman, OBC female, EWS trans-woman, EWS female, UR trans-woman, UR female, and so on.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed through SMS and email on registered mobile number and email address.
  • Physical verification of documents will be conducted by the Divisional/Unit Head of the Division/Unit where the post is notified.
  • Upon successful verification, a system-generated 'Offer of provisional engagement' will be issued immediately.
  • Candidates must complete pre-engagement formalities within 30 days from the date of offer of provisional engagement, including prescribed basic training of 3 days and arrangement of accommodation (for BPM posts).
  • Final order of engagement will be issued after receipt of verification reports from issuing authorities and antecedent reports from Police Authorities.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only one registration is permitted per candidate. Multiple or duplicate registrations/applications are strictly prohibited.
  • Candidates are not required to attach/upload any documents along with the application form except recent photograph and signature.
  • Applications submitted without complete data will be rejected.
  • Applicants should enter all details such as name, date of birth, father's name, and mother's name strictly as per the SSC (Class X) marksheet.
  • Applications with blurred or illegible photographs/signatures will be rejected.
  • GDS are not regular employees of the Department/Central Government. Their service conditions are governed by GDS (Conduct and Engagement) Rules, 2020.
  • GDS are required to work for a minimum of four hours and a maximum of five hours a day.
  • GDS cannot be retained beyond 65 years of age.
  • A Sevak should have another source of income besides the allowances paid by the Government for adequate means of livelihood.
  • Candidates selected as BPM are required to arrange accommodation for running the Branch Post Office at their own cost.
  • The Department reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, or revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason.
  • Candidates who have been dismissed/removed/compulsory retired from Government service/Gramin Dak Sevak in the past as a measure of penalty are barred from applying.
  • No person holding an elective office will be considered for engagement.
  • The applicant selected as GDS shall not engage in any activity with any outside agency detrimental to the business or interest of the Post Office/IPPB.
  • Past experience or service of any kind will not be considered for selection.
  • The Department will verify the authenticity of Secondary Level Marksheets through API SETU Portal/Digi Locker if available online.

How to Apply

  • Applications must be submitted in online mode only at https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement
  • Applications received through any other mode will not be entertained.
  • The application process consists of two parts: (A) One-Time Registration (OTR) and (B) Filling of Online Application
  • Candidates must have their own active email ID and mobile number for registration.
  • Once registered, the same mobile number and email ID will not be allowed for further registrations of any other applicant.
  • Before One-Time Registration, keep ready: Mobile Number (to be verified through OTP), Email ID (to be verified through OTP), and information about Board and Year of Passing Matriculation (10th) Examination.
  • For One-Time Registration, click on "Candidate Login/Register" button, then click on "New Candidate Registration".
  • After registration, a registration number will be generated and sent to registered mobile number and email ID.
  • For submitting the application, log in using Registration Number and password.
  • Fill all details in the online application form including Personal Details, Board/Educational Details, Division selection and Post preference.
  • Upload recent photograph (JPG/JPEG format, 30 KB to 100 KB, 320×400 pixels recommended) and signature (JPG/JPEG format, 20 KB to 100 KB, 300×120 pixels recommended).
  • Preview the application before final submission.
  • Make fee payment if applicable before final submission.
  • Candidates can apply for one or more vacant posts in only one selected Division.
  • On selecting the Division, give preferences for eligible posts based on community, age, PwD status, and local languages studied.
  • If shortlisted for more than one post, only the first post in order of preference will be offered and candidature for remaining posts will be forfeited.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the online application well before the closing date and time.
  • The cut-off time for submission is 17:00 hours on 16/02/2026.

  • ME/M. Tech/Equivalent Degree OR
  • Post Graduate Degree in Science/Computer Application or in relevant Domain with 60% or equivalent CGPA OR
  • PhD. in relevant discipline

in  Computer Science and Engineering and aligned branches - AI, data science, cybersecurity, IoT, etc., or Information Security, or Electronics & Communication Engineering or Electrical Engineering

 Age Limit and Relaxation

  • Maximum Age limit: 56 Years
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

Upper Age limit will be as specified against each post

Applicants belonging to reserved category (SC/ST/OBC) / physically challenged/Ex-servicemen could be eligible for relaxations according to the ‘Government of India’ norms.

 Government employees on payscale will be eligible for relaxation in age by 5 years including  other  age relaxations as applicable.

 The cut-off date for ascertaining the age and experience will be Last Date of submission of    application.

Candidates seeking age relaxation need to submit a copy of caste certificate when called for document verification.  

 SSLC/SSC/ISC mark sheet/ certificate and any other valid document will be considered as proof of date of birth.

The Economically Weaker Section’s Certificate should be strictly in the format prescribed by DoPT.  The format is available on the website www.persmin.nic.in

The application of the candidates not meeting the prescribed age criteria will be reject/cancelled without any prior intimation.

Candidates belonging to OBC category (Non creamy layer) should produce the certificate issued in prescribed format.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is charged by C-DAC for applying to this advertisement.

Important Dates

  • Notification Release Date: 01-02-2026
  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 01-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 20-02-2026
  • Interview Dates: Will be communicated via email to shortlisted candidates

Selection Process

  • Candidate should meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the advertisement.  
  • The qualification and experience prescribed, are the minimum requirements and possession of the  same does not automatically make the candidates entitled to be called for written test and / or selection processes. 
  • There will be an initial screening based on the academic records and other parameters declared in  the on-line application and only screened-in candidates will be considered for further selection process. 
  • The management reserves the right to increase/alter the minimum eligibility criteria/cut off  limits, in  the event of the number of applicants are more, for any post(s), at its discretion. 
  • Candidates will be selected on the basis of their academic credentials, experience profile, written   test marks (if any), performance in the interview and such other selection processes/parameters, as adopted and deemed fit by management. e. Mere application and fulfilment of the mentioned qualifications etc., does not entitle a candidate  to be called for written/skill test/ interview.
  • C-DAC may restrict the number of candidates to be  called to participate in interview/selection process to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than that of the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. The  candidates should, therefore, furnish all the qualifications and experience possessed in the relevant field, over and above the minimum qualifications prescribed.  
  • The selection process shall be carried out by the respective C-DAC Centre based on its requirements and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further process.
  • All information submitted in the application will be verified with the original documents at the time  of document verification or at any stage of the recruitment process. If any documents/information provided by the candidate is found to be false or incorrect or Non- conformity with the eligibility criteria, then his/her candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at  any stage of the recruitment and selection process without any prior intimation.
  • The candidature is also liable for rejection at any stage if C-DAC comes across any evidence/knowledge that the qualification, experience and any other particulars indicated in the application/other    forms/formats are not recognized/false misleading and/or amounts to suppression of information/particulars which should have been brought to the notice of C-DAC

How to Apply

  • Before filling the online application form, Candidates should read General Terms and Conditions carefully.
  • Candidate should read all the eligibility parameters and ensure that he/she is eligible for the post before starting to apply online.
  • Candidate should have a valid email id and mobile no. which should remain valid & active till the completion of selection process.
  • While applying online Candidates can click on the ‘Apply’ button provided against each position for which he/she wish to apply.
  • The candidate needs to log in with mobile no. and then fill in the OTP received on the said mobile no.
  • On filling the correct OTP, the applicant will be directed to fill in the application form. In case you have filled in an application in our previous advertisement, the applicant will receive a prefilled editable application.
  • Candidates shall check the prefilled application and submit it, after adding additional details by clicking on ‘Submit’ button.
  • Candidates should scan their photograph in .jpg format (not more than 400 KB) and keep it ready before starting to apply online for uploading.
  • Candidate should upload their resume in PDF format (Not more than 500 KB)
  • A unique application number will be generated by the system, please note this application number for future reference and use. Candidates can take a print of the application form and keep it with them for their own records.
  • No hard copy/printed applications should be sent to C-DAC. Incomplete and defectively filled online forms shall be rejected straightway and no subsequent correspondences will be entertained in this regard.
  • Candidates working in Government/PSUs/Govt. Autonomous bodies should also apply online in advance and print of the application form, duly filled and signed should be forwarded through proper channel to HRD Section, C-DAC, Bangalore.
  • Those who are not forwarding their application through proper channel are required to produce 'No objection certificate (NOC)' from their current employer at the time of interview, if called for, failing which they will not be permitted to attend the interview.
  • Any dispute with regard to selection/recruitment process will be subject to Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Bangalore, Karnataka only.

In case of a tie in age also, the candidate with highest marks in the prescribed educational qualification i.e., SSC, would be considered

  • Selection will be made as per the Service Rules of the High Court for the State of Telangana, 2019 (as amended from time to time).
  • Candidates resorting to bring any influence of any kind will be summarily disqualified.
  • No person who has more than one wife living or who has spouse living, marries in any case, in which such marriage is void by reason of its taking place during the life time of such spouse, shall be eligible for appointment by direct recruitment.
  • No person who has been dismissed from a State or Central Government service or from the service of Central or State Government undertaking or local or other authorities or who has been convicted by a Court of Law for an offence involving moral turpitude shall be eligible for appointment to the post.
  • This appointment shall be covered by the Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS).
  • No information will be sent to the unsuccessful candidates after announcement of the list of provisionally selected candidates.
  • All rights are reserved with the appointing authority to cancel the provisional selection of the candidates if the certificates of the provisionally selected candidates such as eligibility, educational qualification, and social status etc., are found to be in correct at any stage of the recruitment.
  • The prescribed Form of Application can be downloaded from the High Courts' website, viz., https://tshc.gov.in and print the same on a A4 size copy paper for the purpose of filling-in and submission.
  • Help Desk (Help Desk will function on all working days): i. Help Desk Land Line Telephone No.040-23688394. ii. Help Desk Email ID: [email protected]. iii. Working hours of Help Desk Office: From 10.30 A.M to 5.00P.M iv. Lunch Break: 1.30 P.M. to 2.30 P.M.

How to Apply

  • Applications are invited in the proforma application enclosed to this notification
  • The duly filled in applications should be sent by Speed post/ Courier or in person, duly superscribing on envelop as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF DRIVER- 2026", to the Registrar (Recruitment), High Court for the State of Telangana at Hyderabad - 500 066, on or before 28.02.2026 by 05:00 PM (Two separate self-addressed envelopes for communication to the applicant by the High Court, are also required to be submitted along with this application.)
  • Attested (to be attested by a Gazetted Officer) copies of certificates of prescribed academic qualification, such as, marks lists, pass certificate, certificate evidencing date of birth, Valid Driving Licence issued by competent authority substantiating the eligibility criteria as prescribed in this notification, caste certificate and relevant experience certificate
  • One passport size photograph is to be pasted on the application at right top corner. Further the applicants shall include 2 passport size photographs (not to be attested and not to be pasted anywhere on the application) along with the application. All three photographs shall be latest and identical
  • No-objection Certificate from the Employer (if employed anywhere)

They shall produce all the relevant original certificates on the prescribed date. If any candidate fails to produce any of the required certificates, his/her candidature will be rejected without any further correspondence
  • The unsigned, not properly filled and the applications received without necessary enclosures will be summarily rejected and applications received after the due date, for any reasons will not be entertained. Information will be sent to all the eligible applicants about the date, time and venue of Skill Test to be conducted. The information will also be placed in the website of the High Court
