Eligibility Criteria – Telangana High Court Office Subordinate Recruitment 2026

Educational Qualification

  • Candidate must have passed any examination between 7th to 10th class or its equivalent.
  • Candidates having qualification higher than 10th class are not eligible.
  • Applicants must mention any work experience such as cooking, carpentry, plumbing, electrical, painting, etc., as relevant to duties at residences of Judicial Officers.
  • Educational qualification must be possessed as on the date of notification (02.02.2026).

Age Limit (as on 01-07-2026)

  • Minimum age: 18 years.
  • Maximum age: 46 years.

Age Relaxation (as per Telangana State & Subordinate Service Rules)

  • SC / ST / BC / EWS: 5 years.
  • Persons with Disabilities (PWD): 10 years.
  • For candidates working on contract or outsourcing basis in specified judicial/legal services – relaxation as per rules, provided they were within age limit at initial appointment and have at least 2 years of service by date of notification.

Reservation

  • Reservation applicable for SC, ST, BC, EWS, Persons with Disability (40% and above), and Women, as per Government of Telangana orders.
  • Community must be recognized as BC/SC/ST in the State of Telangana as per G.O.Ms references; otherwise, candidate is treated as Open Category.
  • 33 1/3% horizontal reservation for Women will be implemented.
  • Reservation for EWS will be as per relevant G.O.Ms issued by Government of Telangana.

Selection Process – Telangana High Court Office Subordinate 2026

OMR Based Examination & Viva-Voce

  • OMR-based written examination (objective type, multiple choice) – 45 marks.
  • Oral interview (Viva-voce) – 5 marks.
  • Question paper: General Knowledge, 45 questions, 1 mark each, duration 60 minutes.
  • Question paper will be in two languages – English and Telugu.

Minimum Qualifying Marks

  • OC & EWS: 45% in OMR examination.
  • BC: 40% in OMR examination.
  • SC / ST / PH: 35% in OMR examination.

Shortlisting & Weightage

  • Candidates qualified in OMR exam will be shortlisted in 1:3 ratio of notified/available vacancies for certificate verification and viva-voce.
  • Weightage marks will be given to candidates working on contract/outsourcing basis in notified judicial/legal services based on length of service, subject to minimum 2 years of service and securing minimum qualifying marks.

Merit List

  • Merit list will be prepared on the basis of marks secured in OMR examination and viva-voce.
  • In case of tie in total marks, elder candidate in age will be preferred.
  • If tie persists, candidate with higher marks in prescribed educational qualification will be considered.

Application / Examination Fee

  • OC & BC candidates: Rs. 600/- (excluding service charges).
  • SC / ST / EWS / PWD candidates: Rs. 400/- (excluding service charges).
  • Concessional fee of Rs. 400/- for SC/ST is applicable only to communities recognized as SC/ST in Telangana.
  • Fee must be paid online only; once paid, it is non-refundable under any circumstances.

How to Apply Online for Telangana High Court Office Subordinate Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official website of the High Court for the State of Telangana: https://tshc.gov.in.
  2. Click on the recruitment/notifications section and open the link for “Notification No. 101/2026 – Office Subordinate Recruitment”.
  3. Complete Part-A: One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) by entering your basic details to generate OTPR ID and password.
  4. Login using the OTPR ID and password and proceed to Part-B: Application Form for Office Subordinate posts.
  5. Fill in all required details carefully – personal details, educational qualification (7th to 10th class), community, disability (if any), and work experience (cooking, carpentry, plumbing, electrical, painting, etc.).
  6. Upload scanned copies of required certificates/documents in PDF format (as per instructions in the user guide) and recent passport-size photograph and signature, if required.
  7. Pay the applicable online application/examination fee as per your category through the available online payment modes.
  8. Submit the online application and take a printout / save the application and payment receipt for future reference.

Important: Candidates must keep all scanned certificates ready in PDF format before starting the online application. Particulars furnished in the online form will be treated as final, and any wrong information regarding category/caste may forfeit the claim for reservation.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The candidates should have passed MBBS (including completion of Internship) or equivalent degree recognized by MCI/NMC/DCI on or after 01.01.2023 onwards will only be considered.
  • Valid Registration with Telangana State Medical Council (TSMC) is mandatory before joining, if selected.
  • Those who had joined Junior Residency (Non-Academic) at any AIIMS and whose services were terminated on account of unauthorized absence or any other disciplinary/ground, will be ineligible to be considered for these JR (NA) posts even if they otherwise qualify.
  • For all eligible candidates, maximum three terms of Junior Residency (Non-Academic) are allowed (depending upon concerned department assessment and availability of posts).
  • Any AIIMS graduates will be considered to be allotted post on preferential basis.
  • Candidates who have already done three terms of Junior Residency (Non-Academic) either at AIIMS or outside will not be considered.
  • Experience in Army Services, Central Health Services, Private Nursing Homes and Private Practice will be taken as equivalent to Junior Residency (Non-Academic).
  • Relaxation in age shall be as per Government of India norms with maximum permissible relaxation: SC/ST candidates 5 years, OBC candidates 3 years, PWBD (General) 10 years, PWBD (OBC) 13 years, PWBD (SC/ST) 15 years.

Salary/Stipend

  • Junior Resident (Non-Academic) will be in Level-10 of pay matrix under 7th CPC plus usual allowances including NPA.
  • The tenure period for the post is up to six months.

Age Limit 

  • Relaxation in age shall be as per Government of India norms.
  • SC/ST candidates: 5 years relaxation.
  • OBC candidates: 3 years relaxation.
  • Persons with Bench-mark Disabilities (PWBD) General Category: 10 years relaxation.
  • Persons with Bench-mark Disabilities (PWBD) OBC Category: 13 years relaxation.
  • Persons with Bench-mark Disabilities (PWBD) SC/ST Category: 15 years relaxation.

Application Fee

  • General/OBC Category: Rs.1180 (including 18% GST) + transaction charges.
  • EWS Category: Rs.944 (including 18% GST) + transaction charges.
  • SC/ST/PWD Category: No application fees.
  • Women candidate: No application fees.
  • Payment to be made to the following account of AIIMS Bibinagar:
    • Name of the Bank: Bank of Baroda
    • Branch: AIIMS, Bibinagar
    • Name of the Account holder: AIIMS BIBINAGAR
    • Account No: 66120100000006
    • IFSC: BARB0DBCHND

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Advertisement 09-02-2026
Last date for submission of applications 23-02-2026 (Monday) up to 5:00 PM

Selection Process

  • The Junior Residency (Non-Academic) will be provided first to all the AIIMS Bibinagar MBBS graduates who fulfill the eligibility criteria.
  • The merit for AIIMS Bibinagar MBBS graduates will be made on the basis of their aggregate marks in the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd Professional examinations.
  • All Junior Resident posts which remain unfilled after allotment to AIIMS Bibinagar MBBS graduates will be offered to other candidates.
  • The merit order of non-AIIMS Bibinagar MBBS graduates will be on the basis of rank obtained in the INI-CET PG Entrance Examination for January 2026 session.
  • Candidates who have not appeared in INI-CET PG Entrance Examination January 2026 session will be ranked in merit after those who have appeared, and combined merit list will be prepared based on percentage of marks (MBBS or MCI screening exam percentage, as applicable).
  • The interview/counselling will be done strictly by combined merit list; in case of absentee, the next candidate in merit will be considered.
  • PWD candidates will be considered against posts in the category in which they have applied (UR/EWS/SC/ST/OBC) and last posts in the respective category will be offered to PWD candidates, in case PWD candidate is not able to make on his/her own merit, subject to medical fitness certification by duly constituted Board.
  • The number of vacancies indicated against each post/category is provisional and may vary at the time of selection.

General Information/Instructions

  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification and incomplete applications will not be considered and will be rejected.
  • The prescribed qualification is minimum and merely possessing the same does not entitle any candidate for selection.
  • Late applications/ incomplete applications in any respect will be summarily rejected.
  • The appointee shall be on whole time appointment of AIIMS Bibinagar and shall not accept any other assignment, paid or otherwise, and shall not engage in private practice during the period of contract.
  • All Junior Residents will need to work in emergency on rotation as needed and may work in shifts and can be posted at any place in the Institute as per discretion of MS/Dean/Executive Director.
  • The appointees shall be granted leave in accordance with instructions issued by Government of India from time to time and shall not be entitled to benefits like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Seniority, Promotion etc. available to regular Government servants.
  • If an appointee wishes to apply somewhere else or resign within the first 3 months of joining, then he/she will not be issued a No Objection Certificate (NOC) nor any relieving letter or experience certificate.
  • The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law and must abide by rules of conduct and discipline of the Institute.
  • If any information or declaration is found false or if any information is willfully suppressed, the candidate will be liable to be removed from service and action will be taken as deemed fit by Competent Authority.
  • The Competent Authority reserves the right to amend, cancel and change this advertisement as a whole or in part without assigning any reason or giving notice, and all disputes will be subject to jurisdiction of High Court, Hyderabad (Telangana).
  • Candidates working in Govt./Semi-Govt./PSU should apply through proper channel and will not be permitted for examination/interview without No Objection Certificate from the employer.
  • On selection, candidates will be given one month time to join the post at AIIMS Bibinagar and in exceptional situations extension may be granted by the Competent Authority.
  • The appointment can be terminated at any time by either side by giving one month’s notice or by paying one month’s salary without assigning any reason.
  • JR at AIIMS Bibinagar cannot leave/resign before three months of Junior Residency after joining; in case of resignation before this, no working experience certificate will be issued and one month’s notice/pay & allowances will be applicable, with salary for the month of acceptance of resignation forfeited.

How to Apply

  • Candidates have to submit online application form (Google Form) on or before the last date of receipt of applications.
  • The Google Form will be available at www.aiimsbibinagar.edu.in (link: Click here for Google Form application for JR (NA)).
  • For any query, candidates may write to the email [email protected].
  • Candidates shall bring two sets of photocopies along with the originals at the time of counseling/interview for the post of Junior Residents (Non-Academic), including:
    • Date of Birth Certificate
    • SSC and HSSC pass certificates
    • MBBS degree certificate
    • Internship Completion Certificate
    • All marks sheets of MBBS
    • UG Registration certificate
    • Proof of rank of recent January 2026 INICET
    • MCI screening test for registration (FMGE test) and marks obtained in percentage in the MCI screening exam (for Indian citizens having done MBBS outside India)
    • Caste Certificate, if applicable
    • Fee payment receipt
    • Any other relevant certificates of experience etc.
  • Candidates are advised to visit AIIMS Bibinagar website regularly for qualification, reservation, selection procedure, emoluments, date of counseling/interview and other latest details.
  • No separate call letters shall be sent to candidates for appearing in counseling/interview; interview schedule and venue details will be intimated in due course through the official website.

Eligibility Criteria for HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher 2026

1. Educational Qualification

English Teacher (Post Code 26002)

  • M.A. English with 50% marks in Graduation with B.Ed and teaching of English as compulsory subject in B.Ed (B.A B.Ed/B.Com B.Ed/B.Sc B.Ed will be eligible).
  • The applicant must have passed Graduation (including B.Ed) with a minimum of 50% marks and 55% marks in English at Graduation level.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates should have at least 45% marks in Graduation (and 45% marks in B.Ed) and 50% marks in English at Graduation level.

Mathematics Teacher (Post Code 26003)

  • M.A/M.Sc. Mathematics with 50% marks in Graduation with B.Ed and teaching of Mathematics as compulsory subject in B.Ed (B.A-B.Ed/B.Com-B.Ed/B.Sc-B.Ed will be eligible).
  • The applicant must have passed Graduation (including B.Ed) with a minimum of 50% marks and 55% marks in Mathematics at Graduation level.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates should have at least 45% marks in Graduation and 45% marks in B.Ed and 50% marks in Mathematics at Graduation level.

2. Age Limit

The age limit for HPRCA English and Mathematics Teacher Recruitment 2026 is:

  • Minimum Age: 25 years
  • Maximum Age: 45 years
  • Age Calculation Date: As on 21.02.2026 (closing date of ORA)
  • Age Relaxation: There will be no age relaxation to any of the categories.

3. Nationality

Candidates from Himachal Pradesh and other states can apply; however, candidates of reserved categories from other States will be treated as General (UR) category for reservation and fee purposes as per instructions.

Selection Process for HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher 2026

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

  • Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Objective Screening Test of 120 marks of 1½ hours duration or as decided by HPRCA.
  • Objective type screening test with 120 multiple-choice questions (1 mark each).
  • Syllabus:
    • Subject/field up to the level of prescribed essential qualifications.
    • General Knowledge including Himachal Pradesh, Current Affairs, Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi (Matric level).
  • Normalization of scores using Z-Score Method in case of multiple shifts.
  • Document verification for shortlisted candidates.

Note: Minimum qualifying marks: 45% for General category and 40% for SC/ST/OBC/Wards of Freedom Fighters, with possible relaxation by 5% if required as per notification.

Application Fee for HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher 2026

  • Examination Fee: ₹100 for all categories.
  • Processing Fee: ₹700 for all categories.
  • Total Fee: ₹800 per application.
  • Correction Fee: ₹100 (for corrections during the correction window).
  • Payment Mode: Online Payment Gateway using Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking (no other mode accepted).

How to Apply for HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply online for HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official website: https://hprca.hp.gov.in
  2. Register on the portal by using the “Sign Up” option to create username and password.
  3. Complete One Time Registration (OTR) by entering personal, educational, and experience details and uploading photograph, signature and relevant documents.
  4. Update and complete the profile, if required.
  5. View available posts and click on “Apply” for English Teacher or Mathematics Teacher.
  6. Select preferred examination district(s) from the dropdown menu.
  7. Verify auto-filled application details and ensure correctness.
  8. Pay the examination and processing fee through the Online Payment Gateway.
  9. Submit the application and keep a downloaded/printed copy for documentation.

How to Apply

    The Registrar
    Central Sanskrit University
    56-57, Institutional Area, Janakpuri
    New Delhi - 110058
    Latest by 10-03-2026 at 6:00 PM IST by registered post

Candidates can apply in only ONE zone for each post category. However, candidates are free to choose different zones for different post categories. For example, a candidate can apply for LDC in Zone-1 and UDC in Zone-3, but cannot apply for LDC in both Zone-1 and Zone-3.

Selection Process for HP Health Medical Laboratory Technician Gr-II Recruitment 2026

Candidates will be selected through the following stages:

  • Stage 1: Sponsorship from Employment Exchange / Special Cell for PwD
  • Stage 2: Merit based on weightage (Educational Qualification, Disability Percentage, Additional Qualification, etc.)
  • Stage 3: Counseling / Interview / Document Verification

General Instructions for HP Health Medical Laboratory Technician Gr-II Recruitment 2026

  • The candidate shall be eligible for appointment if he/she has passed Matriculation and 10+2 from any school/institution situated within Himachal Pradesh. Provided this condition shall not apply to Bonafide Himachalis.
  • Married daughters/grand-daughters of freedom fighters and Ex-serviceman are entitled for reservation under Ward of Freedom Fighter and Ward of Ex-Serviceman category respectively subject to the final outcome of SLP No. 31435/2016.
  • Eligibility for vacancies in Sub-Category of SPORTSMAN shall be as per the norms framed by department of Youth Services and Sports.
  • The certificate of Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Other Backward Classes should be on parental basis.
  • The candidates belonging to OBC of HP Category must produce OBC certificate(s) on the prescribed format, not more than one year old at the time of documentation.
  • The benefit of reservation under EWS can be availed upon production of an Income and Asset Certificate issued by the Competent Authority.
  • The validity of IRDP/BPL certificate is of six months from the date of its issuance.
  • If in any recruitment year any vacancy earmarked for EWS cannot be filled due to non-availability of suitable candidate, such vacancies shall not be carried forward as backlog.
  • The candidates are required to submit their requisite documents in support of their eligibility at the time of documentation.
  • The candidates are advised to visit the Health Department's official website hphealth.nic.in from time to time for updates.

How to Apply for HP Health Medical Laboratory Technician Gr-II Recruitment 2026

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply by following these steps:

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of HP Health at hphealth.nic.in
  • Step 2: Check for updates on the recruitment section
  • Step 3: Ensure registration with the Special Cell/Employment Exchange for Physically Handicapped
  • Step 4: Wait for sponsorship and intimation for counseling
  • Step 5: Fill in the bio-data form with accurate details
  • Step 6: Attach required documents (Photo, Certificates)
  • Step 7: No fee required
  • Step 8: Submit the form during counseling and keep a copy for reference

  • The candidate shall be eligible for appointment if he/she has passed Matriculation and 10+2 from any school/institution situated within Himachal Pradesh; this condition does not apply to Bonafide Himachalis.
  • Candidates of reserved categories of other States will be treated as General (UR) and the benefit of reservation and fee concession shall not be admissible.
  • Candidates will be admitted to selection process provisionally subject to verification of eligibility at document verification stage; furnishing incorrect information may lead to rejection.

  • Candidates can view available posts on HPRCA portal and click “Apply” for the desired post (Junior Office Assistant (IT) (Job Trainee), Post Code 26001).

The official notification for the Indian Army Agniveer Vacancy 2026 has been released, announcing over 25,000+ (Expected) vacancies across various positions including GD, Tradesman, Technical, Soldier Pharma, and more.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates Should Posses 12TH, 10TH, 8TH Pass 

Class 10th /Matric pass with 45% marks in aggregate of five basic subjects and min 33% marks in each of those five subjects. For boards following grading system, grades commensurate to percentages, as above, will be considered. Indian Gorkhas – Class 10th simple pass.

Note: Candidates who have appeared in class 10th Board Exam and are awaiting declaration of results are also eligible to apply provided they fulfill all other Qualification Required. Such candidates, however, shall only be selected when they produce the original marksheet during the Phase II of recruitment process.

 Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 17 ½ years
  • Maximum Age: 22 years
  • Candidates born between 01 Jul 2005 to 01 Jul 2009 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply.

Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

  • Upper Age limit will be relaxable upto 30 years of age (as on date of joining training) in respect of widows of Defence personnel who have died in harness.
  • Note: Women who are widowed, divorced or legally separated are also eligible provided they do not have any children subject to fulfilling all other eligibility criteria. Widows of Defence Personnel who have died in harness will be eligible to apply for enrolment as Women Military Police. Such widows even with children will be, however, eligible only if they have not remarried.

Physical Standards

  • Height: 162 cms.
  • Chest Expansion: The candidate should be capable of chest expansion of 05 cms.
  • Weight: Weight standards are based on BMI as per the chart below.

  • Tribals of recognized tribal areas.

Note: Domicile and Caste certificate will be considered to determine applicability of height relaxation.

Application Fee

  • Examination Fee: Rs 250/- per application for all categories.
  • Payment Mode: Online (through the website during application).

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 13-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 01-04-2026
  • Online Exam Dates: 01/06/2026 to 15/06/2026 (Tentative)
  • Firm dates for online exam will be announced later on the website.

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

Physical Fitness Test (PFT) (At Rally Site)

  • 1.6 Km Run
    • Group I: Upto 7 Min 45 Secs - Excellent
    • Group II: 7 Min 46 Sec to 8 Min 30 Sec - Good
  • Long Jump: 10 Feet (Need to qualify)
  • High Jump: 3 Feet (Need to qualify)

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Paper Subject Type Marks Duration
Paper I General Studies (GS) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II CSAT (Aptitude Test) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

Paper Subject Marks Nature
Paper A Compulsory Indian Language 300 Qualifying

  • Mains + Interview marks decide final service allocation.

  • Candidate should meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the advertisement.

  • Candidate should read all the eligibility parameters and ensure that he/she is eligible for the post before starting to apply online.

  • While applying online Candidates can click on the ‘Apply’ button provided against each position for which he/she wish to apply.

  • Any dispute with regard to selection/recruitment process will be subject to Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Bangalore, Karnataka only.

  • Applicant should not have been involved in any criminal case, whether convicted or against whom criminal trial proceedings are pending. A declaration in this behalf shall be made by the candidate.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Research Fellow: Rs.45,000/- per month (consolidated pay)
  • Research Assistant: Rs.30,000/- per month (consolidated pay)

Age Limit (as on 01 January 2026)

  • Applicant must not have attained the age of 30 years as on 01.01.2026 (i.e. applicant should not have been born before 02.01.1996).

Important Dates

Notification Date 09 January 2026
Last Date for Submission of Online Application 20 February 2026

Selection Process

  • A Committee of Hon’ble Judges / Board of Governors constituted by the Hon’ble The Chief Justice will select the candidates on the basis of academic record, achievement in co-curricular activities and performance in the Viva-voce.
  • If there are large number of applicants, candidates will be shortlisted for Viva-voce on the basis of academic record and achievement in co-curricular activities.
  • Viva-voce will be conducted only in Chennai and no request for change of venue, date and time will be entertained.

General Information / Instructions

  • Research Fellow / Research Assistants will be ad hoc appointees and their engagement shall be initially for a period of one year on contract basis, extendable for a further period of not exceeding one more year based on performance.
  • The assignment may be discontinued even before completion of one year, without notice.
  • Research Fellow / Research Assistant shall not be treated or deemed to be an employee either in the Madras High Court Service or in the Tamil Nadu State Judicial Academy.
  • Any Research Fellow / Research Assistant intended to leave within one year shall give prior notice of three months.
  • No Research Fellow / Research Assistant shall practice as an Advocate in any Court during the assignment and must inform the Bar Council accordingly.
  • Shall not take up any employment or engagement on full-time or part-time basis during the assignment.
  • The decision of the High Court of Madras in respect of all matters pertaining to this Recruitment Process would be final and binding.
  • Candidates are required to keep visiting the websites of the Tamil Nadu State Judicial Academy[](https://www.Madras High Court.tn.nic.in) / Recruitment Portal of the Madras High Court[](https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in) for latest updates.
  • Any application seeking information regarding the selection under RTI will not be entertained till completion of the process.

How to Apply

  • Applications are invited through online mode only.
  • Applicants must visit https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/recruitment_rf/login and register as new applicants (previous registrations are invalid).
  • Enter details: E-mail ID, Mobile No., Name (as in SSLC or Gazette if changed), Create Password, Retype Password, Captcha Code.
  • After successful registration and OTP activation, login and fill the application in 5 steps: Personal Information (upload photo & signature), Educational Qualification details, Additional information (upload required certificates), Declaration, Confirm details & Submit.
  • Photograph: Recent passport size colour .jpg (20-50 KB, 230x200 pixels), white background, no selfie, no dark glasses/hats.
  • Signature: .jpg (<20 KB, 60x140 pixels).
  • Upload certificates (SSLC, HSC, Degrees/Marksheets, Enrolment, Experience, etc.) below 115 KB each.
  • Once submitted, no changes allowed; take printout of filled application for reference (no need to send physically).

Eligibility Criteria

  • ECHS invites applications from Ex-servicemen and Civilians to be employed as contractual employees on various appointments tenable at Polyclinics under Station Headquarters, Chennai for vacancies from 01 Apr 2026 to 30 Sep 2026.
  • Medical Specialist: MD/MS in speciality concerned/DNB with minimum 3 years’ experience in the subject concerned after Post Graduation.
  • Radiologist: PG degree in the concerned speciality in section A or B of schedule VI of the Central Health Services Regulation 1996 or 5 years’ experience after obtaining Post Graduate Diploma; DMC Registration is a must.
  • Gynaecologist: MD/MS in speciality concerned/DNB with minimum 3 years’ experience in the subject concerned after Post Graduation.
  • Medical Officer: MBBS with minimum 3 years’ experience after Internship; preferable additional qualification in Medicine/Surgery.
  • Lab Assistant: Diploma in Medical Lab Technology (DMLT)/Class-1 Lab Technician course (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ experience in Medical Laboratory.
  • Pharmacist: B Pharmacy or 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry & Biology and Diploma in Pharmacy with minimum 3 years’ experience as a Pharmacist.
  • Radiographer: Diploma/Class-1 Radiographer Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ experience.
  • Physiotherapist: Diploma/Class-1 Physiotherapy Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ experience as a Physiotherapist.
  • Dental Asst/Tech/Hygienist: Diploma in Dental Hygienist Course/Class-1 DH/DORA Course (Armed Forces) with minimum 3 years’ experience as Dental Hygienist in recognised Dental Laboratory/Clinic/Hospital.
  • Officer-in-Charge: Reserved for Retired Defence Officers with minimum 5 years’ experience in health care institution or managerial positions.
  • Clerk & DEO/Clerk, DEO: Graduate/Class-1 Clerical trade (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ experience.
  • IT Network Technician: Diploma/Certificate/Equivalent in IT Networking, Computer application with minimum 2 years’ experience.
  • Driver: Minimum passed Class-8th/Class-1 Driver MT (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ experience as a driver and holding a civil driving license (LMV).
  • Female Attendant: Literate with minimum 5 years’ experience in civil/Army Health institutions.
  • Safaiwala: Literate with minimum 5 years’ service.
  • Chowkidar: Education Class 8th Std or GD Trade (Armed Forces).
  • Peon: Education Class 8th Std or GD Trade (Armed Forces) with minimum 5 years’ service.

Salary/Stipend

  • Medical Specialist, Radiologist, Gynaecologist: Rs 1,30,000/- per month; part time may also apply with gross monthly part time Rs 4670/- per day (four hours), Rs 3500/- per day (three hours), Rs 2330/- per day (two hours).
  • Medical Officer: Rs 95,000/- per month; selected candidates will undergo 10 days On the Job Training (OJT) and obtain a certificate from OIC Polyclinic before signing the contract; OJT will be unpaid but mandatory.
  • Officer-in-Charge: Rs 95,000/- per month with similar OJT requirement as specified.
  • Lab Assistant, Pharmacist, Radiographer, Physiotherapist, Dental Asst/Tech/Hygienist, IT Network Technician: Rs 36,500/- per month.
  • Clerk & DEO/Clerk, DEO: Rs 29,200/- per month; RC vacancy pay scale in lieu of Peon is Rs 21,800/-.
  • Driver: Rs 25,600/- per month.
  • Female Attendant, Safaiwala, Chowkidar, Peon: Rs 21,800/- per month.

Age Limit 

  • Medical Specialist, Radiologist, Gynaecologist: Maximum age limit for employment – 68 years.
  • Medical Officer: Maximum age limit for employment – 66 years.
  • Officer-in-Charge: Maximum age limit for employment – 63 years.
  • Lab Assistant, Pharmacist, Radiographer, Physiotherapist, Dental Asst/Tech/Hygienist: Maximum age limit for employment – 56 years.
  • Clerk & DEO/Clerk, DEO, IT Network Technician, Driver, Female Attendant, Safaiwala, Chowkidar, Peon: Maximum age limit for employment – 53 years.

Application Fee

  • No application fee details are mentioned in the employment notice.

Important Dates

Event Date
Vacancy period 01 Apr 2026 to 30 Sep 2026
Last date for receipt of application (employment notice text) 16 Feb 2026
Last date for receipt of application (newspaper extract) 15 Feb 2026
Date of publication (newspaper) 10 Jan 2026
Interview date & time To be intimated through E-mail/SMS to eligible candidates

Selection Process

  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview through SMS/email; list will also be displayed on the Notice Board.
  • An objective type written test on the relevant subject and practical tests as applicable will be conducted before interview.
  • Only those candidates meeting eligibility criteria and with completed application form, shortlisted by the Board of Officers, will be considered for interview.
  • Candidates will bring all original documents as applicable at the time of interview; no TA/DA will be admissible for attending the interview.
  • Employment of all individuals will be at the discretion of the appointing authority; changes in terms and conditions arising out of unforeseen circumstances may be made without compensation at the discretion of the appointing authority.

General Information/Instructions

  • Employment period for Ex-Servicemen would be 12 months and for others it will be 11 months, renewable for an additional period of one year/till attaining the maximum age, subject to performance and other conditions.
  • Individual application for each post as per format attached and available on www.echs.gov.in (duly affixed with passport size photo) should be submitted along with all supporting documents.
  • The application must reach Station Headquarters ECHS, Fort Saint George, Chennai - 600009 on or before the specified last date duly mentioning “Application for the post of ____” on the top of envelope; incomplete applications will be rejected.
  • Only one application is required to be submitted for a particular post for all Polyclinics.
  • Candidates earlier employed in ECHS whose services were terminated or who had resigned or are blacklisted need not apply; such applications will be rejected.
  • Computer qualified candidates will be given preference.
  • Changes to this notice, if any, will be posted on ECHS website only.
  • Those who have worked in any Empanelled Hospital must have a clear gap of one year between relinquishment of appointment in Empanelled Hospital and joining any ECHS establishment.
  • Anybody found using unfair means or creating a ruckus at the time of interview will be dealt with as per Code of Criminal Procedure Act 1973.

How to Apply

  • Download the application format from www.echs.gov.in or use the format attached with the notice; affix passport size photograph.
  • Fill individual application for each post and attach self-attested photocopies of all supporting documents as listed in the notice.
  • Send the application in duplicate in a sealed envelope duly mentioning “Application for the post of ____” on the top to OIC ECHS Cell, Station Headquarters, Fort Saint George, Chennai - 600009.
  • Ensure that the application reaches on or before the last date mentioned; applications received after the cut-off date will not be accepted.
  • Keep email and mobile number active; eligible candidates will be informed of date and time of interview through email/SMS.

Selection Process

  • Interview: Where applicable, as per CSU procedures
  • Merit-Based Selection: Final selection on merit within each zone

How to Apply

  • Visit the official CSU recruitment portal: https://csu.co.in/adarsh_nt/
  • Register with your email ID and mobile number
  • Fill the online application form with accurate details
  • Select your preferred zone and institution from the available options
  • Choose examination centre (Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, or Chennai)
  • For multiple posts: Apply separately if choosing different post categories or zones, paying individual fees for each
  • Upload required documents (as mentioned in portal)
  • Pay the prescribed application fee online
  • Submit the online application
  • After online submission, send a duly signed hard copy of the application along with self-attested copies of supporting documents to:
    The Registrar
    Central Sanskrit University
    56-57, Institutional Area, Janakpuri
    New Delhi - 110058
    Latest by 10-03-2026 at 6:00 PM IST by registered post
  • Preserve application receipt and printout for future reference

Required Documents (Hard Copy)

  • Duly signed hard copy of online application form
  • Self-attested copies of all supporting documents:
  • • Educational certificates and mark sheets
  • • Experience certificates
  • • Proof of date of birth
  • • Government-issued photo ID proof
  • • Category certificates (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD) if applicable
  • • No Objection Certificate from current employer (if government employee)
  • • NET/SLET/SET certificate (for College Librarian post)
  • Publication list (for applicable posts)

Important Instructions

  • Dual Requirement: Both online submission AND hard copy must reach by specified deadlines. Applications failing either requirement will be rejected
  • Multiple Applications: Candidates can apply for different post categories but only ONE per category per zone. Applying for same post in different zones is NOT allowed for same category
  • Examination Centres: Available at Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, and Chennai. Candidates may choose any centre regardless of zone applied
  • Eligibility Date: Criteria reckoned as on 27-02-2026 (application closing date)
  • Document Verification: Original certificates must be produced at the time of verification/interview
  • Disqualification Grounds:
  • • Incomplete applications
  • • Incorrect/mismatched information
  • • Signature/photograph variations
  • • Non-payment or incorrect fee payment
  • • Late receipt of hard copy (after 10-03-2026)
  • • False/fake certificates
  • • Use of unfair means in examination
  • Employed Candidates: Must submit No Objection Certificate from employer in hard copy at document verification
  • PwBD Candidates: Must inform about required assistance at least 10 days before examination
  • No TA/DA: Candidates bear own travel expenses for examination/interview
  • Merit-Based Selection: Mere fulfillment of qualifications does not guarantee selection
  • CSU reserves right to cancel, modify, or withdraw vacancy at any stage
  • Canvassing in any form leads to automatic disqualification
  • No interim inquiries entertained; updates available only on CSU website
  • Territorial jurisdiction: Delhi High Court for any legal disputes

Zone-wise Recruitment Details

Candidates can apply in only ONE zone for each post category. However, candidates are free to choose different zones for different post categories. For example, a candidate can apply for LDC in Zone-1 and UDC in Zone-3, but cannot apply for LDC in both Zone-1 and Zone-3.

Zone Definition: Zones are designed for institutional stability and continuity. There is no domicile restriction—any candidate can apply to any zone. Selected candidates will be allotted to institutions within their chosen zone based on merit and preference.

Examination Details

  • Scheme of examination and syllabus available at: https://sanskrit.nic.in/uploads/2026_01_05_CSU_NT_Scheme_of_Examination_r.pdf
  • Detailed examination pattern, selection criteria, and interview schedule will be announced on CSU website
  • Candidates advised to regularly visit www.sanskrit.nic.in for updates

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV

  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)

  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

Position Details

Post: Post Doctoral Researcher - FedEx SMART Center (1 Vacancy)

Focus Area: India's Logistics and Air Cargo Ecosystem, Supply Chain Management, and Logistics Policy

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct research on India's logistics and air cargo ecosystem including policy, regulatory, and operational dimensions.
  • Analyze national and international policies governing air cargo, transshipment, and logistics infrastructure.
  • Develop research frameworks on supply chain resilience and optimization.
  • Contribute to research publications and policy briefs.
  • Collaborate with FedEx SMART Center team and research partners.
  • Prepare technical reports and research documentation.
  • Support research data collection and analysis.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification (Essential)

Ph.D. (Doctorate) in any of the following disciplines:

  • Economics
  • International Trade
  • Public Administration
  • Management Studies
  • Logistics
  • Supply Chain Management
  • Ports and Shipping Logistics
  • Transport Planning
  • Civil Engineering
  • Infrastructure Management
  • Operations Research
  • Or any closely related discipline

Special Note: Candidates who have submitted their doctoral thesis or are about to submit and are awaiting defense are also encouraged to apply. However, PhD completion is mandatory by the date of appointment.

Technical & Domain Proficiency Required

  • Strong understanding of India's logistics and air cargo ecosystem including policy, regulatory, and operational dimensions.
  • Ability to analyze national and international policies governing air cargo, transshipment, and logistics infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of supply chain management principles and practices.
  • Research experience in logistics, supply chain, or related field.
  • Proficiency in research methodologies and data analysis.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and technical writing skills.
  • Familiarity with logistics data and analytics tools is a plus.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Research publications in peer-reviewed journals related to logistics, supply chain, or policy.
  • Experience with air cargo industry or port operations.
  • Knowledge of India's policy framework on logistics and infrastructure.
  • Experience with statistical software and data analysis tools (SPSS, R, Python, etc.).
  • Previous research experience in academic or industry setting.
  • Understanding of FedEx operations and global logistics networks (advantageous).

Salary & Compensation

Component Amount
Monthly Salary Rs. 65,000/- to Rs. 1,15,000/-
Salary Basis Based on PhD, experience, and qualifications

Note: The exact salary within the range will be determined based on the candidate's educational background, research experience, publications, and performance during the selection process.

Duration & Nature of Employment

  • Nature: Temporary research position.
  • Initial Duration: 6 months.
  • Extension: Possible based on performance, project funds, research requirements, and centre's needs.
  • Contract-based position with no guarantee of permanent employment.

Selection Process

  • Screening of applications based on CV, qualifications, and research experience.
  • Shortlisting of eligible candidates with strong research background.
  • Technical interview covering research background, logistics/supply chain expertise, knowledge of India's logistics ecosystem, and relevant policies.
  • Presentation of research proposal or previous work may be required.
  • Final selection by the selection committee.

How to Apply

Prepare the following

  • Comprehensive research CV including:
    • PhD completion status and dissertation title.
    • Educational qualifications with dates.
    • Research experience and projects undertaken.
    • List of publications.
    • Conference presentations and research awards.
    • Technical skills and expertise areas.
    • Contact information and references.
  • Research statement (1–2 pages) on:
    • Your research interests in logistics/supply chain.
    • Alignment with FedEx SMART Center's focus.
    • Your perspective on India's air cargo ecosystem.

Documents to Submit

  • Detailed CV (3–4 pages preferred).
  • Research statement (1–2 pages).
  • Copy of PhD completion certificate or thesis submission proof.
  • Copies of published papers / research work (if available).
  • 2–3 reference letters (preferably from academic supervisors).

Submission Method

Send application as a single PDF via email:
Alternatively, apply through the official portal: https://icsrstaff.iitm.ac.in/

Important Instructions

  • PhD must be completed or thesis submitted with defense scheduled before appointment.
  • All information must be accurate and verifiable.
  • Research publications will carry high weightage.
  • Candidates with domain-relevant research experience will be preferred.
  • This is a contract-based position with no permanent employment guarantee.
  • Selected candidate should be able to join immediately or within a specified timeframe.
  • Background verification and medical examination may be conducted.
  • IIT Madras reserves the right to modify/cancel recruitment if required.

Vacancy Details

High Court of Allahabad has announced the recruitment of Special Judicial Magistrates for two districts in Uttar Pradesh. These positions are on a fixed honorarium basis with conveyance allowance. The recruitment is open for Government servants or former Government employees who possess legal qualifications or have extensive experience in legal affairs.

District Vacancy Position
Gonda 1 Special Judicial Magistrate
Jalaun (Orai) 1 Special Judicial Magistrate

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications

  • Status: Must be a Government servant (current or former) OR has held any post under the Government of India/State Government/Union Territory
  • Educational Qualification: Must possess:
    • Law degree (LL.B. from a recognized university), OR
    • Be well-experienced in relation to legal affairs to the satisfaction of the High Court
  • Professional Background: Experience in legal matters, judicial work, or administrative/legal roles under Government is an advantage

Term & Age

  • Term of Office: 4 years from the date of assumption of charge OR attaining the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier
  • Age Limit: No specific upper age limit mentioned, but term ends at age 70
  • Transferability: A candidate appointed for a specific district shall NOT be transferred to any other district under any circumstances

Previous SJM/SMM Experience

  • Ex-SJMs appointed by Government of Uttar Pradesh do NOT need to submit character roll entries
  • Ex-SJMs applying for re-appointment must enclose four best judgments delivered while holding the post of SJM/SMM

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Released 09.02.2026
Application Submission Last Date 13-04-2026
Selection Process Merit-based by High Court
Term of Office 4 Years or Age 70 years

Selection Process

  • Application Scrutiny: All applications are submitted to the respective District Judge who conducts preliminary scrutiny
  • District Judge Review: The District Judge reviews applications and forwards only those he finds fit for the SJM post to the High Court with his remarks
  • High Court Evaluation: The High Court evaluates forwarded applications based on qualifications, experience, and legal expertise
  • Merit-Based Selection: Selection is based on merit, qualifications, Government service record, and experience in legal matters
  • Final Appointment: Appointment is made by the High Court through formal order of the Court

Salary/Remuneration

  • Fixed Honorarium: ₹45,000/- per month (fixed, subject to correction and updation by High Court)
  • Conveyance Allowance: ₹5,000/- per month for official travel and conveyance
  • Total Monthly Remuneration: ₹50,000/- per month (base honorarium + conveyance)
  • Payment: Subject to correction and updation from time to time as per High Court guidelines

How to Apply

Application Preparation

  1. Download the Application Form from the official High Court notification PDF
  2. Fill all columns of the application form in block letters (all columns are compulsory)
  3. Affix a self-attested recent passport-size photograph
  4. Provide complete and accurate information including:
    • Full name, father's name, date of birth
    • Current and permanent residential addresses with PIN codes
    • Email address and mobile number
    • Details of posts held under the Government (designation, pay scale, duration, retirement date)
    • Educational qualifications (High School, Intermediate, Graduation, LL.B., and any other qualifications)

Eligibility Criteria

Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical)

  • Post Graduate Degree in Population Geography / Biostatistics / Demography / Population Studies, or other relevant disciplines, including the integrated PG degrees.

Date 3 February 2026
Date & time of Interview 23 February 2026, at 8:00 AM. (Monday).
online application form by 21 February 2026

Selection Process

  • Walk-in Interview at Department of Community & Family Medicine, Academic Block (MNC building), AIIMS, Gorakhpur. No request for Online will be entertained.
  • Only eligible candidates will be permitted to appear for the interview after document verification.
  • If the number of eligible candidates is large, a written examination may be conducted prior to the interview.

General Information/ Instructions

  • As per the guidelines of ICMR Extramural Research Grant.
  • The number of posts may vary.
  • Successful candidates will normally be engaged on Project Human Resource Positions for a period of 11 months or less, depending upon the tenure of the project and functional requirements. Continuation / extension to engagement of Project Human Resource Positions will be depending up on evaluation of the performance, tenure of the project, availability of funds, functional requirements and approval from the competent authority.
  • The rates of the emoluments / stipend may vary according to the sanction of the funding agency of the project.
  • Cut-off age limit will be as on the last date of application.
  • Age relaxation will be as per ICMR guidelines.
  • Separate application should be submitted for each position. Allotment of project to the successful candidate will be decided by the competent authority at its discretion.
  • No TA/ DA will be paid to attend the interview / personal discussion and candidates have to arrange transport/ accommodation themselves.
  • The persons engaged on human resource project positions will normally be posted at the study site; however, they can be posted to any other sites in the interest of research work.
  • The persons engaged on Project Human Resource Positions shall not have any claim on a regular post in ICMR or AIIMS, Gorakhpur or in any of its institutes or in any other government organizations and their project term with breaks or without breaks in any or multiple projects will not confer any right for further assignment or transfer to any other project or appointment / absorption/ regularization of service in funding agency or in ICMR or AIIMS, Gorakhpur.
  • AIIMS, Gorakhpur reserves the right to terminate the project human resource positions even during the agreed study period without assigning any reason.
  • Candidate must bring his/ her duly filled in application form in the prescribed format with a recent passport size colour photograph along with a detailed bio-data / CV and all relevant documents; duly self- attested; in proof of his/ her educational qualifications [all certificates and marksheets from 10th standard onwards], working experience, age caste and photo id [ Aadhar card/ Indian passport/ PAN card/ Driving License] etc.

How to Apply

  • Eligible candidates must submit the online application form by 21st February 2026 through the following link & report at the interview venue on the scheduled date and time:
  • https://forms.gle/34JJ1oMViiy3wySu6
  • Candidates are also required to bring a printed copy of the submitted application form, a recent passport-sized photograph, and all original certificates for verification on the day of the interview.

Vacancy Details

Post Name Number of Openings
Software Developer 01

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Qualification: B.Tech in computer science (CSE) or electronics and communication engineering (ECE) with a minimum of 55% marks.
  • Desirable Qualification or Experience: Candidates should be language- and framework-agnostic engineers who get things done - the focus is on working fluently across multiple languages (Go, Dart, TypeScript, Python, C/C++, Rust) and picking up tools as needed. Expertise in Go for scalable backend systems is essential - clean architecture, testing, CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes. Strong Flutter skills with an eye for crafting beautiful, polished UIs and smooth user experiences are expected. Hands-on GCP experience including Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, IAM, and Cloud Monitoring is expected. Strong PostgreSQL and PostGIS skills covering query optimization, indexing, and partitioning are required. Experience with Redis, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers is desirable. Proficiency in LLM integration, AI agent orchestration, RAG architectures, and vector databases is highly valued. Embedded systems development is a plus. Candidates must be capable of package-level engineering — authoring libraries, SDKs, and CLI tools. Proficiency with Uber's H3 spatial indexing and geospatial pipelines is expected. Familiarity with Terraform or similar IaC tools is a bonus. Prior experience with urban transportation or mobility-specific projects is a strong advantage.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Rs. 65,000/- per month (TDS as per institute norms)

Age Limit (as on relevant date)

  • 28 Years or less

Important Dates

Event Date
Last Date to Apply 24 February 2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates found suitable will be called for an interview at IIT (BHU) Varanasi.
  • The final selection will be based on interview performance.

General Information/ Instructions

  • Late applications shall not be considered in any case.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be informed to appear in the interview, and any communication regarding shortlisting and/or selection will not be entertained.
  • Interview shall be held at IIT (BHU) Varanasi in online mode, and no TA/DA will be paid to the candidates, if called for interview in physical mode.
  • The selected candidate will be expected to join immediately.
  • The appointment is terminable with one month's notice on either side and does not confer any right for extension and/or re-appointment of the candidate.
  • Duration: 8 months (may be further considered for another 12 months based on satisfactory performance and future tranches of the project grant amount in upcoming financial years).

How to Apply

  • Download the application form from the IIT BHU website.
  • Prepare a single PDF file containing: (i) Filled application form, (ii) Certificates and marksheets (starting from Class 10), (iii) Experience certificates (if any), (iv) Detailed resume, (v) Identity proof (Any one: Aadhaar Card / Passport / Driving License / Voter Identity Card / PAN Card).
  • Email the PDF file to [email protected] within 21 days of the advertisement (Deadline: 24 February 2026).

In this article, you’ll find the RLBCAU Teaching and Non Teaching Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

RLBCAU Various Positions Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Rani Lakshmi Bai Central Agricultural University (RLBCAU)
Post Name Registrar, Dean (College of Veterinary & Animal Science), Assistant Registrar, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor
No of Posts Various Statutory, Teaching and Non-Teaching positions as per advertised tables

RLBCAU Various Positions Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Category Position/Post Total
Statutory Positions Registrar 01
Dean, College of Veterinary & Animal Science 01
Non-Teaching Assistant Registrar (Academic/Establishment) 01
Teaching – Associate Professor Associate Professor 29
Teaching – Assistant Professor Assistant Professor  43

Eligibility Criteria

  • The candidate must be a citizen of India.
  • Applicants must apply separately for each Position/Post with applicable form fee, using the prescribed online application form on the University website.
  • Qualifications for each post (Registrar, Dean, Assistant Registrar, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor) are specified under “Qualifications” and “Teaching Positions” sections, including required degrees, marks, experience and, where applicable, veterinary registration.
  • For Assistant Professor (non-Veterinary disciplines): Master’s degree in relevant discipline with at least 60% marks or equivalent, with evidence of NET (ICAR-ASRB/UGC-CSIR), or Doctorate degree in relevant subject with two published research papers (NAAS rating above 4.0).
  • For Assistant Professor (Veterinary disciplines): Recognized veterinary qualification under Indian Veterinary Council Act 1984, B.V.Sc. & A.H. with at least 55% marks, Master’s degree in relevant Veterinary discipline with at least 60% marks and NET, or Doctorate degree with two NAAS-rated research papers.
  • Associate Professor (non-Veterinary): Doctoral degree in relevant subject including relevant basic sciences, eight years’ experience in relevant subject in specified pay bands, and contributions to research / teaching / extension evidenced by publications and innovations.
  • Associate Professor (Veterinary): Recognized veterinary qualification, B.V.Sc. & A.H. with at least 55% marks, Master’s in relevant Veterinary discipline with at least 55% marks, and other qualifications similar to non-veterinary disciplines (doctorate, experience, publications).
  • Registrar: Master’s degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent; at least 15 years of teaching or administrative experience in specified cadres, or 15 years of administrative experience with eight years as Deputy Registrar or equivalent.
  • Dean, College of Veterinary & Animal Science: Recognized veterinary qualification; B.V.Sc. & A.H. with at least 55% marks; Master’s and Doctorate degrees in relevant Veterinary disciplines; minimum 15 years of teaching/research experience with at least 5 years as Professor or equivalent; outstanding research contributions.
  • Assistant Registrar: Master’s degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade and good academic record; experience as per desirable condition for service in administration/establishment in specified grades is preferred.

Salary/Stipend

  • Statutory Positions (Registrar, Dean): Level 14 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
  • Associate Professor: Level 13A as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
  • Assistant Professor: Level 10A as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
  • Assistant Registrar (Non-Teaching): Level 10 as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix.
  • Higher initial pay may be considered for exceptionally qualified and deserving candidates if recommended by the Selection Committee.

Age Limit 

  • Registrar: Preferably below 57 years as on last date of advertisement; tenure of 5 years or till attaining age of 62 years, whichever is earlier.
  • Dean, College of Veterinary & Animal Science: Preferably below 57 years as on last date of advertisement; tenure of 5 years or till attaining age of superannuation (65 years), whichever is earlier.
  • Assistant Registrar: Preferably below 40 years as on last date of advertisement.
  • Associate Professor (all disciplines): Preferably below 47 years as on last date of advertisement.
  • Assistant Professor (all disciplines): Preferably below 40 years as on last date of advertisement (age may be relaxed as per Section 10 of Recruitment Rules for Teaching Employees).
  • Relaxation of age and experience is available for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD and other categories as per UGC/Government of India norms and Section 10 of Recruitment Rules, with possible additional relaxation for women candidates and employees of specified institutions.

Application Fee

  • Application fee is non-refundable and must be paid through online mode only.
  • General and other candidates: Rs. 1000/- (per application form).
  • SC / ST / PwBD candidates: Rs. 500/-.
  • Women candidates are exempted from payment of prescribed fee.
  • No other means of payment (IPO/money order/DD etc.) will be accepted.

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Notification (Advertisement Dated) 21.01.2026
Date of commencement of online application 22.01.2026, 10.00 AM
Last date for submission of online application 21.02.2026 till 5.00 PM
Last date for receiving printout (hard copy) of online application form with enclosures 28.02.2026 till 5.00 PM

Selection Process

  • Direct recruitment to Statutory, Teaching and Non-Teaching posts will be on the basis of merit through all India advertisement and selection by duly constituted Selection Committees.
  • Screening of applications will be done using post-wise Score-Card Guidelines (Dean, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor) and/or additional criteria decided by the Screening Committee.
  • The ratio of candidates called for interview will generally not exceed 1:20 and not be less than 1:3 for each post, subject to candidates securing at least 60% marks in screening.
  • Weightage of score card and interview will be in the ratio of 70:30 for Associate Professor and above, and 80:20 for Assistant Professor.
  • The University may adopt short-listing criteria such as higher qualifications, experience or desirable qualifications to restrict the number of candidates called for interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicants must apply online through the University website and additionally send hard copies (signed, with all enclosures already uploaded) by Indian postal service to the Registrar within the stipulated time.
  • The envelope of the hard copy must clearly mention “Application for the post ……………….” and “Post Code………”; applications received in any other manner will be rejected.
  • Candidates must pay the non-refundable application fee online and ensure correct contact details (phone number and email) for all communications.
  • In-service applicants and candidates on deputation/Foreign Service must submit applications through proper channel and upload/send No Objection Certificate in the prescribed format within the stipulated time.
  • The crucial date for determining age limit for each Position/Post is the last date of advertisement.
  • The University reserves the right to withdraw, increase or decrease advertised posts; to fix screening criteria; to relax age/qualifications/experience; and to draw reserve panels for future vacancies.
  • Any addendum / corrigendum / updates regarding the recruitment will be posted only on the University website; no separate postal communication will be issued.
  • Reservations and relaxations for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/EWS candidates will be as per Government of India/UGC rules, subject to submission of valid certificates in prescribed formats and dates.

How to Apply

  • Applicants must fill the online application form available on the University website: www.rlbcau.ac.in.

Essential Qualifications (Any one)

  • Master’s degree in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi or English medium and English or Hindi as a compulsory/elective subject at degree level, OR
  • Master’s degree in any subject other than Hindi or English, with Hindi and English as compulsory/elective subjects or either of the two as medium of examination and the other as compulsory/elective subject at degree level, OR
  • Recognized Diploma or Certificate course in translation from Hindi to English and vice versa, OR
  • Two years’ experience of translation work from Hindi to English and vice versa in Central or State Government offices including Government of India undertakings.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Knowledge at Matriculation level of one language other than Hindi listed in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution.
  • Degree or Diploma in translation from Hindi to English and vice versa from a recognized University or equivalent Master’s degree.

Age Limit

  • Assist in effective implementation of the Official Language Policy of Government of India within CIMAP.
  • Translate official correspondence, scientific documents, reports and records from English to Hindi and from Hindi to English.
  • Assist in preparation of reports, returns and compliance documents related to Hindi implementation.
  • Perform any other related duties assigned by higher authorities from time to time.

Paper-II: Descriptive (2 Hours, 300 Marks)

  • Paragraph writing in English and Hindi.
  • Precis writing in English and Hindi.
  • Translation from English to Hindi and from Hindi to English.
  • Standard of questions: Graduation level; medium: English and Hindi.
  • Paper-II will be evaluated only for candidates who secure minimum threshold marks in Paper-I as decided by CIMAP.
  • Final merit list will be prepared based solely on marks obtained in Paper-II.
  • Admit cards for the written examination will be uploaded on CIMAP website only; no separate postal intimation.

Tie-Breaking Rules

  • Candidate with fewer negative marks in Paper-I will be placed higher.
  • If still tied, older candidate (by date of birth) will rank higher.
  • Next, earlier acquisition date of essential qualification will be considered.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Secondary School Examination (SSE) pass certificate of 10th standard with passing marks in Mathematics and English conducted by any recognized Board of School Education by the Government of India, State Governments, or Union Territories in India.
  • The applicant should have studied the local language at least up to 10th Standard from a recognized board. Post-wise local language details are given in Annexure-III.
  • Special provisions apply for engagement in Arunachal Pradesh, Goa, and Sikkim regarding local language requirements.

Essential Qualifications

  • Knowledge of computers
  • Knowledge of cycling
  • Adequate means of livelihood

Desirable

  • Candidates applying for BPM posts must be able to arrange accommodation for running the Branch Post Office at their own cost.
  • Ability to work in rural areas
  • Ability to use smartphones, laptops, or computer devices

Salary/Stipend

GDS are paid emoluments in the form of Time Related Continuity Allowance (TRCA), which carry an annual increase of 3 percent, subject to fulfillment of conditions. They are also entitled to Dearness Allowance on TRCA as declared by the Government of India from time to time.

  • Branch Postmaster (BPM): Rs. 12,000 to Rs. 29,380 per month
  • Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM): Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 24,470 per month
  • Dak Sevak: Rs. 10,000 to Rs. 24,470 per month

Additional Benefits:

  • Dearness Allowance on TRCA
  • GDS Gratuity
  • Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (akin to National Pension System)

Age Limit (as on 16/02/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 40 years
