SC/ST (Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe) 5 years
OBC (Other Backward Classes) 3 years
EWS (Economically Weaker Sections) No relaxation
PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities) 10 years
PwBD + OBC 13 years
PwBD + SC/ST 15 years

Note: Age will be determined as on the last date of submission of applications (16/02/2026).

Application Fee

  • General/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 100 (Rupees One Hundred only)
  • Fee Exemption for: All female applicants, SC/ST applicants, PwBD applicants, and Transwomen applicants

Payment Mode: Online payment through Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking, or UPI

Important: Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Candidates are advised to ensure their eligibility before making fee payment.

Important Dates

Activity Start Date End Date
Notification Date 28/01/2026
Online One-Time Registration 31/01/2026 14/02/2026 (upto 1700 Hrs)
Submission of Online Applications and Fee Payment 02/02/2026 16/02/2026 (upto 1700 Hrs)

Physical Verification of Documents Within 15 days from date of shortlisting
Joining Formalities Within 30 days from offer of provisional engagement
Process of Engagement Closes 30/06/2026

Selection Process

  • Applicants will be shortlisted for engagement on the basis of a system-generated merit list.
  • Merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in Secondary School Examination of 10th standard, aggregated to percentage to the accuracy of 4 decimals.
  • For applicants with grades/points only, subject-wise marks will be arrived at by applying a multiplication factor of 9.5.
  • Where Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) is provided, marks will be arrived at by multiplying the CGPA by 9.5.
  • In case of tie among applicants, priority will be decided based on: DOB (older in age), followed by category order: ST trans-woman, ST female, SC trans-woman, SC female, OBC trans-woman, OBC female, EWS trans-woman, EWS female, UR trans-woman, UR female, and so on.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed through SMS and email on registered mobile number and email address.
  • Physical verification of documents will be conducted by the Divisional/Unit Head of the Division/Unit where the post is notified.
  • Upon successful verification, a system-generated 'Offer of provisional engagement' will be issued immediately.
  • Candidates must complete pre-engagement formalities within 30 days from the date of offer of provisional engagement, including prescribed basic training of 3 days and arrangement of accommodation (for BPM posts).
  • Final order of engagement will be issued after receipt of verification reports from issuing authorities and antecedent reports from Police Authorities.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only one registration is permitted per candidate. Multiple or duplicate registrations/applications are strictly prohibited.
  • Candidates are not required to attach/upload any documents along with the application form except recent photograph and signature.
  • Applications submitted without complete data will be rejected.
  • Applicants should enter all details such as name, date of birth, father's name, and mother's name strictly as per the SSC (Class X) marksheet.
  • Applications with blurred or illegible photographs/signatures will be rejected.
  • GDS are not regular employees of the Department/Central Government. Their service conditions are governed by GDS (Conduct and Engagement) Rules, 2020.
  • GDS are required to work for a minimum of four hours and a maximum of five hours a day.
  • GDS cannot be retained beyond 65 years of age.
  • A Sevak should have another source of income besides the allowances paid by the Government for adequate means of livelihood.
  • Candidates selected as BPM are required to arrange accommodation for running the Branch Post Office at their own cost.
  • The Department reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, or revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason.
  • Candidates who have been dismissed/removed/compulsory retired from Government service/Gramin Dak Sevak in the past as a measure of penalty are barred from applying.
  • No person holding an elective office will be considered for engagement.
  • The applicant selected as GDS shall not engage in any activity with any outside agency detrimental to the business or interest of the Post Office/IPPB.
  • Past experience or service of any kind will not be considered for selection.
  • The Department will verify the authenticity of Secondary Level Marksheets through API SETU Portal/Digi Locker if available online.

How to Apply

  • Applications must be submitted in online mode only at https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement
  • Applications received through any other mode will not be entertained.
  • The application process consists of two parts: (A) One-Time Registration (OTR) and (B) Filling of Online Application
  • Candidates must have their own active email ID and mobile number for registration.
  • Once registered, the same mobile number and email ID will not be allowed for further registrations of any other applicant.
  • Before One-Time Registration, keep ready: Mobile Number (to be verified through OTP), Email ID (to be verified through OTP), and information about Board and Year of Passing Matriculation (10th) Examination.
  • For One-Time Registration, click on "Candidate Login/Register" button, then click on "New Candidate Registration".
  • After registration, a registration number will be generated and sent to registered mobile number and email ID.
  • For submitting the application, log in using Registration Number and password.
  • Fill all details in the online application form including Personal Details, Board/Educational Details, Division selection and Post preference.
  • Upload recent photograph (JPG/JPEG format, 30 KB to 100 KB, 320×400 pixels recommended) and signature (JPG/JPEG format, 20 KB to 100 KB, 300×120 pixels recommended).
  • Preview the application before final submission.
  • Make fee payment if applicable before final submission.
  • Candidates can apply for one or more vacant posts in only one selected Division.
  • On selecting the Division, give preferences for eligible posts based on community, age, PwD status, and local languages studied.
  • If shortlisted for more than one post, only the first post in order of preference will be offered and candidature for remaining posts will be forfeited.
  • Candidates are advised to submit the online application well before the closing date and time.
  • The cut-off time for submission is 17:00 hours on 16/02/2026.

  • It is mandatory to fill all the relevant information such as qualification details, experience details, percentage of marks, email address, contact mobile number, address for correspondence, Aadhar card number/PAN Number etc.

Sector should forward their Applications through proper channel clearly indicating their present grade and present scale of pay separately or NOC should be submitted at the time of interview, in case selected, failing which their candidature will be rejected.

Advertisement

The advertisement does not mention the exact number of posts or category-wise breakup (UR, SC, ST, OBC, EWS, etc.) for Hindi Officer or Multi Tasking Staff. Vacancies are filled based on merit and requirements.

Eligibility Criteria

Hindi Officer (Post Code - A)

  • Essential Qualification:
    • Master's degree from a recognized university in Hindi with English as compulsory/optional subject at graduation level (or equivalent combinations where Hindi/English is medium/compulsory/optional at graduation/post-graduation).
    • Plus 3 years experience in terminology work (translation of technical/scientific literature English ↔ Hindi) or teaching/research in Hindi/English in Central/State Govt, Autonomous bodies, Universities, or recognized institutions.
  • Desirable Qualification: Experience in conducting Hindi classes/workshops; administrative experience.
  • Job Responsibilities: Ensure compliance with Official Language Policy/Rajbhasha Act 1963 and related rules/orders in CSIR-CDRI; any other duties assigned by superiors.

Multi Tasking Staff (Post Code - B)

  • Essential Qualification: Matriculation (10th) or equivalent pass OR ITI pass (specific requirements may apply as per post).
  • Desirable Qualification: Intermediate (12th) pass.
  • Job Responsibilities (Multi-faceted non-technical duties):
    1. Office upkeep and assistance: Physical maintenance of records/files/registers, general cleaning, arranging furniture/equipment, opening/closing office on time.
    2. Filing and document handling: Moving files/documents between sections, assisting in filing, photocopying, faxing, scanning.
    3. Distribution and correspondence: Distributing internal/external dak/mail, sending parcels/letters as directed, assisting at reception.
    4. Equipment/utility tasks: Operating simple machines (photocopier/fax), assisting in equipment maintenance, proper use/storage of stationery.
    5. Assistance to officers/staff: Serving water/tea during meetings/office hours, helping seniors with daily tasks, assisting in official meetings/workshops/conferences.
    6. Other assigned duties: Any tasks within the general nature of MTS role.
  • General duties: Filing, photocopying, data entry, record maintenance/updation, handling mail/documents, general cleaning, carrying files within building, non-clerical tasks.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Hindi Officer (Group A, Gazetted): Pay Level-10 (Cell-1), Pay Scale ₹56,100 – 1,77,500; Approx. gross emoluments ₹97,452/- (including HRA, TA, DA for Class 'Y' city).
  • Multi Tasking Staff (Non-Technical Group 'C'): Pay Level-1 (Cell-1), Pay Scale ₹18,000 – 56,900; Approx. gross emoluments ₹35,393/- (including allowances).

Age Limit (as on 16 February 2026)

  • Hindi Officer: Not exceeding 35 years.
  • Multi Tasking Staff: Not exceeding 25 years.
  • Relaxations:
    • SC/ST: 5 years (where posts reserved).
    • OBC: 3 years (where posts reserved).
    • PwBD (UR): 10 years; PwBD (SC/ST): 15 years; PwBD (OBC): 13 years.
    • Ex-Servicemen: Service rendered + 3 years.
    • Widows/Divorced women/judicially separated women (not remarried): Up to 35 years (higher for reserved categories).
    • CSIR/Govt employees: Up to 40 years (general); 45 years (SC/ST).
    • Other relaxations as per GoI/DoPT/CSIR rules.
  • Minimum age to apply: 18 years.

Application Fee

  • Unreserved (UR), EWS, OBC: ₹500/- (online via Debit/Credit Card/Net Banking).
  • Women / SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen / CSIR Departmental Candidates: Exempted (Nil).

Important Dates

  • Online application start date and time: 12 January 2026, 10:00 AM
  • Last date and time for online submission: 16 February 2026, 05:30 PM (website link deactivates thereafter)

Selection Process

Hindi Officer

  • Written Examination (Objective, 300 marks, 2 hours, Hindi medium, 1/3 negative marking for wrong answers) + Interview (100 marks); Weightage 75:25.
  • Top 12 unreserved candidates (minimum 50% in written) called for interview in Lucknow.
  • Syllabus: Official Language Policy, Constitutional provisions, Presidential Orders-1960, Rajbhasha Sankalp-1968, Hindi literature/history/development, grammar/spelling, translation (Hindi↔English, technical/scientific), IT tools in Hindi, e-Governance in Hindi, general knowledge related to Hindi.

Multi Tasking Staff

  • Trade Test (qualifying) → Competitive Written Examination (CWE) – OMR/CBT based, objective, 150 questions, 450 marks (3 marks per correct), 2 hours, Class X level, bilingual (except English section), 1 mark negative for wrong answers.
  • Subjects:
    • General Intelligence & Reasoning: 25 questions (75 marks)
    • Numerical Aptitude: 25 questions (75 marks)
    • General Awareness: 50 questions (150 marks)
    • English Language: 50 questions (150 marks)
  • Final merit list based on CWE marks.

General Information / Instructions

  • Women candidates are encouraged to apply (focus on gender balance).
  • Age/qualification/category claims as on 16 February 2026.
  • Upload scanned photo, signature, certificates (caste/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD in prescribed format).
  • False claims lead to disqualification/legal action.
  • No hard copy of application to be sent.

How to Apply

  • Apply online only via the link: https://cdri.res.in (access provided in advertisement).
  • Fill form, upload documents, pay fee (if applicable).
  • Submit before deadline; keep printout for reference.

Position Details

Position 1: Research Associate

Project Title

"HyWats" - Hybrid Non-Sewered Wastewater Treatment System for Safe Discharge and Reuse (BRICS STI Framework Programme)

Project Overview

This project aims to design, develop, and demonstrate wastewater treatment and recovery systems at pilot scale with an objective to deliver recycled water without micropollutants and emerging contaminants.

Position Details

Position Title Research Associate
Position Code Position 1
Number of Posts 1
Project Duration 6 months
Funding Agency Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India
Fellowship/Salary As per DST norms

Eligibility Criteria - Position 1

  • Educational Qualification: PhD (Doctor of Philosophy) in relevant field
  • Specialization/Experience Required: Experience in any of the following areas: Electrochemical systems, Bioelectrochemical systems, Algal Biorefinery, Constructed wetlands

Position 2: Research Assistant

Project Title

Global Sanitation Graduate School (GSGS) - Regional Hub India

Project Overview

Hosting the GSGS Regional Hub India Annual Conclave/Workshop and managing GSGS Hub-to-hub exchange and alumni engagement activities. This position involves collaboration with international sanitation research networks.

Position Details

Position Title Research Assistant
Position Code Position 2
Number of Posts 1
Project Duration 24 months (2 years)
Funding Agency CEPT under Global Sanitation Graduate School
Fellowship Amount ₹30,000 - ₹35,000 per month

  • Educational Qualification: Minimum Bachelor's degree (Graduate)
  • Experience Required: Research experience in the field of wastewater treatment and non-sewered sanitation
  • Additional Skills: Good communication, event management, coordination abilities beneficial

Position 3: Project Fellow

Project Title

"Characterization and Sustainable Recovery of Metals from Low-Grade Ores via Leaching and Bioleaching within a Circular Economy Framework"

Project Overview

This project aims to develop a sustainable, closed-loop process for recovering manganese and other valuable metals from low-grade ferruginous ores and mine waste through a combination of chemical leaching, bioleaching using native microorganisms, and hybrid chemical-biological approaches.

Position Details

Position Title Project Fellow
Position Code Position 3
Number of Posts 1
Project Duration 36 months (3 years)
Funding Agency Ministry of Mines, Government of India
Fellowship Amount ₹25,000 - ₹35,000 per month (approximately, as per Ministry of Mines norms)

Eligibility Criteria - Position 3

  • Educational Qualification: Master's degree (M.Sc) in Biological Sciences, Biotechnology, or related fields
  • Subject Requirements: Background in microbiology, bioprocesses, or environmental biotechnology preferred

Position 4: Project Fellow

Project Title

"SOIL" - Sustainable Sanitation for Off-grid Integrated Loops: Integrated Treatment and Recovery of Water and Nutrients

Project Overview

This project aims to demonstrate financially affordable and simple-to-operate decentralized sanitation treatment technologies that will produce high-quality effluent for safe disposal or agricultural reuse, thereby alleviating pressure on limited water resources.

Position Details

Position Title Project Fellow
Position Code Position 4
Number of Posts 1
Project Duration 12 months (1 year)
Funding Agency Kakatiya Grassroot Innovation Projects (K-GRIP), launched by Kakatiya Center for Rural Innovation, Technology, and Impact (KRITI) at BITS Pilani
Fellowship Amount ₹25,000 - ₹35,000 per month
Special Feature Project Fellows appointed under K-GRIP may be considered for enrollment into the PhD program, subject to eligibility and institute norms

Eligibility Criteria - Position 4

  • Educational Qualification: Master's degree (M.Sc) in Biological Sciences, Biotechnology, or related fields
  • Subject Requirements: Background in microbiology, environmental science, or biotechnology preferred

PhD Pathway Opportunity

Candidates selected for Position 4 (SOIL Project) may be considered for enrollment into BITS Pilani's PhD program, subject to meeting the institute's eligibility criteria and requirements. This offers an excellent opportunity for career advancement and advanced research credentials.

  1. Prepare your application materials including: CV (Curriculum Vitae), Cover letter mentioning the position applied for, Education certificates, Experience certificates (if any)
  2. Send your complete application via email to: [email protected]
  3. Email Subject Line: "Application for [Position Name] - [Your Full Name]" (e.g., "Application for Research Associate - John Doe")
  4. Application Deadline: 20th February 2026
  5. Selection Process: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for online interviews in the last week of February 2026

Selection Process

  1. Application Screening: All applications will be screened based on eligibility criteria and experience
  2. Shortlisting: Only qualified candidates meeting the position requirements will be shortlisted
  3. Online Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for online interviews (tentatively last week of February 2026)
  4. Final Selection: Final selection based on interview performance and overall suitability
  5. Offer Letter: Selected candidates will receive offer letters with appointment terms

Written Test Date To be notified
Document Verification To be notified
Group Discussion/Interview To be notified

Selection Process

  • The selection process will consist of Written Test, Document Verification, Group Discussion/Interview
  • Stage 1 - Written Test: The Written Test will normally consist of 25% General Aptitude and 75% subject/trade related questions. Candidates need to secure minimum 40% marks for General/EWS category and 35% marks for SC/ST/PwBD/OBC category to qualify for the subsequent stage of selection. The written test may be conducted through Computer based Test (CBT) or Pen Paper based Test (PBT)
  • Stage 2 - Document Verification: A category-wise list will be drawn of the candidates who qualify the written test. In case of large response, candidates in the ratio of 1:5 based on the performance in the written test shall be called for the Document Verification followed by Group Discussion/Interview. These candidates shall produce all the relevant documents in original at the time of Document Verification
  • Candidature of a candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage of the recruitment process or after recruitment or joining, if any information provided by the candidate is found to be false or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement
  • Stage 3 - Group Discussion/Interview: The candidates, who clear the Document Verification round, shall only be eligible for the Group Discussion/Interview. Candidates need to secure minimum 40% marks for General/EWS and 35% marks for SC/ST/PwBD/OBC to qualify
  • Final Grading: On completion of written test, group discussion/Interview, the weightage of final grading marks will be: Written Test - 85%, Group Discussion/Interview - 15%, Total - 100%

  • The vacancies advertised will be filled through the candidates sponsored from Local Employment Exchange (Stage-I). Any further, unfilled vacancies will be filled through open advertisement (Stage-II)
  • Posts are purely on contract basis, initially for a period of 02 years. It may further be extended for maximum up to 1 year depending upon the requirement of the organisation and the performance of the individual
  • It is NOT against a regular post, but on contract basis only. The contract will stand automatically terminated at the end of the period, unless intimated otherwise in writing
  • GSL does not provide any assurance for regular employment on completion of contract tenure
  • Candidates from reserved category fulfilling eligibility criteria may also apply for the posts earmarked for UR as per Government Rules. Such candidates applying for a post where there are no vacancies in their respective reserved categories will be treated as General candidates and no relaxation in any criteria will be applicable to these candidates
  • If the SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD certificate has been issued in a language other than English/Hindi, the candidates will be required to submit a self-certified translated copy of the same either in English or Hindi

  • Concessions and relaxations will be granted to PwBD candidates applying against the said posts. Their candidature will be considered as per Government guidelines in vogue
  • The disability condition falling under the category "Likely to improve" under temporary disability category are not eligible for reservation. Further the condition i.e. "progressive, non-progressive or not likely to improve" will be treated eligible for reservation
  • Candidates are advised to make sure that they are meeting the eligibility requirements as per the vacancy notification for the posts before submitting the applications
  • Mere fulfilment of qualifications and other requirements as applicable for the respective post does not entitle a candidate to be called for selection process
  • Management reserves the right to fill or not to fill the post/s and also to fill up future vacancies, if any, from the valid panel of selected candidates as per the rules of the company
  • GSL Management in its sole discretion reserves the right to increase/reduce the number of vacancies notified. In case sufficient candidates have not applied or sufficient candidates are not provisionally shortlisted after scrutiny, GSL management reserves the right to cancel the Selection Process
  • Interim enquiries will not be entertained

  • Management reserves the right to raise the eligibility criteria for short listing the applications

  • Management reserves the right to reject the candidature if it is found that false or fabricated information is furnished in the application. The selection of any candidate is liable to be cancelled even after his/her selection on confirming that any information submitted by the candidate is false/fabricated
  • Management reserves the right to cancel the advertisement and/or the selection process thereto without assigning any reason
  • Corrigendum, if any, will be uploaded on the website only. Candidates are requested to check website (www.goashipyard.in) regularly under the heading "Notice Board - Careers - Advertisement"
  • Management will not be responsible for non receipt of email and loss of their Email ID and password

  • The above advertisement is applicable to candidates from Local Employment Exchange (Stage-I)

How to Apply

Selection Process for GSSC Primary School Teacher 2026

The selection process consists of THREE stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test - I (CBT-I) - Screening/Shortlisting

For Marathi Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 20
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Konkani Language 10
Test of Marathi Language 10
TOTAL 60 Marks

Duration: 75 minutes (100 minutes for PwD candidates with compensatory time)

For Konkani Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 20
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Konkani Language 20
TOTAL 60 Marks

Duration: 75 minutes (100 minutes for PwD candidates with compensatory time)

Minimum Passing Marks (CBT-I):

  • Unreserved (UR) candidates: 45%
  • OBC/PwD candidates: 40%
  • SC/ST candidates: 35%

Konkani Language Test (Mandatory):

  • Marathi Medium: Minimum 4 marks out of 10 required in Konkani test (mandatory for merit consideration)
  • Konkani Medium: Minimum 8 marks out of 20 required in Konkani test (mandatory for merit consideration)
  • Konkani language questions will appear in the first 10/20 questions
  • Only candidates securing minimum qualifying marks in Konkani will be evaluated for merit list

Shortlisting for CBT-II: 3.5 times the number of posts in each category/sub-category based on CBT-I merit

Stage 2: Computer Based Test - II (CBT-II)

For Marathi Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 10
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Marathi Language (including basic grammar) 40
Test of Methodology/Education Pedagogy 10
TOTAL 80 Marks

Duration: 100 minutes (135 minutes for PwD candidates with compensatory time of 35 minutes)

For Konkani Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 10
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Konkani Language (including basic grammar) 40
Test of Methodology/Education Pedagogy 10
TOTAL 80 Marks

Duration: 100 minutes (135 minutes for PwD candidates with compensatory time of 35 minutes)

Shortlisting for Class Demonstration: Twice the number of candidates in each category/sub-category based on CBT-II merit

Stage 3: Class Demonstration - 10 Marks

  • Candidates will be asked to demonstrate on a particular concept of the post for which they have been shortlisted
  • Shortlisted based on CBT-II performance
  • Carries 10 marks

Final Merit & Selection

  • Combined Score: CBT-II marks + Class Demonstration marks
  • Common merit list prepared in descending order of Combined Score
  • Selection process as per Government of Goa O.M. No.1/6/83-PER(Vol.II)Pt.(a)/143 dated 14.01.2019
  • In case of tie (equal marks): Candidate born earlier gets precedence
  • Wait list will also be prepared for each post in descending order of merit

Selection Process (Category-wise):

  1. First: PwD/Ex-Servicemen/Meritorious Sportspersons candidates shortlisted on merit and adjusted against their vertical category (UR/ST/SC/OBC/EWS)
  2. Second: Unreserved (UR) category candidates shortlisted in descending order
  3. Third: Reserved category candidates (who didn't avail age relaxation/concessions except fee) adjusted against UR if eligible on merit
  4. Fourth: Reserved category candidates (OBC/SC/ST/EWS) shortlisted separately in descending order

Important Selection Notes:

  • No Negative Marking in CBT examinations
  • CBT-I is only for screening/shortlisting (marks not counted for final merit)
  • Question type: Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
  • Compensatory time for PwD: 25 minutes for CBT-I (60 marks), 35 minutes for CBT-II (80 marks)
  • If PwD/Meritorious Sportspersons not available in their reserved category, vacancies deducted from unreserved
  • If Ex-Servicemen not available, vacancies filled by meritorious candidates
  • If reserved category candidates not available, vacancies remain unfilled

If any major or minor penalty has been imposed on the applicant during the last 10 years, the disciplinary case leading to such penalty along with necessary documents may be sent by the forwarding authority along with the application.
  • Vigilance report is to be furnished in the format prescribed, vide Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterway's letter No.A-12023/2/2021-PE-1 dated 20.1.2021, copy of which is attached as Annexure-III.
  • As per the Ministry's guidelines dated 26.09.2019 regarding filling up the HOD level posts in Major Port Authorities, Port official, who withdraws his/her candidature for the post after his/her selection by the Services Selection Committee, will be liable for debarment from future selection to HOD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for a period of two years. Incomplete applications or applications not made following the stated procedure or received after due date will not be considered.

How to Apply

  • Applications are invited from eligible and willing Officers of all the Major Port Authorities possessing the prescribed qualifications, experience and other conditions, for the post of Secretary in the pay scale of Rs.100000-260000 as per Annexure-I. The application may be submitted through "Online Application Portal" (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways website https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in from 13.02.2026 to 14.03.2026. No application other than OAP shall be accepted.
  • The candidate will have to submit the printout of application form already uploaded in OAP to his administrative Port for onward forwarding. The administrative Ports are required to forward the applications of the candidates alongwith the following documents on or before 30.03.2026 superscribing "Application for the post of Secretary (HOD) in Mormugao Port Authority".
  • (i) Certified copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years (2020-21 to 2024-25), duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD on each of the pages.
  • (ii) A statement showing year-wise availability of ACRs/APARs and grading duly signed by the Dy. Chairperson/Chairperson as per the Ministry's letter dated 01.02.2007. If ACR/APAR for a particular year during the last 5 years period is pending/not available, "No Report Certificate" may be furnished alongwith ACRs/APARs of the preceding years.
  • (iii) Attested photocopies of all certificates and proof of educational qualification, present and past work experience in the respective post and pay scale.
  • (iv) No objection certificate from the respective Port.
  • (v) Certificate by the Head of the Office of the applicant (Annexure-II).
  • (vi) An undertaking of the applicant to the effect that candidature will not be withdrawn, if selected by Services Selection Committee.
  • (vii) Vigilance and Administrative clearance of the concerned Port, as per enclosed proforma (Annexure-III)
  • (viii) The veracity of the professional certificates and caste certificate provided in terms of letter no.A-12022/10/2005-PE-I dated 27.8.2010 by the applicant may be ensured and certified.
  • (ix) Two recent passport size colour photographs in a sealed envelope.

  • For Pay Level 04 (Group C), the selection will be based on the written test, as per recruitment rules. Written test means Written Test / Computer Based Test and/or Trade Test and/or any other mode of test, as deemed fit.
  • The online applications received in response to this advertisement shall be scrutinized as per the eligibility criteria detailed in the advertisement.   2. Applicants are advised to satisfy themselves before applying that they possess the minimum essential qualification and experience (if any) laid down in the advertisement. Applicants possessing the requisite qualification and experience may apply online only. The applicants shall upload all the relevant documents in the application portal in support of his/her candidature. Applicants should ensure that they have requisite qualification from a Board / University/ Institute recognized by UGC/AICTE. Certificates of experience in the relevant field, (from the present employment to the first employment) should be in proper format i.e. it should be on the organization's letterhead, bearing the date of issue, specific period of work, salary, name and designation of the issuing authority along with their signature and stamp. There is no need to send the hard copy of the application. The online applications without uploading photographs/documentary evidence(s) will be treated as incomplete and such applications will be summarily rejected.
  3. Applicants desirous to apply for more than one post should apply for each post separately along with payment of application fee for each post.
  4. Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) can apply to the post(s) that are not reserved for PwBD. The Institute strives to have a workforce, which reflects gender balance, and women applicants are encouraged to apply.

  6. Eligibility of applicants for the post applied shall be considered as on the last date of application.
  7. For availing the benefit under reserved category, the applicant must upload in the application portal, Category Certificate (as per the prescribed proforma of the Government of India) issued by the Competent Authority.
  8. Application fee (non-refundable) should be paid for each post separately as detailed below. No fee will be charged from SC/ST, PwBD & Female applicants.
  9. Persons employed in Government/Semi Government Organizations/Autonomous Bodies/ PSU etc. should process their application through proper channel and submit No Objection Certificate (NOC) with vigilance clearance. Those who are unable to process their application through proper channel may submit 'No Objection Certificate (NOC)' mentioning clearly regarding vigilance clearance from their present employer during the time of interview/final selection. Application without NOC will be treated as advance copy, however the applicants must declare that NOC will be submitted at the time final interview/selection.
  10. The online applications received in response to this advertisement shall be scrutinized as per the eligibility criteria detailed in the advertisement. Merely fulfilling the eligibility criteria does not entitle an applicants to be called for selection process. In case the number of applications received is large, Institute reserves to formulate additional criteria for shortlisting, based on academic performance and/ or levels/area/years of experience of the applicants or any other criteria as deemed fit. Only shortlisted applicants will be called for selection process. The decision of the Institute in this regard shall be final.
  11. The age limit shall be 57 years across all the cadres for regular employees of the Institute.
  12. Relaxation up to a maximum of 57 years of age shall be given for applicants working in the Institute on a non-regular/contract basis, provided they have served the Institute for at least 05 years.
  13. Appointments will be governed by the relevant service rules and regulations of the Institute as amended from time to time.
  14. No correspondence/queries will be entertained from applicants regarding email delays, conduct and result of interview/written test and reasons for not being called for interview/written test. However, all information/corrigendum related to this advertisement/ correspondence (viz. list of shortlisted applicants/syllabus/date of examination/call letter for test or interview), results, etc shall be uploaded on Careers@IITGoa page of IIT Goa's website. The applicants are advised to check the Institute website on regular basis. Applicants are also advised to provide correct email address and regularly check their emails including spam.
  15. In case of any inadvertent mistake in the process of selection which is detected at any stage even after the issue of appointment letter, the Institute reserves the right to modify/cancel the appointment and withdraw any communication made to the applicants.
  16. Decision of the Institute in all matters relating to the eligibility of the applicant, skill/written test and selection shall be final and binding on all the applicants. No correspondence or personal inquiries shall be entertained.
  17. In case of any dispute/ambiguity that may occur in the process of selection, the decision of the Institute shall be final.
  18. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  19. For any query related to submission of online application, you may send email to [email protected]
  20. All information/corrigendum related to this advertisement/updates on recruitment shall be posted only on Institute's website. The applicants are advised to check the Institute's website on regular basis.
  21. Any resultant dispute arising out of this advertisement shall be subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts situated at Goa only.
  22. In case of any discrepancy between the Hindi and English versions, the English version shall prevail in authenticating the original meaning of this advertisement.

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications

  • Doctorate degree (PhD) or equivalent in Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Life Sciences, or Medical Biotechnology.
  • Specialization in the area of Neurobiology is mandatory.
  • Degree must be from a recognized University or Institute.
  • Candidates must meet all minimum academic requirements at the time of interview.

Desirable Qualifications & Experience

Candidates with prior hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas will be strongly preferred:

  • Handling and culturing of mammalian cell lines, especially neuronal cell lines.
  • Induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) generation and culture.
  • Differentiation of stem cells into neurons and neural lineages.
  • Analyzing function and cell signaling in neuronal cells.
  • Developing and characterizing animal models of neuronal/neurodegenerative disorders.
  • Molecular biology techniques including: gene cloning, Western blotting, protein analysis, RT-PCR/qPCR, co-immunoprecipitation, protein–protein interaction studies, and cellular signaling pathway analysis.

Job Description & Responsibilities

  • In Vitro Model Development: Develop and optimize cell-based models of bipolar disorder using mammalian neuronal cell lines and iPSC-derived neurons.
  • Culture & Differentiation: Establish and maintain optimal culture and differentiation protocols for neuronal cells and stem cells.
  • Drug Screening: Conduct chemical/drug screening for bipolar disorder drug discovery using developed cell models.
  • In Vivo Studies: Develop rodent models of bipolar disorder and perform behavioral and neurobiological characterization.
  • Functional Analysis: Study disease progression and regulation at genetic and protein levels.
  • Molecular Analysis: Perform gene expression studies, protein analysis, and signaling pathway characterization in vitro and in vivo.
  • Therapeutics Development: Contribute to development of novel therapeutics and nutraceutical-based interventions for bipolar disorder.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Maintain detailed lab records, analyze data, and prepare reports/publication drafts.

Salary & Benefits

Component Amount
Basic Salary Rs. 48,000/- per month
House Rent Allowance (HRA) As per IIT Roorkee norms
Total Monthly Emoluments Rs. 48,000/- plus admissible HRA

Duration & Project Details

Initial Duration:
One year from the date of joining.
Extension Possibility:
Extendable for another one year based on availability of project funds and satisfactory performance.
Overall Project Duration:
Five years (or till project continuation, whichever is earlier).
Project Sponsor:
SKAN Research Trust, Puducherry.

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on performance in the interview.
  • Academic credentials, research experience, and interview performance will be considered.
  • Short-listing may be done prior to interview based on qualification and experience.
  • Original degrees, certificates, and experience documents will be verified at the time of interview.
  • SC/ST candidates will be given preference on equal qualifications and experience.

Vacancy Details

Category Number of vacancies Reserved for
Fireman 02 UR-01 EWS-01
Stoker 01 EWS-01

Eligibility Criteria

  • Matriculation (10th or equivalent).
  • Must be conversant with the use and maintenance of all types of extinguishers, including multi-use appliances and equipments like fire engines, fogger, fire pumps, foam branches etc.
  • Must be familiar with the use and maintenance of all fire and Fire Fighting Appliances and Tender Fire pump.
  • Must know elementary principles of Fire Fighting employed in fighting different types of fire.
  • Must be conversant with tool and appliance Fire Service Units and be able to perform the task allotted to the personnel of a Fire Crew.
  • Must be physically fit and capable of performing strenuous duties and must have passed the test specified in Para 10 below.
  • Matriculation pass or equivalent from recognised Board.
  • Must be conversant with the duties of Stoker.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Pay Matrix Level 2 Rs 19,900-63,200/- and other allowances
  • Pay Matrix Level-1 Rs 19,900-63,200/- and other allowances

Age Limit (as on the last date of receipt of application)

  • For Unreserved & EWS candidates - 18 to 25 years (Relaxable for Government Servant upto 35 years as per extant rules by the Central Government).

Selection Process

  • Selection will be subject to medical fitness and verification of character and antecedents from civil authorities.

General Information/ Instructions

  • The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the last date of receipt of application.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates who apply against unreserved post will not be given any concession of reserved category status will be considered in the Un-reserved category.
  • The benefits of reservation under EWS can be availed upon production of an Income and Asset Certificate issued by a Competent Authority.
  • All posts are temporary but likely to be permanent under Ministry of Defence with probation period of two years.
  • Candidates after selection will be subject to "All India Service Liability Rules".

How to Apply

  • Candidates to forward application duly typed in A4 size paper as per prescribed format given in the advertisement attached with extra passport size photograph, education qualification certificates so as to reach at Post Branch, Headquarters Armoured Corps Centre & School, Ahmednagar-413002 on or before the date of receipt of application.
  • The application should be sent by registered post or by speed post.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Ph.D. in Life Sciences or Biological Sciences.
  • Minimum 60% marks or first class or equivalent grade in Ph.D.
  • Degree must be from recognized universities/institutions.

Mandatory Experience

  • Experience in LC-MS based proteomics is mandatory.
  • Must include sample preparation, instrument handling, and data analysis.
  • Candidacy will NOT be considered without LC-MS based proteomics experience.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience in mammalian tissue culture.
  • Molecular biology expertise.
  • Biochemical assays experience.
  • Peer-reviewed publications showing experience in the above areas.
  • Candidates with publications demonstrating proteomics expertise will be preferred.

Age Limit

  • Not more than 35 years as on date of walk-in interview.
  • Age relaxation may be considered for candidates with higher qualifications/experience (with prior approval of competent authority).

Selection Process

Interview Based Selection

  • Selection through walk-in interview.
  • Screening committee will evaluate candidates based on qualifications and experience.
  • If candidates are large in number, the institute may restrict interviews to a reasonable limit based on screening committee recommendations.
  • Candidates with additional qualifications/experience above minimum may be preferred.

Important Selection Points

  • Minimum qualifications and experience are bare minimum requirements.
  • Mere possession of minimum qualifications does not entitle a candidate to be considered.
  • Additional qualifications and experience must be clearly mentioned in the application for better evaluation.
  • Interview date is the criterion date for determining age, qualifications, and experience.
  • If selected candidate does not join or resigns, waitlisted candidates may be offered the position.

Salary / Remuneration

  • Monthly consolidated emoluments: ₹80,000 per month.
  • Tenure: Initially for 1 year, extendable for further period subject to continuation of project and satisfactory performance.
  • Funding: Position is funded by Private Agency (project-based).

Important Terms & Conditions

  • Appointment is purely temporary and contractual.
  • Will terminate automatically without notice or compensation on project termination.
  • No claim for permanent appointment in IISER Pune or Funding Agency.
  • Appointment will be governed by funding agency terms and conditions.
  • No TA/DA admissible for interview.

Job Description / Responsibilities

  • Handle LC-MS based proteomics experiments.
  • Analyze proteomics data at cohort level.
  • Set up cell models and biochemical assays for validating findings from proteomics experiments.
  • Contribute to research publications in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Work on project-specific research objectives.

Vacancy Details

Name of the Post & Pay Scale Assistant Manager (Safety-Health-Environment) [on contractual basis] Equivalent to IDA grade E2 / Rs. 50000-160000
No. of vacancies 01 (One)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Master's degree in environmental engineering / M.Sc in Environmental Science / Post Graduate Diploma in Environment Engineering / Master's Degree in Environment Management.
  • Experience: Minimum 06 years post qualification work experience in the field of Safety-Health-Environment preferably in construction/manufacturing units.

Salary / Stipend

  • IDA equivalent E2/Rs. 50000-160000
  • DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Cafeteria of Allowances, annual increment etc as per the policy applicable to contractual employees of the corporation.
  • Gratuity as per the Gratuity Act.

Age Limit (as on 04-02-2026)

  • 40 years

Important Dates

Date of Walk-in-Interview 17 February 2026
Reporting time for Walk-in-Interview 10.00 hrs to 12.00 hrs

Selection Process

  • Walk-in-Interview
  • Candidate should attend the interview with application form with original credentials.
  • The candidates should arrive on time at the venue and get registered with HR Department for the walk-in interview.
  • The candidate will be interviewed by a nominated Committee and the selection will be finalized on merit based on the performance in the interview, qualification and post qualification experience gained by the Candidate.
  • The decision of the Nominated Committee of MRVC shall be final and binding.

General Information / Instructions

1. Undertake regular field visits to address and monitor Safety-Health-environmental issues related to project implementation.

2. Maintain and update computerized databases on environmental matters, including Forest, Wildlife, CRZ, and other statutory compliances.

3. Coordinate with CPMs offices for implementation and monitoring of Environmental Assessment (EA) and Environmental Management Plan (EMP) activities, including liaison with AIIB and other funding agencies.

4. Review and monitor deliverables of third-party consultants engaged for preparation and implementation of EMPs.

5. Prepare policy notes, compliance reports, progress updates, and related documents for submission to the Ministry of Railways and external funding agencies.

6. Provide technical guidance and support to CPMs offices through periodic site inspections on environmental safeguard issues.

7. Coordinate preparation of additional environmental action plans, studies, and conduct capacity-building/training programmes for field staff.

8. Coordinate with PMC and perform any other duties related to environmental aspects as assigned by CPM from time to time.

The engagement will be for a period of 3 years.

The period of contract is extendable at sole discretion of MRVC as per project requirement subject to satisfactory service of the contractual employee.

The cut-off date for eligibility would be date of issue of notification i.e. 04.02.2026.

a) 8 days Casual Leave + 2 days Restricted Holidays per annum (unutilised CL/RH if any would lapse at the end of one year)

b) 10 days sick leave for six months (like Half Pay leave with provision of commutation)

c) 12 days Special Leave per annum.

However, grant of leave shall not be claimed as a matter of right and the Competent Authority has the right in its absolute discretion either to sanction or reject the leave applied for.

The selected candidate will have to serve the Corporation for at least two years for which he/she should execute a Surety Bond of Rs.1 Lac. in favour of Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. on Rs. 500/- stamp paper to serve the Company for two years.

The candidate should have sound health. Before joining, candidates will have to undergo medical examination and produce the certificate of fitness for job issued by a Doctor (at least MBBS).

How to Apply

  • Interested and eligible candidates are advised to carefully read the contents of Annexure-I and ensure that they meet the prescribed eligibility criteria before appearing for the Walk-in-Interview. Candidates should bring a duly filled-in Application Form along with all required documents (original with one set copy), as specified in Annexure-II, at the time of the Walk-in-Interview.
  • Venue: Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd., 2nd Floor, Churchgate Station Building, Churchgate, Mumbai-400 020.

Selection Process

  • Candidate should meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the advertisement.  
  • The qualification and experience prescribed, are the minimum requirements and possession of the  same does not automatically make the candidates entitled to be called for written test and / or selection processes. 
  • There will be an initial screening based on the academic records and other parameters declared in  the on-line application and only screened-in candidates will be considered for further selection process. 
  • The management reserves the right to increase/alter the minimum eligibility criteria/cut off  limits, in  the event of the number of applicants are more, for any post(s), at its discretion. 
  • Candidates will be selected on the basis of their academic credentials, experience profile, written   test marks (if any), performance in the interview and such other selection processes/parameters, as adopted and deemed fit by management. e. Mere application and fulfilment of the mentioned qualifications etc., does not entitle a candidate  to be called for written/skill test/ interview.
  • C-DAC may restrict the number of candidates to be  called to participate in interview/selection process to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than that of the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. The  candidates should, therefore, furnish all the qualifications and experience possessed in the relevant field, over and above the minimum qualifications prescribed.  
  • The selection process shall be carried out by the respective C-DAC Centre based on its requirements and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further process.
  • All information submitted in the application will be verified with the original documents at the time  of document verification or at any stage of the recruitment process. If any documents/information provided by the candidate is found to be false or incorrect or Non- conformity with the eligibility criteria, then his/her candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at  any stage of the recruitment and selection process without any prior intimation.

  • Candidate should read all the eligibility parameters and ensure that he/she is eligible for the post before starting to apply online.
  • Candidate should have a valid email id and mobile no. which should remain valid & active till the completion of selection process.
  • While applying online Candidates can click on the ‘Apply’ button provided against each position for which he/she wish to apply.
  • The candidate needs to log in with mobile no. and then fill in the OTP received on the said mobile no.

  • Candidates shall check the prefilled application and submit it, after adding additional details by clicking on ‘Submit’ button.
  • Candidates should scan their photograph in .jpg format (not more than 400 KB) and keep it ready before starting to apply online for uploading.
  • Candidate should upload their resume in PDF format (Not more than 500 KB)
  • A unique application number will be generated by the system, please note this application number for future reference and use. Candidates can take a print of the application form and keep it with them for their own records.
  • No hard copy/printed applications should be sent to C-DAC. Incomplete and defectively filled online forms shall be rejected straightway and no subsequent correspondences will be entertained in this regard.
  • Candidates working in Government/PSUs/Govt. Autonomous bodies should also apply online in advance and print of the application form, duly filled and signed should be forwarded through proper channel to HRD Section, C-DAC, Bangalore.
  • Those who are not forwarding their application through proper channel are required to produce 'No objection certificate (NOC)' from their current employer at the time of interview, if called for, failing which they will not be permitted to attend the interview.
  • Any dispute with regard to selection/recruitment process will be subject to Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Bangalore, Karnataka only.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Paper Subject Type Marks Duration
Paper I General Studies (GS) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II CSAT (Aptitude Test) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

Paper Subject Marks Nature

Vacancy Details

Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation (MRVC), a Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Railways, is recruiting 7 professionals for Rolling Stock projects on a 5-year contractual basis. These positions are critical for executing EMU (Electric Multiple Unit) projects and enhancing suburban rail transportation capacity in Mumbai.

Position Vacancies Category Pay Scale (IDA)
Sr. Manager (Rolling Stock) 3 UR E4 (₹70,000 - ₹2,00,000)
Manager (Rolling Stock) Included in 3 UR E3 (₹60,000 - ₹1,80,000)
Project Engineer (Rolling Stock) 4 3 UR, 1 OBC E1 (₹40,000 - ₹1,40,000)

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • B.E / B.Tech in Electrical, Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Power Electronics, or Instrumentation from a Government recognized University/Institute
  • Minimum 60% marks in engineering graduation (aggregate percentage as per university conversion norms if CGPA/OGPA/CPI/DGPA is awarded)
  • Note: Rounding off percentages will NOT be acceptable (e.g., 59.99% will be treated as less than 60%)

Experience Requirements (Post-Qualification)

  • Sr. Manager (Rolling Stock): Minimum 8 years post-qualification working experience. Currently working in E-3/L-10 grade with minimum 2 years in that level or higher grade
  • Manager (Rolling Stock): Minimum 4 years post-qualification working experience. Currently working in E-2/L-8 grade with minimum 2 years in that level or higher grade
  • Project Engineer (Rolling Stock): Minimum 2 years post-qualification working experience
  • Preferred: Candidates with working experience in design, technical specifications, bid preparation, testing, operation and maintenance of EMU rolling stock in Railway/RRTS/Metro/LRT/HSR/Suburban rail systems will be preferred

Age Limit (as on 28.02.2026)

  • Sr. Manager (Rolling Stock): Not exceeding 40 years
  • Manager (Rolling Stock): Not exceeding 35 years
  • Project Engineer (Rolling Stock): Not exceeding 30 years
  • Age relaxation as per Government of India policy applicable

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Released 29.01.2026
Last Date for Application Submission 28.02.2026
Eligibility Cut-off Date 28.02.2026
Document Verification & Interview To be announced (5x vacancies will be shortlisted)
Contract Period 5 Years

Selection Process

  • Preliminary Screening: Applications will be screened for compliance with eligibility criteria and prescribed format
  • Shortlisting: If more applications are received, candidates equal to 5 times the notified vacancies will be shortlisted based on engineering marks and experience
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must bring original application, original certificates, one set of self-attested photocopies, and character certificate from Gazetted/Executive Officer
  • Interview: Candidates will be interviewed by a nominated Committee of MRVC
  • Merit-Based Selection: Final selection will be based on performance in interview, qualifications, and post-qualification experience
  • Medical Examination: Selected candidates must pass medical fitness examination by a doctor (minimum MBBS qualification)
  • Decision: The decision of the Nominated Committee shall be final and binding

Salary/Remuneration

  • Sr. Manager (Rolling Stock) - IDA E4/L-11: Basic Pay ₹70,000 - ₹2,00,000 with annual increment @ 3% of basic pay
  • Manager (Rolling Stock) - IDA E3/L-10: Basic Pay ₹60,000 - ₹1,80,000 with annual increment @ 3% of basic pay
  • Project Engineer (Rolling Stock) - IDA E1: Basic Pay ₹40,000 - ₹1,40,000 with annual increment @ 3% of basic pay
  • Additional Allowances: DA (Dearness Allowance), HRA (House Rent Allowance), Provident Fund, Cafeteria, and other perks as per MRVC policy
  • Medical Benefits: As per MRVC policy
  • Pay Protection: Provided to candidates already working in Govt/Semi-government/PSU organizations (including on contract)

How to Apply

Application Process

  1. Download the application proforma (Annexure-I) from the official PDF
  2. Fill the application form completely with all required information in the prescribed format
  3. Paste a recent passport-size photograph and sign across it
  4. Fill all mandatory fields including:
    • Full name, father's/husband's name, postal address with PIN code
    • Contact details (mobile number and email address)
    • Date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format
    • Gender, Category (SC/ST/OBC/UR)
    • Current working position and pay level
    • Complete educational qualifications with aggregate percentage marks
    • Detailed work experience in chronological order

Required Documents (Self-Attested)

Mandatory Documents:

  • Copy of original application with photo and signature
  • Certificates in proof of educational qualifications (all degrees/diplomas)
  • Proof of Date of Birth (SSLC/SSC Certificate or Birth Certificate)
  • OBC-NCL certificate in format prescribed for Central Government employment (if applicable)
  • Photo ID proof (Aadhar Card or PAN Card)
  • Documents regarding work experience and last service record
  • Character certificate from Gazetted Officer or Executive Officer
  • NOC from Government/PSU employer if currently employed

Recommended Documents:

  • Employment letters from previous and present employers
  • Form 16 (Income Tax) from previous/present employer
  • EPF/PF Number documentation

Submission Mode

  1. Email the duly filled application with all supporting documents to: [email protected]
  2. Subject line format: "Application for [Position Name] - [Your Name]"
  3. Application must be received by 28.02.2026 (email timestamp will be considered)
  4. Incomplete applications or those without prescribed documents will be summarily rejected
  5. No correspondence will be entertained regarding rejection

  • Essential Qualification: Bachelor Degree in any Discipline with First Class and Master of Business Administration with First Class from any recognized University/ Institution within India.

  3. Stage 3: Walk-In-Interview
    • Shortlisted candidates must appear for walk-in-interview on specified date and time

  4. Stage 4: Final Selection

  • In case of deserving and exceptionally qualified candidates, desirable qualifications may be relaxed

  • Duration: For the project tenure up to 04th December 2029

Important Terms

  • Exceptional Qualification Relaxation: Desirable qualifications may be relaxed for deserving and exceptionally qualified candidates at discretion of Competent Authority
  • Project Requirement: Candidates may be reassigned to another project based on institutional need
  • Language Option: Candidates have the option to appear for interview in Hindi language as well as English

2. Assistant Professor - Pathology (Tumor Tissue Repository)

  • M.D. or D.N.B. in Pathology or equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by National Medical Commission.
  • Minimum 3 years experience in Tumor Tissue Repository/Tissue Banking/Biorepository with expertise in tissue handling, processing and cryopreservation techniques.
  • Knowledge of bio-banking regulations and biosafety guidelines.

3. Assistant Professor - Radiation Oncology

  • M.D. or D.N.B. in Radiation Oncology/Radiotherapy or equivalent postgraduate degree.
  • 3 years post M.D./D.N.B. experience in Radiation Oncology in a teaching hospital or cancer centre.
  • Experience in Brachytherapy, 3D conformal treatment planning and IMRT is desirable.

4. Assistant Professor - Anesthesiology (2 Posts)

  • M.D. or D.N.B. in Anesthesia or equivalent postgraduate degree in Anesthesiology.
  • 3 years post M.D./D.N.B. experience in Anesthesia in a teaching hospital.
  • Experience in critical care and pain management is desirable.

5. Assistant Professor - Pathology (3 Posts)

  • D.M. in Oncopathology or Haematopathology, or M.D./D.N.B. in Pathology or equivalent postgraduate degree.
  • Minimum 3 years post M.D./D.N.B. experience in Pathology in a teaching hospital.

6. Assistant Professor - Medical Oncology, Solid Tumor (3 Posts)

  • D.M. or D.N.B. in Medical Oncology or equivalent postgraduate degree.
  • 1 year experience in Solid Tumor Medical Oncology in a teaching hospital is desirable.

7. Assistant Professor - Intensivist, Critical Care (2 Posts)

  • D.M. in Critical Care or M.D./D.N.B. in Anaesthesia/General Medicine/Pulmonary Medicine/Pediatrics or equivalent postgraduate degree.
  • For M.D./D.N.B.: 3 years post M.D./D.N.B. experience in Critical Care.

8. Assistant Professor - Interventional Radiology (2 Posts)

  • D.M. in Interventional Radiology or M.D./D.N.B. in Radiodiagnosis recognized by National Medical Commission.
  • For M.D./D.N.B.: 3 years post M.D./D.N.B. experience in Interventional Radiology.

9. Consultant - Infectious Diseases (2 Posts)

  • D.M. in Infectious Disease, or M.D. Medicine/Pediatrics with Fellowship in Infectious Diseases (minimum 1 year), recognized by National Medical Commission.
  • 3 years post M.D. experience in Infectious Diseases unit.
  • Experience in Transplant Infectious Diseases is desirable.

10. Consultant - Pulmonary Medicine (1 Post)

  • M.D. or D.N.B. in Respiratory Medicine/Pulmonary Medicine, or D.M. in Pulmonary Medicine/Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine, recognized by National Medical Commission.
  • For M.D./D.N.B.: Minimum 3 years post M.D./D.N.B. experience in Pulmonary Medicine in a teaching hospital.
  • Skills in EBUS, Medical Thoracoscopy and advanced bronchoscopy procedures are desirable.

11. Consultant - Pathology (2 Posts)

  • M.D. or D.N.B. in Pathology or equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by National Medical Commission.
  • Minimum 1 year post M.D./D.N.B. experience in Pathology in a teaching hospital.

In this article, you’ll find the SEBI Young Professional Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

SEBI Young Professional Program 2026 – Important Details

Advertisement
Details Information
Organization Name Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
Post Name Young Professional (Securities Market Operations / Law / Research / Information Technology / Rajbasha)

SEBI Young Professional Program 2026 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for SEBI Young Professional Program Recruitment 2026 is 91 posts distributed among domains as under:

Domain Number of Young Professionals
Young Professional (Securities Market Operations) 40
Young Professional (Law) 13
Young Professional (Research) 4
Young Professional (Information Technology) 29
Young Professional (Rajbasha) 5
Total 91

The Board reserves the right to modify the number of Young Professionals to be engaged or not to engage any Young Professional at all.

Eligibility Criteria

1. Age & Nationality

  • The candidate must be an Indian citizen.
  • Age must not be more than 30 years as on the date of publication of the advertisement.

2. General Essential Skills (for all domains)

All candidates are expected to have reasonable:

  • Understanding of financial markets.
  • Analytical ability.
  • Knowledge of Information Technology tools.
  • Aptitude for research.
  • Oral and written communication skills.
  • Judgment and interpersonal skills.

3. Domain-wise Educational Qualification, Work Experience & Skills

Young Professional (Securities Market Operations)

  • Post Graduate qualification (degree / 2-year diploma) in Management (with specialization in Finance) from a recognized and reputed university/institution with minimum 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA; OR
  • Chartered Accountant (CA) / Company Secretary (CS) / Cost Management Accountant (CMA) with minimum 55% aggregate marks in the final level of the course; OR
  • Successfully completed all 3 levels of Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) course from CFA Institute (USA).
  • At least 1 year of work experience in the financial sector after completion of Post Graduate qualification or CA/CS/CMA/CFA.

Young Professional (Law)

  • Bachelors’ Degree in Law from a recognized and reputed university/institution with minimum 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA.
  • At least 1 year of work experience in corporate/securities laws after completion of Bachelors’ Degree in Law / LLM.
  • Preference to candidates with experience in a financial or investment environment requiring knowledge of market practices and rules, regulations and guidelines governing the securities industry.

Young Professional (Research)

  • Post Graduate qualification (degree / 2-year diploma) in Management (with specialization in Finance) / Economics / Commerce / Financial Economics / Business Economics / Applied Statistics / Econometrics from a recognized and reputed university/institution with minimum 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA.
  • For candidates with only Post Graduate qualification: at least 1 year of research/work experience in areas including but not limited to financial markets, corporate finance, macroeconomic theory, corporate governance, financial institutions and related areas of international finance, supported by published work/working papers/submission of papers in research conferences.
  • For candidates with PhD in relevant fields (Economics/Econometrics/Finance/Commerce, preferably focused on financial markets): work experience requirement is not mandatory.
  • Skill: Knowledge of statistical software.

Young Professional (Information Technology)

  • Any of the following degrees from a recognized and reputed university/institution with minimum 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA:
    • B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics / Electronics and Communication / Information Technology / Computer Science; OR
    • MCA / MSc (IT) / MSc (Computer Science) / MBA (Systems) / MBA (Analytics) / M.Tech (Computer Science/IT/Relevant Stream) / MS (Computer Science/IT/Relevant Stream) or equivalent degree.
  • At least 1 year of work experience in software development (programming) or cyber security.

Skills – Software Development (Programming)

  • Proficiency in any of: JSP/J2EE with Spring/Hibernate; Angular; SAP-ABAP/Web Dynpro; Python (with ML frameworks like Pandas, Pytorch, scikit-learn, NumPy, Matplotlib, Plotly); IBM BPM development.
  • Knowledge of ML algorithms, Deep Learning frameworks and NLP; or deep understanding of statistical concepts and methodologies including Multivariate Analysis, anomaly and pattern detection techniques, graph database.
  • Proficiency in front-end frameworks like React, Vue etc. and/or knowledge of digital forensic analysis or OSINT frameworks.
  • Database proficiency in DB2/ORACLE/PostgreSQL/MySQL etc.

Skills – Cyber Security

  • Knowledge of global best practices in cyber security and IT.
  • Ability to take corrective measures/prudent response in case of cyber-attacks.
  • Experience in development, implementation and compliance with cyber and information security policies and procedures.
  • Installation/operation of Data Security (DLP/DAM), Network Security (Firewall/IPS/Proxy/DDoS), or System Security (PIM/Antivirus/Anti-APT) products.

Young Professional (Rajbasha)

  • Master’s Degree in Hindi/Hindi Translation with English as a subject at Bachelor’s Degree level; OR
  • Master’s Degree in Sanskrit/English/Economics/Commerce with Hindi as a subject at Bachelor’s Degree level; OR
  • Master’s Degree in both English and Hindi/Hindi Translation from a recognized University/Institute.
  • At least 1 year of work experience in the field including knowledge of Hindi typing.

Age Limit

  • Maximum age: Not more than 30 years as on the date of publication of advertisement.

Selection Process for SEBI Young Professional Program 2026

Candidates will be selected based on a three-step process:

  • 1. Application Screening: Applications will be screened and shortlisted as per criteria decided by SEBI, which may include institute ranking (e.g. NIRF), academic performance, relevance of work experience, Statement of Purpose, extracurricular activities, and overall profile.
  • 2. Preliminary Interview: Conducted in virtual mode for shortlisted candidates.
  • 3. Final Interview: Conducted in virtual mode; candidates must have valid ID proof for verification as required.

For Young Professionals (IT), additional factors considered may include relevant programming/cyber security certifications, valid GATE score and achievements in coding competitions, bug bounty, hackathons, or zero-day vulnerability reporting.

SEBI’s decision regarding eligibility, screening, interviews, assessment, number of vacancies and results will be final and binding. SEBI may select or reject any candidate and may cancel the advertisement fully or partly.

How To Apply

Eligible candidates can apply online for SEBI Young Professional Program 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit SEBI’s official website: www.sebi.gov.in and go to the “Careers” section.
  2. Access the Young Professional Program online application form at:
    Apply for SEBI YPP 2026.
  3. Fill the online application form carefully with accurate personal, academic, experience and domain choice details. A candidate is permitted to apply for only one domain.
  4. On submission, note down the generated Application Number and save the system-generated filled-in application form for future reference.
  5. Ensure that no false, tampered, fabricated or invalid particulars are furnished and that no material information is suppressed.

No other mode of application is permitted. The online application window will remain open for 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in newspapers.

Important Dates

Event Date / Duration
Notification issue date (on letter) 08/02/2026
Application Window 21 days from date of publication of advertisement in newspapers

General Information / Instructions

  1. Merely applying for the post and being shortlisted in the examination/interview and/ or any stage of recruitment process does not imply that a candidate will necessarily be offered employment in the Port. No request for considering the candidature under any category / post other than the one in which applied will be entertained.

In that event, every effort will be made to rectify the problem, which may include shifting the candidates to the other centers or conducting another examination if considered necessary.   10. Admission to further recruitment process will be purely provisional without verification of age / qualification / experience / category (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD) etc. of the Candidates with reference to documents.

  16. Decisions of the Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority in all matters regarding eligibility, conduct of online examination, other tests and selection would be final and binding on all candidates. No representation or correspondence will be entertained by the Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority in this regard.

  19. Candidate’s admission to the online test/written exam other tests is strictly provisional. The mere fact that the call letter has been issued to the candidate does not imply that his/her candidature has been finally cleared by the Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority.
  20. The Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority reserves the right to cancel the above Recruitment Exercise at any stage of the process without assigning any reason thereof.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

  • Junior Engineer (Electrical): Diploma in Electrical Engineering from a recognized institution with valid certificate

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: Computer-based test covering general knowledge, reasoning, mathematics, technical subjects related to the post, and Marathi language
  • Document Verification: Candidates qualifying in written test will be called for document verification. Candidates must bring all original documents along with self-attested photocopies
  • Personal Interview/Skill Test: For technical and specialist posts, candidates may have to appear for personal interview and/or skill test
  • Medical Examination: Selected candidates must undergo medical fitness test as per NMMC norms
  • Final Merit List: Final selection will be based on performance in written test, interview (if applicable) and document verification
  • Typing Test: For Clerk-Typist and similar posts, typing test in Marathi and English will be conducted

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must read the official notification carefully before applying
  • Only online applications through the official website www.nmmc.gov.in will be accepted
  • Candidates should have a valid email ID and mobile number which should be active during the entire recruitment process
  • Incomplete applications or applications without required documents will be rejected
  • False information or suppression of facts will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage
  • NMMC reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process at any stage
  • Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply unless otherwise specified
  • Candidates already employed in government/semi-government organizations must produce NOC (No Objection Certificate) from their employer
  • Selected candidates will be appointed on probation for a period as per NMMC rules
  • The decision of NMMC in all matters related to recruitment will be final and binding
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate
  • No TA/DA will be provided for attending the exam or interview

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation at www.nmmc.gov.in
  • Step 2: On the homepage, locate the "Recruitment" or "Career" section
  • Step 3: Click on the relevant recruitment notification link for NMMC Recruitment 2025
  • Step 4: Read the detailed notification and instructions carefully
  • Step 5: Click on "Apply Online" button to start the application process
  • Step 6: Register yourself by providing basic details like name, email ID, and mobile number
  • Step 7: After registration, login using the credentials received on your email/mobile
  • Step 8: Fill the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and other required details
  • Step 9: Upload scanned copies of your photograph, signature, and other required documents in prescribed format and size
  • Step 10: Pay the application fee online through available payment modes (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking/UPI)
  • Step 11: Review all the entered information carefully before final submission
  • Step 12: Submit the application form and take a printout of the confirmation page for future reference
  • Step 13: Keep the payment receipt and application confirmation safe until the recruitment process is complete

NMMC Recruitment 2026 - FAQs

1. What is the starting date to apply for NMMC Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Starting Date to apply is 20/01/2026

2. What is the last apply date for NMMC Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Last apply date is 19/02/2026 

3. What is the Eligibility to apply for NMMC Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Eligibility varies by post. For Junior Engineer posts, Diploma in relevant engineering is required. For medical posts, MBBS with respective post-graduate qualification is mandatory. For administrative posts, Graduate degree with relevant qualifications is required.

4. What is the Maximum Age Limit to apply for NMMC Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Maximum age limit is 38 years for most posts, with relaxation for reserved categories as per government norms.

5. How many vacancies are being recruited by NMMC in 2026?

Ans: Total 432+ Vacancies across Group A (12 posts), Group B (07 posts), and Group C (113 posts).

Ans: Application fee is Rs. 1,000/- for General/OBC/Other categories and Rs. 900/- for SC/ST/PWD categories.

7. What is the salary for NMMC posts?

Ans: Salary ranges from Rs. 38,600 to Rs. 1,77,500 per month depending on the post, as per 7th Pay Commission norms.

8. Is there any negative marking in the NMMC examination?

Ans: Details about negative marking will be mentioned in the exam pattern section of the official notification. Candidates should check the detailed notification before appearing for the exam.

9. Can candidates apply for multiple posts in NMMC Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Candidates can apply for multiple posts if they meet the eligibility criteria for each post. Separate application forms and fees must be submitted for each post.

Ans: Required documents include scanned photograph, signature, educational certificates, caste certificate (if applicable), experience certificates, age proof, and other relevant documents as specified in the notification.
