Eligibility Criteria

  • Applications are invited only from eligible and willing Officers of all Major Port Authorities possessing prescribed qualifications, experience and other conditions as per MbPT Employees (Recruitment, Seniority and Promotion) Regulations, 2010 (Recruitment Rules at Annexure I).
  • Absorption/deputation will be of Officers holding analogous posts or officers in feeder posts with required qualifying service and experience in a Major Port Trust as specified in the Recruitment Rules.
  • Promotion channel in the Recruitment Rules specifies promotion from Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil) in the scale of pay Rs.9100-15100 with 5 years regular service in the grade, with Degree in Civil Engineering from recognised University/Institution (or essential Diploma in Civil Engineering in specified cases).
  • Industrial/commercial/Govt. undertakings experience in planning/construction/design/maintenance, especially of Port and Marine structures, is required as per detailed Recruitment Rules extract.

Salary/Stipend

  • The post of Executive Engineer (Civil) carries the pay scale of Rs.50000-160000.
  • The circular also refers to pre-revised scales of Rs.20600-46500 and Rs.10750-16750 for the post, as per earlier pay structures in the Recruitment Rules.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • The crucial date for determining eligibility is 01.01.2026 in terms of Regulation 10(2) of the MbPT Employees (Recruitment, Seniority & Promotion) Regulations, 2010.
  • The circular and attached Recruitment Rules do not explicitly mention minimum or maximum age limits in years; eligibility is governed by service, cadre and qualification conditions as on 01.01.2026.

Application Fee

Important Dates

Notification Date 19/01/2026
Crucial Date for Eligibility 01/01/2026 (as per Regulation 10(2) of MbPT (RS&P) Regulations, 2010)
Last Date for Receipt of Applications by Mumbai Port Authority 20/02/2026

Selection Process

  • Filling up of the posts of Executive Engineer (Civil) will be by absorption/deputation from Officers of all Major Port Authorities, in accordance with MbPT Employees (Recruitment, Seniority and Promotion) Regulations, 2010.
  • Applications will be forwarded by the concerned Port Authority along with Vigilance and administrative clearance, certified copies of ACRs/ APARs and required certificates, for consideration by Mumbai Port Authority.
  • The process is a selection post as per the Recruitment Rules, with scrutiny of eligibility, ACRs and vigilance status; no written test or interview details are specified in the circular text.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications must be made in the format at Annexure II and submitted through proper channel by the concerned Major Port Authority.
  • The concerned Port Authority must forward the application along with: certificate on last page of application duly completed by HoD; certified copies of ACRs for last 5 years (2020-21 to 2024-25) duly attested by an Officer not below Dy. HoD on each page; statement showing year-wise availability of ACRs and grading signed by Secretary/HoD; and Vigilance & administrative clearances.
  • The circular, along with Annexures, is also available on www.mumbaiport.gov.in under “People & Career/Jobs”.
  • Applicants are advised that payscale granted as financial upgradation under MACP should not be indicated as it is not regular service in the grade, as mentioned in the application form instructions.
  • Self-attested copies of certificates in support of educational and other qualifications, and documents in support of employment in organisations other than Major Port Authority, may be enclosed with the application.

How to Apply

  • Download and fill the application form in the format given at Annexure II of the circular.
  • Route the application through proper channel, ensuring the Head of Department completes the certificate on the last page of the application form.
  • Attach certified copies of ACRs for the last five years (2020-21 to 2024-25), the year-wise ACR availability and grading statement signed by Secretary/HoD, and Vigilance & administrative clearances.
  • The concerned Major Port Authority must forward the complete application and enclosures to the designated authority in Mumbai Port Authority so as to reach on or before 20.02.2026.
  • Candidates must ensure that they meet all eligibility conditions as per the MbPT Employees (Recruitment, Seniority and Promotion) Regulations, 2010 as on the crucial date 01.01.2026.

  • Essential Experience: Officers having total minimum 7 yrs of post qualification experience with following criteria - For CDA: Working in Grade Pay of Rs. 6,600/- (CDA) 7th CPC with minimum 2 yrs experience in desirable domain for the post OR Working in Grade Pay of Rs. 5,400/- (CDA) with minimum 5 yrs experience in desirable domain for the post; For IDA: Currently working in Govt. Entities in IDA pay scale of Rs. 60,000 – 1,80,000/- with minimum 2 yrs experience in desirable domain for the post or Currently working in IDA pay scale of Rs. 50,000 – 1,60,000 with minimum 5 yrs experience in desirable domain for the post; OR Total minimum 10 yrs of post qualification experience in reputed private sector in Executive grade in desirable domain for the post with minimum CTC of Rs. 12 Lacs
  • Desirable: Candidate should have experience of working in construction projects of Railways/ Metros/ other PSUs/ private sector dealing in 25 kV Traction/ Traction Power Supply/ Traction SCADA works; Candidate should be conversant with computerized designing & drawings related to latest 25 kV Traction/ Traction Power Supply/ Traction SCADA technologies and should be conversant with international bidding procedures; Candidate with working experience of modern metro rail systems will be preferred

Deputy Engineer (Civil)

  • Qualification: Full time Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized and reputed university
  • Essential Experience: Sr. Supervisor having total minimum 04 years of experience in Grade Pay of Rs. 4,600/- (CDA) or its equivalent in IDA Pay scale of Rs.40,320-77,540/- (W7) with minimum 02 years post qualification experience in desirable domain for the post; or Officer currently working in Jr. Scale with Grade Pay of Rs. 5,400/- (CDA) or its equivalent in IDA PayScale of Rs. 50,000 – 1,60,000/- (E2) with minimum 02 years' experience in desirable domain for the post; or Total minimum 04 years of experience in Supervisory grade of Rs. 40,320 – 77,540/- (W7) in IDA pay scale with minimum 02 years post qualification experience in desirable domain for the post; or Total minimum 04 years of post-qualification experience in Executive grade in Government entities in desirable domain for the post; or Total minimum 04 years of post-qualification experience in reputed Private sector in desirable domain for the post with minimum CTC of Rs. 05 - 06 Lacs
  • Desirable: Candidates should have experience of Construction and Maintenance of Civil & Track structure in Railways /Metro; Candidates should have experience of working on projects of stations/tunnels/viaduct and bridges/ ballastless track works/tracks of Urban Railways; Candidate should be conversant with international competitive bidding, computerized environment working; Adequate experience in planning, designing, supplying, testing and commissioning of civil engineering works for underground Metro/ rail projects in urban & suburban environment including consultancy works related to urban rail projects; Candidates with experience of working of modern urban rail system will be preferred; Candidates should have experience and knowledge of interface with railway related disciplines such as Civil, Tracks, Signalling, Electrification and Rolling Stock

Deputy Engineer (S&T)

  • Qualification: Degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering from recognized and reputed university
  • Essential Experience: For Degree holders: A total minimum of 05 years of post-qualification with minimum 2 years of experience in Grade Pay of Rs.5400/- (CDA) or its equivalent in IDA Pay scale of Rs. 40000 - 140000/- (E1) or 05 years in W7/W8 grade in the Desirable domain in government organizations Or A total minimum of 06 years of post-qualification with minimum 3 years of experience in the Desirable domain in any reputed private sector with minimum CTC of Rs. 05 Lacs; For Diploma holders: A minimum of 06 years of post-qualification experience, minimum 2 years of experience in Grade Pay of Rs.5400/- (CDA) or its equivalent in IDA Pay scale of Rs. 40000 - 140000/- (E1) or 05 years in W7/W8 grade in the Desirable domain in the IDA pay scale or its equivalent in other government organizations Or A minimum of 07 years of post-qualification experience, including minimum 02 years of service in the Desirable domain in any reputed private sector with minimum CTC of Rs. 05 Lacs
  • Desirable: Candidate should have experience of working in construction projects of railways / metros/ other PSUs /private sector dealing in signal and telecom; Candidate should be conversant with computerized environment working and the latest Signaling & Telecommunications (S&T) technologies; Candidates with experience of working of CBTC based signaling systems will be preferred

Junior Engineer-II (S&T)

  • Qualification: Full time B.E. / B. Tech or Diploma in Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering discipline from a Govt. recognized Institute / University
  • Essential Experience: For Diploma holders: A total minimum of 08 years of post-qualification with minimum 3 years of experience in Grade Pay of Rs.4200/- (CDA) or its equivalent in IDA Pay scale of Rs. 34,020 - 64,310/- (W5) in the Desirable domain in government organizations Or A total minimum of 09 years of post-qualification experience including minimum 03 years of service in the Desirable domain in any reputed private sector with minimum CTC of Rs. 05 Lacs; For Degree holders: A total minimum of 06 years of post-qualification experience with minimum of 02 years of service in the Desirable domain in Rs. 34,020 - 64,310/- (W5) grade in the IDA pay scale or its equivalent in other government organizations in a different type of pay scale; Or A total minimum of 07 years of post-qualification experience including minimum 02 years of service in the Desirable domain in any reputed private sector with minimum CTC of Rs. 05 Lacs
  • Desirable: Candidates having experience in the field of Signalling & Telecom department in Metro Rail/ Railway/ Railway PSU's/ Metro related Infrastructure Industries will be preferred; Candidates should have experience of working in Construction projects of Railways/ Metro/ other PSU's/ Private Sector dealing with latest technology in Signalling or Telecommunication or Automatic Fare Collection (AFC) systems; Adequate experience in supervising S&T related work, coordination between various contractors at Site; Candidate should have exposure in managing and controlling various types of documentations

Assistant (IT)-I

  • Qualification: Full-time B.E (IT or Computer Science Engineering/ Electronics and Telecommunication) or Full time Graduation i.e. B.Sc. (IT/Computer)/BCA or equivalent from recognized College/University OR Diploma in Computer Science/Application or equivalent from recognized University/College
  • Essential Experience: Sound Knowledge of hardware/ software/ Networking / IT Literacy i.e. working skills in MS Office/ drafting skill and email management; For Graduates: Full time Graduation with minimum 02 years' experience in IT field in desirable domain; For Diploma: Minimum 04 years of experience in IT field in desirable domain
  • Desirable: Knowledge of Project IT Applications such as Primavera P6/ ERP/ eOffice, Working experience in reputed companies of Private/ Govt. Sector of IT related Fields; Candidates having experience in Metro/ Railway/ Railway PSU's/ Metro in IT field will be preferred

Salary/Stipend

  • General Manager (Rolling Stock): Rs. 1,20,000 – 2,80,000/- (IDA Pay Scale - Grade E8)
  • Assistant General Manager (PST): Rs. 70,000 - 2,00,000/- (IDA Pay Scale - Grade E4)
  • Deputy Engineer (Civil): Rs. 50,000 – 1,60,000/- (IDA Pay Scale - Grade E2)
  • Deputy Engineer (S&T): Rs. 50,000 – 1,60,000/- (IDA Pay Scale - Grade E2)
  • Junior Engineer-II (S&T): Rs. 35,280 – 67,920/- (IDA Pay Scale - Grade W6)
  • Assistant (IT)-I: Rs. 34,020 - 64,310/- (IDA Pay Scale - Grade W5)
  • Pay Scale, Allowances & Perquisites for candidates appointed on deputation will be governed by DOPT/ DPE/ GOI guidelines as applicable

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • General Manager (Rolling Stock): Maximum 55 years (Age is relaxable for internal /deputation candidates)
  • Assistant General Manager (PST): Maximum 40 years (Age relaxation of 05 years for ST category; Age is relaxable for internal /deputation candidates)
  • Deputy Engineer (Civil): Maximum 35 years (Age relaxation of 05 years for ST category; Age is relaxable for internal /deputation candidates)
  • Deputy Engineer (S&T): Maximum 35 years (Age is relaxable for internal /deputation candidates)
  • Junior Engineer-II (S&T): Maximum 35 years (Age relaxation of 03 years for OBC category; Age is relaxable for deserving/ internal candidates)
  • Assistant (IT)-I: Maximum 35 years (Age relaxation of 03 years for OBC category; Age is relaxable for deserving/ internal candidates)

Age Relaxations as per Government Guidelines:

Category of Candidate Age Relaxation
Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) By 05 years
Other Backward Class (OBC) Non - Creamy Layer By 03 years

Person with Disabilities (PWD) - OBC By 08 years
Person with Disabilities (PWD) - Unreserved By 05 years
Children / Family members of those who died in the 1984 riots By 05 years
Ex-Servicemen By 05 years

Application Fee

Application Fee details are not mentioned in the official notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 29/01/2026
Online Registration Start Date 29/01/2026 at 10:00 Hrs
Online Registration End Date 27/02/2026 at 23:59 Hrs
Age, Qualification and Experience as on 01/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates applying for the posts mentioned in the advertisement will be called for Personal Interview
  • MMRCL reserves the right to shortlist the Candidates for Personal Interview
  • The Candidates will be shortlisted for interview, based on their eligibility/ experience in the relevant field
  • Candidate may be asked to submit any other documents required by the scrutiny committee and he/ she is liable to produce the same
  • Selection criteria are relaxable for deserving Candidates with very sound background on discretion of committee for Scrutiny/ Selection

General Information/Instructions

  • Age, qualification and experience would be as on 01st January 2026
  • In case of educational qualifications, in addition to an institute being approved by UGC/ AICTE; the particular Degree/ Diploma awarded by that institute is also required to be an approved Degree/ Diploma
  • While applying for the above post, the applicant should ensure that he/she fulfils the eligibility and the norms mentioned above on the specified dates and the particulars furnished by him/ her are correct in all respects
  • In case, it is detected at any stage of recruitment that Candidate does not fulfil the eligibility norms and /or that he/ she has furnished any incorrect/ false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), his/her candidature will stand cancelled
  • If any of these shortcomings is/ are detected even after appointment his/ her services are liable to be terminated
  • MMRCL reserves the right to change the number of vacancies and cancel/ restrict/ modify/ alter and modify the recruitment criteria's during the recruitment process if required, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason thereof
  • Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected
  • MMRCL is not responsible for Loss/ delay in post
  • MMRCL is not responsible for any printing error that might have inadvertently crept in
  • Candidates employed in Govt. Dept. / PSU/ Autonomous Body should forward their application through proper channel and must produce "NOC" from the present employer on the date of interview
  • No Travelling Allowances/ reimbursement will be paid to the candidate for appearing for Interview and pre-appointment medical examination
  • Number of vacancies may undergo change depending on the requirement
  • Reservations for PwBD candidates shall be applicable to Non-technical posts only
  • Reservations / Relaxation / Concessions would be given to SCs/STs/OBCs (Non-Creamy Layer)/ Person with Disability (PWD)/ Ex-Servicemen candidates as per guidelines issued by Govt. of India from time to time
  • Reservation for EWSs in direct recruitment is applicable as per DoPT OM No. 36039/1/ 2019- Esst. (Res), dated 31.01.2019
  • For deserving internal candidates, suitable relaxation in Age, work experience & post-qualification experience shall be considered

Note: MMRCL Surety & Training Cost Recovery Bond Policy is not applicable in case of appointment on deputation basis.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply online only through MMRCL official website: www.mmrcl.com ---> Careers --> MMRCL Recruitment Advertisement 2026-01 (No other modes of application will be accepted)
  • Candidates are required to have valid personal E-mail ID & Mobile No. It should be kept active during the recruitment process
  • MMRCL will send intimation of personal interview and any other information regarding your application only through the registered E-mail ID
  • The online registration will remain active from 29th January 2026 at 10:00 Hrs. and will end 27th February 2026 at 23:59 Hrs only

  • MMRCL will not be responsible for network problem or any other problem of this nature & non-submission of online application during the last days due to heavy rush
  • All the fields in the online application form should be filled up carefully. After submission of application, no modification will be permitted
  • Candidates will have to upload scan copy of updated Resume, and passport size photograph (.jpg/ .jpeg) and recent pay slip in .pdf format along with their application
  • Candidate are required to clearly indicate whether they are applying against the vacancy for consideration on Regular or Contract or Deputation basis
  • Candidates belonging to Government Sector are required to forward their application in prescribed format on postal address: Sr. Deputy General Manager (HR), Mumbai Metro Rail Corporation Limited, MMRCL – Line 3 Transit Office, E Block, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (East), Mumbai- 400051
  • Government sector candidates must submit: Latest Resume, photograph, all educational qualification certificates and all work experience certificates, No Objection Certificate, Attested copies of ACR's/APR's of last 05 years, Certificate stating that no vigilance case is either pending or contemplated against the officer, No Penalty Certificate stating that no major/ minor penalty has been imposed on the officer or a statement giving details of major/ minor penalties imposed on the officer, if any, during the last 10 years

Maharashtra.contentHtml:
CSIR Innovation Complex Mumbai has released an official notification for the recruitment of 10 Project Associate, Project Scientist And More Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Offline through the official CSIR website. The last date to submit the application form is 17-02-2026. In this article, you’ll find the CSIR Project Associate, Project Scientist And More Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Offline application form.

CSIR Innovation Complex Mumbai Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Council of Scientific and Industrial Research - Innovation Complex Mumbai
Post Name Project Associate-II, Senior Project Associate, Project Scientist-I, Project Scientist-III
No of Posts 10
Salary Rs. 28,000/- to Rs. 78,000/- + HRA (depending on position and qualification)
Qualification Master’s Degree / Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Technology / Doctoral Degree in relevant fields with experience
Age Limit 35 to 45 years (post-wise)
Last Date 17 February 2026
Official Website https://www.csir.res.in
Trending Govt Jobs
  • RBI 650 Assistant Online Form 2026
  • India Post GDS Online Form 2026
  • Aadhaar Operator Supervisor Online Form 2026
  • Indian Army Agniveer Recruitment Rally Notification 2026
  • RRB 22000 Group D Online form 2026

Vacancy Details

Name of Position Number of Positions
Project Associate-II (Bioanalytical) One (01)
Project Associate-II (Pharmacokinetics & Metabolism) One (01)
Project Associate-II (Cell & Tissue Culture) One (01)
Project Associate-II (In-vitro Toxicology) One (01)
Senior Project Associate (ADME-PK) One (01)
Senior Project Associate (Analytical Chemistry) One (01)
Senior Project Associate (IT) One (01)
Project Scientist-I (Bioanalysis) One (01)
Project Scientist-I (Business Development) One (01)
Project Scientist-III (ADME-PK/Toxicology) One (01)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Varies by position – Master’s/Integrated Master’s Degree, Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering/Technology/Medicine, or Doctoral Degree in relevant fields such as Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Computer Sciences, etc.
  • Essential Qualification: Includes specific educational qualifications with 2 to 7 years of experience in research & development in industrial/academic institutions or science & technology organizations (post-wise details apply).
  • Desirable Qualification: Hands-on experience in ADME-PK/Tox studies, operation of instruments (LC-MS/MS, HPLC, etc.), cell culture, in-vitro toxicology assays, regulatory guidelines knowledge, business development, IT database/network management, etc. (as specified for each post).
  • Experience: 2 to 7 years in relevant research & development areas (as per position requirements).

Salary/ Stipend

  • Project Associate-II: (a) Rs. 35,000/- + HRA (for NET/GATE qualified or equivalent) (b) Rs. 28,000/- + HRA (for others)
  • Senior Project Associate: Rs. 42,000/- + HRA
  • Project Scientist-I: Rs. 56,000/- + HRA (Increment of 5% for every 2 years of experience in the same project)
  • Project Scientist-III: Rs. 78,000/- + HRA (Increment of 5% for every 2 years of experience in the same project)

Age Limit (as on last date of application)

  • Project Associate-II positions: 35 Years
  • Senior Project Associate positions: 40 Years
  • Project Scientist-I positions: 35 Years
  • Project Scientist-III position: 45 Years
  • Age relaxation as per Government of India norms: Up to 5 years for SC/ST, PwBD, female candidates; 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)

Important Dates

Last Date to Apply 17 February 2026
Interview Date (Tentative) 02 March 2025

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting based on essential and desirable qualifications
  • Interview for shortlisted candidates

General Information / Instructions

  • Engagement is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project; no claim for permanent CSIR post
  • Project duration: 3 years; initial engagement 1 year, extendable based on performance
  • Location: Mumbai
  • Final year/semester students awaiting results are not eligible
  • Original certificates required for verification at interview
  • The Head, CSIR-Innovation Complex reserves the right to cancel or modify the notification
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate
  • Travel may be required as per project needs

How to Apply

  • Submit applications by email to [email protected] on or before 17 February 2026
  • Download and fill the application form available at www.csir.res.in
  • Send scanned copy of filled form along with qualifying degree
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview tentatively on 02 March 2025
  • Bring original certificates, self-attested copies, bio-data, and printout of application at interview
  • Reserved category candidates must bring original category certificates
  • No TA/DA for attending interview
  • If employed, furnish No-Objection Certificate from current employer at joining
  • For queries, email to [email protected]

Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official Exim Bank website. The last date to submit the application form is 22-02-2026. In this article, you’ll find the Exim Bank Deputy Managers Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

India Exim Bank Deputy Managers (Banking Operations) Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Export-Import Bank of India (India Exim Bank)
Post Name Deputy Managers (Banking Operations)
No of Posts 20
Salary ₹ 48480-2000-62480-2340-67160-2680-85920
Qualification Minimum 60% aggregate marks / equivalent Cumulative Grade Points Average (CGPA), in Graduation. The graduation course should be of a minimum 3-year full time duration. Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade or Chartered Accountant (CA). In case of CA, passing the professional examination is sufficient. Membership of ICAI is mandatory. The University / Institute should be recognised / approved by Government / AICTE / UGC
Age Limit 21 to 28 years
Start Date 26 January 2026
Last Date 22 February 2026
Official Website eximbankindia.in

  • RBI 650 Assistant Online Form 2026
  • India Post GDS Online Form 2026
  • Aadhaar Operator Supervisor Online Form 2026
  • Indian Army Agniveer Recruitment Rally Notification 2026
  • RRB 22000 Group D Online form 2026

Vacancy Details

Position Total
Deputy Managers (Banking Operations) 20

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Minimum 60% aggregate marks / equivalent Cumulative Grade Points Average (CGPA), in Graduation. The graduation course should be of a minimum 3-year full time duration.
  • Essential Qualification: Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade or Chartered Accountant (CA). Post Graduation course should be of a minimum 2-year full time duration, with a specialization in Finance with minimum 60% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA. In case of CA, passing the professional examination is sufficient. Membership of ICAI is mandatory. The University / Institute should be recognised / approved by Government / AICTE / UGC. The candidates having completed their graduation and postgraduation courses through correspondence/part-time/open university/open learning/external/distance learning are not eligible.
  • Experience: Minimum 01 year of Post Qualification (Post Graduation or Chartered Accountant) work experience in a reputed commercial bank/financial institution/state level term lending institution, with skills in project finance, credit appraisal, term lending, analysis of cross-border risks and financing of overseas joint-ventures.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Deputy Manager (I): ₹ 48480-2000-62480-2340-67160-2680-85920
  • In addition to the pay, officers will be eligible for allowances, perquisites and benefits, as applicable to the Grade as per Bank’s rules, prevalent at the time of joining. Residential accommodation may be provided subject to availability or alternatively leased accommodation scheme is in place. Schemes for granting loans for housing, vehicle, personal computer, children education etc. are also available.

Age Limit (as on 31-12-2025)

  • Not below 21 years and not above 28 years as on December 31, 2025.
  • Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe (SC/ST): 33 Years
  • Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer): 31 Years
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - PwBD (SC/ ST): 43 Years
  • PwBD (OBC-NCL): 41 Years
  • PwBD (UR/ EWS): 38 Years

Application Fee

  • ₹ 600/- for General and OBC candidates
  • ₹ 100/- (Intimation charges) for SC/ST/ PwBD /EWS and Female candidates

Important Dates

Website link opens 26 January 2026
Last day for applying and payment of Examination fee 22 February 2026
Tentative month of Written Examination February 2026

Selection Process

  • The Selection Process will comprise Written test and Personal Interview.
  • Candidates who are shortlisted based on the performance in the Written test will be called for Personal Interview.
  • Final list shall be drawn based on overall performance of the candidate in Written examination and interviews. The marks obtained in written examination out of [Out of 100 with 70% weightage] and Interview [Out of 100 with 30% weightage] shall form the basis for final selection.

General Information / Instructions

  • Reservation for Economically Weaker Section (EWS) in recruitment is governed by Office Memorandum no. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dt. 31.01.2019 of Department of Personnel & Training, Ministry of Personnel (DoPT), Public Grievance & Pensions, Government of India. EWS vacancies are tentative and subject to further directives of Government of India and outcome of any litigation. The appointment is provisional and is subject to the income & Asset certificate being verified through the proper channels. Benefit of reservation under EWS category can be availed upon production of an ‘Income and Asset Certificate’ issued by a Competent Authority in the format prescribed by Government of India. Candidates may please note that they should be in possession of Income and Assets Certificate as mentioned above issued on or after 01.04.2025 and before the date of document verification at the time of interview. Candidates qualifying for interview under EWS category would be required to submit EWS certificate, at the time of interview. In case candidates fail to produce the same at the time of interview, they will not be allowed to appear for interview. Further, their request for interview under General category will also not be entertained.
  • NOTE: Reservations are applicable as per prevailing Government of India (GoI) guidelines.
  • All the eligibility [age, educational qualification etc.] shall be computed as mentioned in subsequent paragraphs.
  • Candidates should possess excellent communication skills and should be proficient in the use of computers and information technology.
  • Candidates from Universities / Institutes awarding degrees based on ratings / grades other than numerical marks (i.e. CGPA/GPA/any other form), may please note that if the equivalent aggregate percentage of marks is not mentioned in the mark sheet/certificate, candidates are required to furnish a letter from the head of the Institute / Controller of Examination of the University, stating clearly, the methodology of conversion of the grades into percentage (conversion formula) and the numerical marks equivalent to their rating/grades.
  • The University / Institute should be recognised / approved by Government / AICTE / UGC. The candidates having completed their graduation and postgraduation courses through correspondence/part-time/open university/open learning/external/distance learning are not eligible.
  • Reservation for candidates belonging to reserved category will be in accordance with the prevailing GoI guidelines. Candidates must state their reservation status clearly in the application. Applicants should produce in original their degree certificates, caste, experience and any other relevant certificates at the time of interview/ at any stage of the subsequent process.
  • 10% reservation in direct recruitment in civil posts and services in GoI is provided to the persons belonging to EWS, who are not covered under the scheme of reservation for SCs, STs and OBCs. The benefit of reservation under EWS can be availed upon production of an Income and Asset Certificate issued by a Competent Authority.
  • Relaxations are provided to the candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC and for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs) category. As per DOPT circular no. 36034/2/2013 dated April 08, 2013, in direct recruitment by way of All India Competitive Examination, the maximum relaxation of 5 years in upper age limit is allowed to Ex-servicemen for appointment in Group A (i.e., Officers cadre).
  • For candidates belonging to OBC category, certificate should specifically contain a clause that the candidate does not belong to creamy layer section and is excluded from the benefits of the reservation for other backward classes in civil posts and services under Government of India. OBC caste certificate containing the Non-Creamy layer clause should be valid as on the last date of applying (issued within one year prior to the last date for applying). Caste name mentioned in certificate should tally letter by letter with Central Government list/notification.
  • Candidates belonging to OBC category but coming under creamy layer and/or if their caste does not find place in the Central List are not entitled to OBC reservation. They should indicate their category as General in the application form.
  • The selected candidates will be posted anywhere in India, depending on the requirement of the Bank. Therefore, only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply.
  • Selected candidates may also be transferred to offices outside India with their consent.
  • All the educational qualifications mentioned above should be from a University / Institution / Board recognized by Govt. of India / approved by Govt. Regulatory Bodies. In case the date of passing is not properly mentioned in the mark- sheet or provisional certificate, proper document from Board / University indicating the date of declaration of results has to be submitted at the time of interview. In case the result of a particular examination is posted on the website of the University / Institute and web-based certificate is issued, then proper document / certificate in original issued and signed by the appropriate authority of the University / Institute indicating the date of passing that examination properly mentioned thereon will be reckoned for verification and further process
  • Only those who satisfy the required age and qualification criteria should apply. Applications that do not meet with the requirements will be rejected and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
  • Interested candidates must fill in an Online Application Form. The application link will be live from January 26, 2026. Application in any other format will not be considered and will be rejected by the Bank, irrespective of fulfilling the eligibility criteria. Only Online Applications will be considered by the Bank. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • Applicants are requested to ensure their eligibility before applying for any post. Fees once paid will not be refunded in case the applicant is not found to be eligible for the said post.
  • The date and timing of the Written test will be advised to the eligible candidates at a later date by notification on our website, personal email and/or SMS.
  • Depending upon the requirement and suitability of the candidates, the Bank reserves the right to cancel/restrict/curtail/enlarge the recruitment process including the number of vacancies, if need so arises, without any further notice and without assigning any reason therefor.
  • No correspondence will be entertained from any ineligible and non-selected candidate. In all matters regarding eligibility, the selection process, the stages at which the scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, documents to be produced for the selection process, assessment, prescribing minimum qualifying standards in the selection process, number of vacancies, communication of results, etc., the Bank’s decision shall be final and binding on the candidates and no correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.
  • Selected candidates, who are already in service must produce a proper relieving letter / discharge certificate in original from their present employer at the time of joining, failing which they shall not be allowed to join the Bank.
  • Selected candidates (Deputy Managers), at the time of joining the Bank, will have to execute a personal bond for ₹ 3 lakh to serve the Bank for a minimum period of 5 years from the date of joining the Bank.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim / dispute arising out of this advertisement and / or an application in response thereto can be instituted only in Mumbai and courts / tribunals / forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction to try any clause / dispute.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

General Instructions for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Application Rules:

  • ONE application per candidate - Multiple applications will lead to rejection of ALL applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams
  • Choose only ONE RRB/Railway Zone (cannot be changed later)
  • Indicate post preferences within chosen Railway Zone
  • Partial options allowed (will be considered only for opted posts)
  • No change in preferences after submission
  • Online application only through official RRB websites (listed in Para 24.0)

Identity Authentication:

  • Strongly advised to authenticate using DigiLocker or Aadhaar during account creation
  • Aadhaar-seeded bank account mandatory for fee refund
  • Candidates using alternate Photo IDs will face stricter scrutiny at all stages

Account Creation:

  • If already created account for CEN 2024/2025, use same credentials
  • Valid mobile number and email ID mandatory (will remain unchanged throughout recruitment)
  • Details in 'Create an Account' form CANNOT be modified

Application Modification:

  • Allowed from 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Fee: Rs. 250/- per modification (non-refundable)
  • Can modify any number of times (except 'Create Account' details and Chosen Railway)
  • If changing from SC/ST to UR/OBC/EWS or from ExSM/Female/PwBD to non-reserved: Pay fee difference (Rs. 250/-) in addition to modification fee
  • No modifications entertained after 14.03.2026

Live Photo & Signature Upload:

  • Live Photo: Captured during application (NOT pre-existing photo)
  • Stand/sit in front of camera at eye level, face centered, neutral expression
  • Non-white clothing (preferably dark colors), no cap/mask/glasses
  • Applications with blurred/non-compliant photos liable for rejection
  • Signature: Running handwriting in black ink on white paper (scanned)
  • NO BLOCK/CAPITAL/DISJOINTED LETTERS
  • JPG/JPEG format, 30-49 KB, 140×60 pixels minimum
  • Signature must match at all stages (CBT/DV/ME/Appointment)

Scribe Facility (for eligible PwBD candidates):

  • Eligible: Blindness, Locomotor Disability (Both Arms - BA), Cerebral Palsy
  • Others: Only with certificate from CMO/Civil Surgeon (Annexure V-G)
  • PwBD <40% with writing difficulty: Certificate as per Annexure V-E required
  • Scribe must register at rrbapply.gov.in (One-Time Registration - OTR)
  • Candidate must enter scribe's OTR number during 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026 window
  • Scribe qualification: ONE step below candidate's qualification
  • One scribe per candidate; scribe cannot be a candidate in same CEN
  • Compensatory time: 20 minutes per hour of examination

Examination Centers:

  • Allocated based on technical/logistical feasibility
  • Candidates may have to travel to other cities/states
  • No change of center/date/shift allowed

Banned Items at Exam Center:

  • Mobile phones, pagers, watches, earphones, Bluetooth devices, microphones, health bands
  • Calculators, books, pen, paper, pencil, eraser, pouch, scale, writing pad
  • Belts, handbags, caps, purses, cameras, water bottles, food items
  • ONLY e-call letter allowed inside test center
  • Pen will be provided during exam
  • No cloak room - advised not to bring valuables
  • Do not apply henna on hands/feet (obstructs biometric capture)

Important Warnings:

  • Debarment for life if found using unfair means, impersonation, forgery, misbehavior
  • Provisions of "The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024" applicable
  • Comprehensive post-exam analysis (log analysis, photo/biometric verification, CCTV review)
  • Beware of touts and fake websites - RRBs NEVER appoint agents/coaching centers
  • Selection purely on merit

How to Apply for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Step 1: Create an Account (if not already created)

  • Visit official RRB website from the list at Para 24.0
  • Click on "Create an Account" link
  • Authenticate using DigiLocker/Aadhaar (strongly recommended)
  • Enter valid mobile number and email ID (CANNOT be changed later)
  • Complete OTP verification
  • Create login credentials

Step 2: Fill Online Application

  • Login with created credentials
  • Select CEN 09/2025
  • Choose ONE RRB/Railway Zone (CANNOT be changed)
  • Fill personal details, educational qualifications
  • Select post preferences within chosen Railway
  • Choose examination language (English/Hindi/Regional)
  • Capture live photograph using webcam/mobile camera
  • Upload scanned signature (JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, black ink, running handwriting)
  • Upload SC/ST certificate (if claiming free travel pass)
  • Indicate scribe requirement (if applicable)
  • Verify all details carefully

Step 3: Pay Application Fee

  • Select payment mode: Internet Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI
  • Pay Rs. 500/- (General/EWS/OBC-NCL Male) or Rs. 250/- (SC/ST/PwBD/Female/ExSM/Transgender/Minorities/EBC)
  • Complete payment (all service charges borne by candidate)
  • Save payment receipt

Step 4: Final Submission

  • After successful payment, application will be accepted
  • Receive confirmation via SMS and email
  • Download and save final application form
  • Note Application Number for future reference

Step 5: Modification (if required)

  • Window: 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Login and modify details (except Create Account info & Chosen Railway)
  • Pay Rs. 250/- per modification
  • Pay additional fee if changing from reserved to unreserved category

Step 6: Enter Scribe Details (if applicable)

  • Window: 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026
  • Login to application portal
  • Enter scribe's OTR number
  • Enter OTP sent to scribe's mobile to confirm

Documents to Upload:

  1. Live photograph (captured during application)
  2. Signature (scanned - JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, running handwriting)
  3. SC/ST certificate (PDF, <400 KB) - if claiming free travel pass

Documents Required at DV (Original + 2 self-attested photocopies):

  • 10th/Matriculation certificate (for age & education)
  • ITI/NAC certificate (if applicable)
  • SC/ST certificate (Annexure-I)
  • OBC-NCL certificate (Annexure-II) - issued on/after 01.04.2025
  • OBC-NCL self-declaration (Annexure-II A)
  • EWS certificate (Annexure-III) - valid for 2025-26, based on F.Y. 2024-25
  • EBC certificate (Annexure-III A) / BPL card / Izzat MST (if claimed fee concession)
  • Minority affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper (Annexure-IV)
  • PwBD certificate (Annexure V-A/V-B) with UDID
  • ExSM certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • ExSM declaration (Annexure VI)
  • ExSM NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) - if serving
  • CCAA - NAC certificate from NCVT
  • LASIK declaration (Annexure-VII) - for A2/A3 posts
  • NOC from employer (if Govt. employee)
  • Caste change certificates (if name differs from 10th certificate)
  • Medical certificates (for scribe eligibility - Annexure V-E/V-F/V-G)

  • Desirable Qualification: Candidates having Post Graduation in relevant field of Electrical / Electrical & Electronics / Mechanical Engineering will have added advantage. Possession of Rolling Stock project management certification and handling project related works will be an added advantage.
  • Experience: Should have a minimum of 4 years of experience in planning, designing, technical specifications/bid preparation, testing, commissioning, operation and maintenance of rolling stock in Railway / RRTS / Metro / LRT / HSR / Suburban rail system as Executive in any government / PSU organization.
  • Experience: For Additional General Manager (Rolling Stock), Applicants from Government organizations, Metro Rail, Railway PSUs, or other PSUs must have minimum 10 years of post-qualification work experience and working in analogous Grade Rs.100000-260000 (IDA E7)/equivalent CDA pay scale or working in Grade Rs.90000-240000 (IDA E6)/equivalent CDA pay scale with minimum 2 years in E6.
  • Experience: For Jt. General Manager (Rolling Stock), Applicants from Government organizations, Metro Rail, Railway PSUs, or other PSUs must have minimum 08 years of post-qualification work experience and working in analogous Grade Rs.90000-240000 (IDA E6)/equivalent CDA pay scale or working in Grade Rs.80000-220000 (IDA E5)/equivalent CDA pay scale with minimum 2 years in E5.
  • Experience: For Deputy General Manager (Rolling Stock), Applicants from Government organizations, Metro Rail, Railway PSUs, or other PSUs must have minimum 06 years of post-qualification work experience and working in analogous Grade Rs.80000-220000 (IDA E5)/equivalent CDA pay scale or working in Grade Rs.70000-200000 (IDA E4)/equivalent CDA pay scale with minimum 2 years in E4.
  • Experience: The candidates working in reputed Private Sector companies and consultancy firms in managerial position having minimum 06/08/10 years and above overall post qualification working experience for DGM/JGM/AGM respectively with minimum 4 years in planning, tendering, designing, testing & commissioning, operation, maintenance of rolling stock and drawing CTC of minimum Rs.180000/- p.m. They will be considered for AGM/JGM/DGM as per their length of experience and expertise in the relevant field.

Salary/ Stipend

  • The selected candidates will be posted as AGM/JGM/DGM (Rolling Stock) as the case may be on contract basis initially for a period of 5 years which can be extended at the sole discretion of the company. He/she shall be paid IDA Pay Scale fixing at minimum of the pay scale plus other allowances such as DA/HRA/Cafeteria of Allowances etc. as per HR policy of MRVC.
  • Pay Protection will be given only to candidates working in Govt./Semi Govt./PSU Organisations (including on contract).
  • There will be annual increment in salary with satisfactory performance certified by controlling HOD.
  • The other entitlements are – medical, Sodexo meal coupon, Leave Travel Concession, Birthday Gift, annual award, if any, reimbursement for laptop/mobile phone etc as per the policy of the corporation and Gratuity as per the Gratuity Act.

Age Limit (as on 28-02-2026)

  • Maximum Age limit as on closing date: 50 years

Important Dates

Notification Date 29 January 2026
Last Date for Submission of Application 28 February 2026
Cut-off Date for Eligibility 28 February 2026

Selection Process

  • After preliminary screening of the applications received from candidates by mail, the eligible candidate(s) will only be called for document verification and interaction.
  • In case of large number of eligible applications received, then candidates equal to 05 times the notified vacancies will only be called for document verification and interaction based on their experience.
  • The candidate will be interviewed by a nominated Committee and the selection will be finalized on merit based on the performance in the interview, qualification and post qualification experience gained by the Candidate.
  • The overall qualifying marks shall be minimum 60%. The candidates must qualify with minimum 60% marks in the personal interview.
  • The decision of the Nominated Committee of MRVC shall be final and binding.
  • Panel of standby candidates over and above requirement will be maintained as per merit as decided by MRVC. Such candidates may be engaged as per requirements of MRVC projects within the validity of panel. Posts notified are not regular establishment posts.
  • The candidate selected for the above contractual agreement shall not be absorbed in MRVC regular service. The candidate therefore shall not have right to claim for permanent absorption in MRVC and shall be required to give an undertaking in writing to MRVC to that effect.

General Information/ Instructions

  • The candidates must bring with them original application, original certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopy in proof of photo identity, age, caste, educational and experience on the date of document verification and interaction, failing which candidate will not be eligible for interview.
  • Candidate should bring one character certificate from Gazetted Officers/Executives Officers for certifying that he is bearing good moral character.
  • Incomplete or vague educational qualification will be invalid.
  • Even after contractual agreement, if any document/ certificate/ information are found incorrect or false in any scrutiny or verification, then the contractual service will be immediately terminated forthwith without assigning any reason and prior notice, besides legal action which may also be initiated.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to cancel/ restrict/ curtail/ enlarge the contract engagement process, if need so arises, without any prior notice and without assigning any reasons therefore.
  • No train/bus fare/ TA/DA shall be payable by the Corporation to the candidates for appearing document verification and interaction.
  • The selected candidates should be able to join at the project site within maximum 45 days after issuing of offer of appointment by MRVC. Any deviation in the said policy will be dealt on case to case basis, based on the merits of the case.
  • Officials serving Govt./PSUs / Autonomous Bodies, if selected, will be allowed to join only after they are properly relieved from their parent organisation.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to terminate the contract if the contract appointee is found unsuitable, by giving one month notice or payment in lieu thereof. Similarly, the appointee will be required to give one month notice to MRVC for termination of contract.
  • The selected candidate on engagement should also attend emergencies and other calls of duties, as demanded and expected, during their day to day activities.
  • In the event the appointee is found involved in undesirable activities such as embezzlement, unlawful activities (including passing on confidential information of MRVC), unauthorized absence, in-subordination or breach of any of the terms of contract without prejudice to the right to initiate civil/criminal proceedings, the contract appointment shall be terminated.
  • Selected candidates shall use electronic resources of MRVC in strict adherence to the policies and guidelines issued by MRVC from time to time. The email account and user ID's created for official purposes shall always be used in a responsible, effective, ethical and lawful manner. Any misuse of these resources and / or putting the Corporation at risk of any liability based on such misuse shall result in termination of employment and appropriate legal action.

How to Apply

  • Duly filled in application should be sent to Senior Manager (HR), Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. by email on [email protected].
  • Last date for submission of application by mail is 28.02.2026.
  • Applications should be complete in all respects and strictly as per the prescribed format (Annexure-I). Applications not conforming to the prescribed format or having illegible/ambiguous certificates or without certificates or incomplete will be summarily rejected.
  • The cut-off date for eligibility is 28.02.2026.
  • Self-attested documents to be attached with the filled application: Copy of original application, Copies of certificate in proof of qualification (As per the qualification specified in Notification), Copy of Proof of Date of Birth (SSLC/SSC Certificate/Birth Certificate), Copy of Photo ID proof (Aadhar/Pan Card), Copy of document regarding experience, last served and others, Character certificate from Gazetted officer/Executive officers for certifying that he/she is bearing good moral character not older than six months.
  • Copy of employment letter issued by previous as well as present employer, Copy of Form 16 issued by previous / present employer, Copy of document indicating Employees Provident Fund (EPF) Number/PF Number.

Eligibility Criteria for HPSC HCS & Allied Services Recruitment 2026

Selection Process for HPSC HCS & Allied Services Recruitment 2026

The examination consists of 3 successive stages:

Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (Screening Only)

Total Marks: 200

Paper Subject Marks Duration
Paper-I General Studies (Merit basis) 100 2 hours
Paper-II Civil Services Aptitude Test (Qualifying) 100 2 hours

Key Points:

  • Both papers: Objective type (Multiple Choice Questions)
  • Bilingual: English and Hindi
  • Duration: 2 hours each
  • Negative Marking: 0.25 marks deducted for each wrong answer
  • Paper-II is qualifying with minimum 33% marks required
  • Merit list based on Paper-I marks only (if candidate scores 33% in Paper-II)
  • Candidates 12 times the advertised vacancies (including bracketed) will be called for Main Examination
  • Preliminary marks NOT counted towards final selection
  • Syllabus available on HPSC official website

Stage 2: Main Written Examination

Total Marks: 600

Paper Subject Marks Duration
Paper-I English (including English Essay) 100 3 hours
Paper-II Hindi (including Hindi Essay) - Devnagri Script 100 3 hours
Paper-III General Studies-I 100 3 hours
Paper-IV General Studies-II 100 3 hours
Paper-V General Studies-III 100 3 hours
Paper-VI General Studies-IV 100 3 hours

Key Points:

  • Conventional (essay) type papers
  • Duration: 3 hours each
  • Answers in Hindi or English (except language papers)
  • General Studies papers: Either Hindi OR English (not both in same paper)
  • Candidates must write in own hand (scribe allowed for VH/OH with permission)
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks:
    • 45% aggregate in all papers (35% for PwBD candidates if sufficient candidates not available)
    • Minimum 33% each in English and Hindi papers
  • Candidates 3 times the advertised posts (including bracketed) will be called for Personality Test
  • Syllabus available on HPSC official website

Stage 3: Personality Test/Viva-voce

Marks: 75

  • Candidates 3 times advertised posts called for interview
  • Assessment of suitability for public service career
  • Qualities judged: Mental alertness, critical powers, clear exposition, judgment balance, social traits, current affairs interest, leadership ability, intellectual and moral integrity
  • Natural, directed, and purposive conversation (not strict cross-examination)

Final Merit & Selection

  • Total Marks: 675 (Main Written: 600 + Viva-voce: 75)
  • Final selection based on total marks and preference of services exercised by candidates
  • If candidates have equal marks: Higher marks in Main Written papers considered, then older age
  • No rechecking/revaluation of answer sheets

General Instructions for HPSC HCS & Allied Services Recruitment 2026

Service Preference:

  • Candidates can apply for all or any services/posts as advertised
  • Preference to be submitted online at time of application
  • No change in preference allowed at any stage
  • Reserved category candidates can also apply for General category posts if fulfilling all conditions

Important Conditions:

  • Candidates must be Indian citizens (or as per specified nationalities)
  • Reservation benefits only for Haryana domiciles
  • BC-A/BC-B candidates must belong to Non-Creamy Layer (as per notification dated 16.07.2024)
  • EWS certificate valid for 2025-26 required
  • BC-A/BC-B NCL certificates must be issued during April 2025 to March 2026
  • All SC candidates must have latest DSC/OSC certificate (as per notification dated 13.11.2024)
  • Women candidates: Caste certificate from father's side only (not husband's side)
  • ESM/DESM/DFF certificates must be valid on closing date
  • Haryana Govt. employees who executed bond must provide NOC
  • PwBD candidates with 40%+ disability eligible for benefits

PwBD Candidates - Scribe & Extra Time:

  • Extra time: 20 minutes per hour for Blind/Low vision/Locomotor disability
  • Candidates must arrange own scribe
  • Scribe should be student up to 10+2 level
  • Written request for scribe/extra time at least 5 days before examination
  • Medical certificate from Medical Board required

Examination Rules:

  • Mobile phones, pagers, electronic devices, smart watches, cameras, Bluetooth devices strictly prohibited (even in switched-off mode)
  • Use of unfair means, impersonation, misbehavior will lead to disqualification and criminal prosecution
  • Penalty provisions of Haryana Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2021 applicable
  • Commission's decision on eligibility, selection is final

How to Apply for HPSC HCS & Allied Services Recruitment 2026

Four-Stage Online Application Process:

Stage 1: Registration

  • Step 1: Visit official website: http://hpsc.gov.in
  • Step 2: Register using Mobile Number & Aadhaar Number (or Mobile Number if Aadhaar not updated)
  • Step 3: Create Login ID and Password
  • Step 4: Login credentials will be sent to registered email

Stage 2: Filling Application Form

  • Step 1: Login with registered Email ID and Password
  • Step 2: Read instructions carefully
  • Step 3: Fill all required details:
    • Post selection with preference
    • Personal details (Name, Father/Mother name, DOB, Category)
    • Educational qualifications with marks and passing year
    • Experience details (if applicable)
    • Aadhaar Number/Virtual ID (for biometric attendance)
  • Step 4: Upload documents (see list below)

Stage 3: Payment of Fee

  • Pay application fee online through Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card
  • Payment deadline: 26.02.2026 up to 05:00 PM

Stage 4: Final Submission

  • Step 1: After payment, take printout of application form
  • Step 2: Check all details carefully
  • Step 3: Sign the printout at bottom right corner
  • Step 4: Upload signed application form online
  • Step 5: Take final printout of uploaded signed application
  • Step 6: Keep hard copy for interview/document verification

IMPORTANT: Applications without uploaded signed copy will be treated as incomplete and summarily rejected.

Documents to be Uploaded:

  1. Scanned photograph of candidate
  2. Scanned signature of candidate
  3. Scanned copies of educational degrees and marksheets
  4. Certificate of mental and physical fitness (for DSP - issued by Standing Medical Board)
  5. DSC/OSC certificate of Haryana (as per notification dated 13.11.2024)
  6. BC-A/BC-B (NCL) certificate issued during 2025-26 (as per notification dated 16.07.2024)
  7. EWS certificate valid for 2025-26 (as per instruction dated 25.02.2019)
  8. DESM certificate for 2025-26
  9. ESM/DFF certificate
  10. PwBD Certificate (for PwBD candidates)
  11. Aadhaar Card
  12. Haryana Resident/Domicile Certificate (if availing reservation benefits)
  13. Experience Certificate (for age relaxation as per letter dated 25.03.2022)
  14. NOC from Department (for Haryana Govt. employees who signed bond)
  15. Proof of adhoc/contract/work-charged/daily wage work (for age relaxation claimants)
  16. Disability Certificate (for Disabled ESM)

Important Points:

  • No other mode of application accepted (only online)
  • Carefully enter all details - no changes allowed after submission
  • Keep Application Number for future reference
  • Multiple applications: Only application with highest/latest number considered
  • Fee paid against one application not adjustable to another
  • Ensure mobile number and email ID remain active till selection completion
  • Check application carefully before final submission
  • Incomplete/defective applications will be summarily rejected

Eligibility Criteria

Team Leader (Safety) - CP/01/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise buildings/KWA projects/Irrigation/shore protection/Harbour projects with experience of managing and working in the field of health and safety
  • Essential: Candidates should hold OSHA or NEBOSH certification

Team Leader (Civil) - CP/02/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise buildings/KWA Projects with experience in handling engineering aspects including interface coordination

Team Leader (MEP) - CP/03/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent OR Full time Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise building projects/KWA projects with experience in handling engineering and overall coordination
  • Essential: Should have a good knowledge in Electrical/HVAC/Fire fighting ELV & Plumbing system including interface coordination

Team Leader (QC) - CP/04/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise building projects/KWA projects with experience in the field of quality control
  • Essential: Shall possess experience in quality assurance/control, auditing design projects, developing QMS, and inspection/testing/product conformity. The concerned should be a Certified Quality Auditor (CQA)

Project Engineer (Civil) - CP/05/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience in Building/water supply/shore protection works/waterways/irrigation/Harbour, etc.

Project Engineer (MEP) - CP/06/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent OR Full time Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience in Electrical/HVAC/Fire fighting ELV & Plumbing system including interface coordination

Junior Engineer (Civil) - CL/01/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering OR Full Time Diploma in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience for diploma holders and 05 years for degree holders, with specific experience in relevant project category (Building/water supply/shore protection works/waterways/irrigation/Harbour)

Junior Engineer (MEP) - CL/02/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent OR Full Time Diploma in Engineering in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience for diploma holders and 05 years for degree holders, in electrical Engineering with specific experience in relevant project category (Building/water supply/shore protection works/waterways/irrigation/Harbour Electrical/HVAC/Fire Fighting, ELV & Plumbing systems)

Important Notes on Qualification

  • The period of training/internship/teaching/academic/fellowship/PhD research experience shall not be counted towards post qualification experience
  • The candidate should possess Degree recognized by AICTE; from a University incorporated by an Act of Central or State legislature in India or other Educational Institutions established by an Act of Parliament or declared to be Deemed as University under Section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956
  • Sections A & B examinations of the Institution of Engineers (India), with enrolment on or before 31.05.2013, which is treated as equivalent to Degree by the Government of India and recognized by AICTE shall be accepted
  • Experience shall be calculated as on 26.02.2026

Salary/Stipend

For Team Leaders (CP/01/26 to CP/04/26)

  • Pay Scale: Rs. 70,000 - Rs. 2,00,000
  • Approximate CTC: Rs. 19.85 Lakhs Per Annum
  • Components: Basic pay and DA, fixed/variable allowances 23% of Basic Pay, HRA/Lease, Contribution to PF, Gratuity as per Payment of Gratuity Act

For Project Engineers (CP/05/26 to CP/06/26)

  • Pay Scale: Rs. 50,000 – Rs. 1,60,000
  • Approximate CTC: Rs. 14.22 Lakhs Per Annum
  • Components: Basic pay and DA, fixed/variable allowances 23% of Basic Pay, HRA/Lease, Contribution to PF, Gratuity as per Payment of Gratuity Act

For Junior Engineers - Degree Holders (CL/01/26 & CL/02/26)

  • For 5 years minimum experience:
    • Monthly Basic Pay: Rs. 25,504
    • Gross Monthly Pay: Rs. 46,417
    • Yearly CTC: Rs. 5,57,008

For Junior Engineers - Diploma Holders (CL/01/26 & CL/02/26)

  • For 7 years minimum experience:
    • Monthly Basic Pay: Rs. 18,940
    • Gross Monthly Pay: Rs. 34,471
    • Yearly CTC: Rs. 4,13,651

Other Benefits (As per company rules applicable to contract employees)

  • Leaves
  • Maternity Leave
  • Medical facility
  • Accident/Death Insurance
  • Leave Encashment

Note: Remuneration mentioned above is only indicative. Actual remuneration shall depend upon place of posting and other terms & conditions of appointment.

Age Limit (as on 26.02.2026)

  • Maximum Age Limit: 55 years as on the last date of application i.e. 26.02.2026
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 years
  • Age Relaxation for OBC-NCL: 3 years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: 10 years; in addition to the age relaxation permissible for SC/ST/OBC-NCL category candidates, subject to the post being identified suitable for PWD
  • Note: Relaxation in upper age limit shall be applicable for PwBD candidates irrespective of the fact whether the post is reserved or not, provided the post is identified suitable for PwBDs
  • PWD candidates suffering from not less than 40% of the relevant disability shall only be eligible for the benefit of PWD

Application Fee

Category Fee Amount
General/OBC Candidates NIL
EWS/SC/ST/PWD Candidates NIL
