Important Dates

Event Date
Commencement of submission of online application 22.01.2026
Last date of submission of online application 26.02.2026
Walk-in Interview for CP/01/26 to CP/06/26 23.02.2026 & 24.02.2026
Walk-in Interview for CL/01/26 & CL/02/26 25.02.2026 to 27.02.2026
Reporting Time for Walk-in Interview 09:30 AM to 12:30 PM

Selection Process

  • All candidates who successfully submitted their online application form shall be provisionally allowed to appear for Document Scrutiny/verification process
  • The eligibility of the candidates with respect to the post applied will be verified during document scrutiny
  • Thereafter, the shortlisted/eligible candidates shall be allowed to appear for Interview
  • RITES Ltd. reserves the right to shortlist the number of candidates for selection out of eligible candidates
  • Weightage Distribution: Interview - 100%
    • Technical & Professional proficiency - 65%
    • Personality, Communication & Competency - 35%
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks:
    • 60% marks for UR/EWS in interview
    • 50% marks for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PWD against reserved posts in interview
  • There will be no minimum qualifying marks required in the aggregate
  • Interviews will be conducted on first come first served basis
  • Candidates can appear for Walk-in Interview at any one of the mentioned venues
  • Candidates have the option to appear for interview either in Hindi or English
  • Based on the requirement and discretion of RITES, the selection process may be conducted from RITES' Regional Offices

General Information/Instructions

  • The appointment shall be purely on contract basis initially for a period of one year, extendable until completion of the assignment subject to mutual consent and satisfactory performance
  • Selected candidates shall be liable for posting anywhere in India as per Company requirements
  • Instant recruitment is being done for deployment of personnel at client's site in the state of Kerala
  • Issuance of offer letter of engagement to the selected candidates shall be subject to approval of CV by the client
  • Appointment of selected candidates will be subject to their being found medically fit in the Medical Examination to be conducted as per RITES Rules and Standards of Medical Fitness for the relevant post
  • Reservation/relaxation/concessions to EWS/SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PWD/Ex-SM/J&K Domicile would be provided against reserved posts (where applicable) as per extant Govt. orders
  • Before applying, candidates should ensure that they satisfy the necessary conditions and requirements of the position
  • Community certificate (SC/ST/OBC) should be in the format prescribed by Government of India only
  • OBC candidates included in the Central List with certificate not more than 12 months old (with clear mention of candidate not belonging to "Creamy Layer") in the GOI prescribed format only will be considered
  • EWS certificate should also be as per Gov. of India format and must be for 2024-25 i.e. issued on or after 01.04.2024
  • Departmental candidates of RITES and candidates working in Government Departments/PSU shall be allowed to join RITES only after being properly relieved from their parent organization
  • If it is detected at any stage of recruitment that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he/she has furnished any incorrect/false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), his/her candidature is liable for cancellation
  • Management reserves the right to cancel/restrict/enlarge/modify/alter the selection/recruitment process at any stage, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason thereafter
  • The number of vacancies may vary
  • No train/bus fare/TA/DA shall be payable
  • Legal jurisdiction will be Delhi in case of any dispute
  • Any corrigendum/addendum to this advertisement will be displayed only on the Company's website www.rites.com

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria are required to apply online in the registration format available in the Career Section of RITES website, http://www.rites.com
  • While submitting the online application, the system would generate 'Registration No.' on top of online form. Note down this "Registration No." and quote it for all further communication with RITES Ltd.
  • While filling up the required details, candidates are advised to carefully and correctly fill the details of "Identity Proof"
  • After filling up the required details under the "Fill/Modify Application Form", candidate should submit the application
  • Keep a copy of Application Form submitted and carry the same at the time of the selection
  • A copy of online APPLICATION FORM containing the registration number is to be printed, signed, and retained
  • The same is to be submitted at the time of Scrutiny of Documents/Interview along with SELF-ATTESTED PHOTO COPIES of the following documents strictly in the following order:
    • 1 recent passport size colour photograph
    • A copy of updated CV/Resume
    • High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth
    • Certificates of Academic & Professional qualifications and statements of marks of all the qualifications for all semesters/years
    • EWS/SC/ST/OBC Certificate in the prescribed format by Govt. of India (if applicable)
    • Proof of Identity & Address (Passport, Voter ID, Driving license, Aadhaar Card etc)
    • PAN Card
    • Proof of different periods of experience as claimed in the Application Form
    • Any other document in support of your candidature
    • PWD Certificate as per latest format (if applicable)
  • No documents are to be submitted while submitting online application
  • Hard copies of documents are not to be sent to this office through post/courier
  • The original testimonials/documents along with one self-attested copy will have to be produced at the time of selection
  • Candidates should submit only one application for one vacancy and application once submitted cannot be altered
  • A valid e-mail ID is essential for submission of the online application
  • Candidate has to bring duly filled two copies of Annexure A, documents in chronological order and submit at the time of Document verification/Selection process
  • Queries should be sent to [email protected] with VC No., Registration/Roll No., Name of Candidate, and valid email address

Walk-in Interview Venues

  • Venue 1: RITES Ltd., Shikhar, Plot No. 1, Sector – 29, Near IFFCO Chowk Metro Station, Gurugram – 122001, Haryana
  • Venue 2: RITES LTD, Ground floor, Calsar Heather Punnen Road, Opposite Hilton Hotel, Statue, Thiruvananthapuram- 695001, Kerala

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess the following minimum educational qualification for the post of Deputy General Manager (Mech.) – Bulk Material Handling Expert (VC No. CP/07/26):

  • Full-time Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or
  • Full-time Bachelor’s Degree in Technology in Mechanical / Production / Production & Industrial / Manufacturing / Mechanical / Railways / Mechatronics & Automobile or any of the above combinations in part or whole.
  • Degree must be recognized by AICTE and obtained from a University incorporated by an Act of Central or State Legislature in India or other Educational Institutions established by an Act of Parliament or declared to be Deemed University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956.
  • Sections A & B examination of the Institution of Engineers (India), treated as equivalent to Degree by Govt. of India and recognized by AICTE, shall also be accepted.
  • UR/EWS candidates (and SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD applying against unreserved posts) must have first class degree / minimum 60% marks in the minimum qualification.
  • Reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD as applicable) should have at least 50% marks in the minimum qualification for consideration against reserved posts.

If the certificate/mark sheet does not indicate first class/division or percentage, candidates must provide the conversion formula issued by the concerned university/institution. Where no formula exists, an undertaking from the university/institution is required, and minimum 6 on 10-point scale will be considered as 60%.

2. Minimum Post-Qualification Experience

Candidates should have the following minimum post-qualification experience (post degree) for CP/07/26:

  • Minimum 09 years’ experience in designing and optimizing bulk material handling systems.
  • Ability to develop process flow diagrams, capacity calculations, and optimization studies.
  • Experience and proficiency in material handling systems such as conveyors, stackers, reclaimers, ship loaders/unloaders, silos, wagon tipplers, and rapid loading systems.
  • Proven capability in project lifecycle management from feasibility to commissioning.
  • Experience in cost estimation, budgeting and lifecycle analysis of CAPEX and OPEX.

The period of training (except on-the-job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship, and PhD research experience shall not be counted as part of experience.

3. Age Limit & Relaxations

  • Maximum age for UR: 50 years as on 08.03.2026.
  • SC/ST: Relaxation of 5 years in upper age limit.
  • OBC–NCL: Relaxation of 3 years in upper age limit.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): Relaxation of 10 years in addition to category relaxation, subject to post being identified suitable.

PwBD candidates will have to meet the physical requirements and functional classifications identified for Mechanical posts (Locomotor disability – OA/OL with specified physical requirements).

4. Nationality

Candidates must be eligible to work in India as per applicable laws and guidelines as implied in the notification.

Selection Process for RITES Deputy General Manager (Mech.) – Bulk Material Handling Expert 2026

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

  • Document Scrutiny/Verification: All candidates who have successfully submitted their online application will be provisionally allowed for document scrutiny/verification to determine eligibility with respect to the post applied.
  • Interview: Shortlisted and eligible candidates after document scrutiny shall be allowed to appear for Interview. RITES Ltd. reserves the right to shortlist candidates for selection out of eligible applicants.
  • Interview Weightage: 100% weightage to Interview (Technical & Professional proficiency – 65%; Personality, Communication & Competency – 35%).
  • Qualifying Marks in Interview: Minimum 60% marks for UR/EWS candidates and 50% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts are required for being considered for placement on panel. There is no minimum qualifying marks requirement in aggregate.
  • Medical Examination: Appointment will be subject to candidates being found medically fit as per RITES Rules and Standards of Medical Fitness for the relevant post.

Reservation/relaxation/concessions for EWS/SC/ST/OBC–NCL/PwBD/Ex-SM/J&K Domicile will be provided against reserved posts, wherever applicable, as per Government orders.

How To Apply

Eligible candidates can apply online for RITES Ltd. Deputy General Manager (Mech.) – Bulk Material Handling Expert 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official website: www.rites.com and go to the Career section.
  2. Open the online registration format under the relevant advertisement for VC No. CP/07/26.
  3. Fill the online application form carefully with correct personal, educational, experience and category details.
  4. Note down the system-generated Registration No. which appears on top of the online form and use it for all future communication with RITES Ltd.
  5. Enter details of “Identity Proof” correctly and ensure availability of the same document in original for later verification.
  6. Under the “Fill/Modify Application Form” section, complete all required fields and then upload all supporting documents in the “Upload Document” section.
  7. Upload mandatory documents including proof of date of birth, educational and professional qualifications with mark sheets, percentage conversion document (if applicable), category certificates, proof of identity and address, PAN card, and experience documents (offer letters, joining orders, relieving letters, service certificates, pay slips, etc.) in a single PDF in chronological order wherever required.
  8. After uploading documents, proceed to the “Make Payment” section and pay the applicable application fee online.
  9. On successful fee payment, download and save the final application form. Retain a printed copy of the application form for future reference and carry it along with self-attested copies of documents, if called for document verification/selection process.

Applications without successful fee payment will be treated as incomplete and will be summarily rejected. Hard copies of documents are not required to be sent by post/courier.

Documents to be uploaded/produced

  • High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth.
  • Certificates and mark sheets of all semesters/years for 10th, 12th, Diploma/Graduation/Post-Graduation (as applicable).
  • Percentage conversion document issued by the University/Institute (if applicable).
  • EWS/SC/ST/OBC–NCL/PwBD certificate in prescribed Government of India format (if applicable).

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

  • Comprehensive post-exam analysis (log analysis, photo/biometric verification, CCTV review)
  • Beware of touts and fake websites - RRBs NEVER appoint agents/coaching centers
  • Selection purely on merit

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification 

  • M.Tech. in Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) / Information Technology with minimum 60% marks from graduation onwards and minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade in Class 10th and 12th.
  • B.Tech./B.E./B.Sc./M.Sc./M.C.A. in Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) / Information Technology with minimum 60% marks or equivalent grade from graduation onwards and minimum 55% marks or equivalent grade in Class 10th and 12th.

Professional Experience

  • Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience in Software Development / Testing / QA (from the date of graduation onwards).

Age Limit

  • Maximum 35 years as on 31-12-2025.
  • Relaxation in age and/or educational qualifications may be considered for exceptionally meritorious candidates with prior approval of IIT Gandhinagar.

Required Skills & Competencies

Technical Skills (Required)

  • Strong knowledge of requirement analysis and documentation: URS 
  • Proven experience in manual testing of web and API applications.
  • Good understanding of usability, accessibility, and security compliance.
  • Proficiency in SQL/MySQL & MSSQL.
  • Familiarity with bug tracking / project management tools such as Jira.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

Additional / Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of automation tools (e.g., Selenium).
  • API testing using Postman and Swagger.
  • Experience with Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Defect Life Cycle (DLC).
  • Contribution to process improvements and compliance standards.

Salary & Compensation

  • Post: IT Associate - II.
  • Salary Range: Rs. 50,000 - Rs. 78,000/- per month (consolidated).
  • Purely contract-based; exact salary depends on qualification, experience, and performance in selection process.

Job Description & Responsibilities

Requirements Analysis & Documentation

  • Analyze and document business requirements from stakeholders.
  • Prepare URS and SRS documents ensuring clarity and completeness.

Test Planning & Execution

  • Design, prepare, and execute test plans and detailed test cases.
  • Prepare defect reports, documenting issues and severity.
  • Ensure product quality through rigorous testing.

Testing Types

  • Functional, regression, and integration testing.
  • Usability and accessibility testing.
  • Security-related testing across web and API applications.

Database Testing & Validation

  • Validate data through SQL/MySQL and MS SQL queries.
  • Work with joins, procedures, triggers, and performance optimization.

Bug & Issue Tracking

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to track and manage bugs using Jira or similar tools.
  • Monitor defect status and support resolution.

API Testing

  • Conduct API testing using Postman and Swagger.

Testing Life Cycle Support & Process Improvement

  • Participate in all phases of STLC and DLC.
  • Contribute to process improvements, compliance standards, and alignment with project objectives.

Important Dates

Event Date / Timeline
Last date for submitting online application 16-02-2026.

How to Apply

  1. Visit the application portal: https://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/
  2. Register with a valid email ID and password.
  3. Fill the online application form with accurate personal details, educational qualifications, professional experience, and PAN Card number.
  4. Upload your latest detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) covering education and professional experience.
  5. Review all details and submit the application on or before 16-02-2026.

Important Application Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted only through the online portal; no manual / paper / email applications will be entertained.
  • PAN Card number is mandatory for identification and must be entered in the form.
  • The email ID entered must remain valid for at least one year and cannot be changed later.
  • Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting of eligible candidates based on the online application and relevance/quality of experience.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by the IMS Team for assessment test and/or interview (likely online depending on number of candidates).
  • Decision of the selection committee is final and binding; meeting minimum qualifications does not guarantee an interview call.

Terms & General Conditions

  • Purely contractual, temporary position with no automatic right to permanency or regularization.
  • Initial tenure of 1 year, renewable annually based on performance and institute requirements.
  • Candidates must be ready to relocate anywhere in India at a location/office decided by IIT Gandhinagar.
  • Candidates employed with Government / PSUs / Autonomous Bodies / Educational Institutions must produce NOC at the time of interview.
  • Any false information can lead to rejection at any stage, including after joining.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to automatic disqualification.
  • IITGN reserves the right to cancel/modify the recruitment process or not select any candidate without assigning reasons.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

 Age Limit and Relaxation

  • Maximum Age limit: 56 Years
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

Upper Age limit will be as specified against each post

Applicants belonging to reserved category (SC/ST/OBC) / physically challenged/Ex-servicemen could be eligible for relaxations according to the ‘Government of India’ norms.

 Government employees on payscale will be eligible for relaxation in age by 5 years including  other  age relaxations as applicable.

 The cut-off date for ascertaining the age and experience will be Last Date of submission of    application.

Candidates seeking age relaxation need to submit a copy of caste certificate when called for document verification.  

 SSLC/SSC/ISC mark sheet/ certificate and any other valid document will be considered as proof of date of birth.

The Economically Weaker Section’s Certificate should be strictly in the format prescribed by DoPT.  The format is available on the website www.persmin.nic.in

The application of the candidates not meeting the prescribed age criteria will be reject/cancelled without any prior intimation.

Candidates belonging to OBC category (Non creamy layer) should produce the certificate issued in prescribed format.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is charged by C-DAC for applying to this advertisement.

Important Dates

  • Notification Release Date: 01-02-2026
  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 01-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 20-02-2026
  • Interview Dates: Will be communicated via email to shortlisted candidates

Selection Process

  • Candidate should meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the advertisement.  
  • The qualification and experience prescribed, are the minimum requirements and possession of the  same does not automatically make the candidates entitled to be called for written test and / or selection processes. 
  • There will be an initial screening based on the academic records and other parameters declared in  the on-line application and only screened-in candidates will be considered for further selection process. 
  • The management reserves the right to increase/alter the minimum eligibility criteria/cut off  limits, in  the event of the number of applicants are more, for any post(s), at its discretion. 
  • Candidates will be selected on the basis of their academic credentials, experience profile, written   test marks (if any), performance in the interview and such other selection processes/parameters, as adopted and deemed fit by management. e. Mere application and fulfilment of the mentioned qualifications etc., does not entitle a candidate  to be called for written/skill test/ interview.
  • C-DAC may restrict the number of candidates to be  called to participate in interview/selection process to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than that of the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. The  candidates should, therefore, furnish all the qualifications and experience possessed in the relevant field, over and above the minimum qualifications prescribed.  
  • The selection process shall be carried out by the respective C-DAC Centre based on its requirements and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further process.
  • All information submitted in the application will be verified with the original documents at the time  of document verification or at any stage of the recruitment process. If any documents/information provided by the candidate is found to be false or incorrect or Non- conformity with the eligibility criteria, then his/her candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at  any stage of the recruitment and selection process without any prior intimation.
  • The candidature is also liable for rejection at any stage if C-DAC comes across any evidence/knowledge that the qualification, experience and any other particulars indicated in the application/other    forms/formats are not recognized/false misleading and/or amounts to suppression of information/particulars which should have been brought to the notice of C-DAC

How to Apply

  • Before filling the online application form, Candidates should read General Terms and Conditions carefully.
  • Candidate should read all the eligibility parameters and ensure that he/she is eligible for the post before starting to apply online.
  • Candidate should have a valid email id and mobile no. which should remain valid & active till the completion of selection process.
  • While applying online Candidates can click on the ‘Apply’ button provided against each position for which he/she wish to apply.
  • The candidate needs to log in with mobile no. and then fill in the OTP received on the said mobile no.
  • On filling the correct OTP, the applicant will be directed to fill in the application form. In case you have filled in an application in our previous advertisement, the applicant will receive a prefilled editable application.
  • Candidates shall check the prefilled application and submit it, after adding additional details by clicking on ‘Submit’ button.
  • Candidates should scan their photograph in .jpg format (not more than 400 KB) and keep it ready before starting to apply online for uploading.
  • Candidate should upload their resume in PDF format (Not more than 500 KB)
  • A unique application number will be generated by the system, please note this application number for future reference and use. Candidates can take a print of the application form and keep it with them for their own records.
  • No hard copy/printed applications should be sent to C-DAC. Incomplete and defectively filled online forms shall be rejected straightway and no subsequent correspondences will be entertained in this regard.
  • Candidates working in Government/PSUs/Govt. Autonomous bodies should also apply online in advance and print of the application form, duly filled and signed should be forwarded through proper channel to HRD Section, C-DAC, Bangalore.
  • Those who are not forwarding their application through proper channel are required to produce 'No objection certificate (NOC)' from their current employer at the time of interview, if called for, failing which they will not be permitted to attend the interview.
  • Any dispute with regard to selection/recruitment process will be subject to Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Bangalore, Karnataka only.

  • (ii) In case of outstation coverage, which are coverages undertaken beyond the geographical limit of the District HQ where the Stringer is empanelled, the Stringer’s fee would be Rs. 1,800 irrespective of the length of the footage or usage of the coverage, inclusive of transportation and delivery charges.

  • Submission of the test coverage assignment on time is essential for being called for the interview.

General Information / Instructions

  • Empanelled Stringers are expected to do news coverages and short features on news, current affairs, sports, business and other subjects. Applicants preferably equipped with four-wheel vehicles, should have qualifications, experience, and expertise in cinematography/videography/ news-gathering / broadcast journalism. Details of other terms and conditions prescribed in Guidelines issued by Directorate General, Doordarshan, New Delhi vide their Memo No. 3/4/2003-P-III dated 02.07.2010 are available in the Annexure to this notification.
  • Stringers should have adequate facilities and equipment to undertake the coverage.
  • The coverages by a stringer should contain all elements of a news story. For each coverage, the stringer should provide raw footage, press material and a script. Stringers should not only cover assigned tasks but also alert the RNU on major news fall/breaking stories/stories of interest in their area. The Panel of Stringers shall be revised every two years.

Stringers will be removed from the panel on all or any of the following grounds:

  1. When the Stringer refuses to cover the assigned coverages on two or more occasions;
  2. If the coverages are poor in content or in technical quality (poor audio quality, noisy video, variation in luminance level, defocused pictures, etc.);
  3. Delay in providing timely coverage;
  4. When the Stringer is suspected of subcontracting the assigned work to others;
  5. If the Stringers are found to be operating a cartel system among themselves;
  6. If the information furnished by the Stringer in the application form for empanelment is found to be incorrect.
  7. Any act on the part of the stringer that creates embarrassment to Prasar Bharati.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Academic Qualifications: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised University or any equivalent qualification recognised as such by the Central Government including Integrated Dual Degree (IDD). Candidates possessing qualifications such as Medical, Engineering, Chartered Accountant, Cost Accountant would also be eligible.
  • Experience: Minimum 2 years' experience as on 31.12.2025 as an officer in any Scheduled Commercial Bank or any Regional Rural Bank as listed in Second Schedule of Reserve Bank of India.
  • Salary Requirement: Candidates having experience in Scheduled Commercial Banks other than Public Sector Banks/Regional Rural Banks shall be drawing minimum annual gross salary of Rs. 9.50 lacs for each year and shall provide documentary evidence for their annual gross salary such as Form-16/Annual Income Statement (AIS)/pay slips for last 24 months or certificate from employer.
  • Local Language: Candidates applying for vacancies of a particular Circle should be proficient (reading, writing and understanding) in any one of the specified opted local language of that Circle.

Selection Process

  • Phase 1 - Online Examination: Online test will consist of Objective Tests for 120 marks and Descriptive Test for 50 marks. The duration of objective test is 2 hours consisting of 4 Sections - English Language (30 marks, 30 minutes), Banking Knowledge (40 marks, 40 minutes), General Awareness/Economy (30 marks, 30 minutes), and Computer Aptitude (20 marks, 20 minutes). The Descriptive Test (30 minutes) will be a Test of English Language (Letter Writing & Essay) for total 50 marks.
  • Phase 2 - Screening: The Screening Committee will examine whether candidates fulfil the required eligibility criteria of experience and match the job profile submitted by candidates with the job profile of Scale-I Generalist Officer of State Bank of India. Candidates numbering up to 3 times (approx.) of the Circle wise and Category wise vacancies will be called for interview from the top of the merit list.
  • Phase 3 - Interview: Interview will consist of 50 marks. Candidates will have to score minimum qualifying marks in interview to be considered for final selection.
  • Phase 4 - Local Language Proficiency Test: Test of knowledge of specified opted local language will be conducted for provisionally selected candidates before joining the Bank. Candidates who produce 10th or 12th standard mark sheet/certificate evidencing having studied the specified opted local language will not be required to undergo the language test.
  • Final Selection: Final merit list is prepared based on normalization of marks scored in Online Test and Interview with 75:25 weightage respectively. Marks secured by candidates in Online Test (out of 170 marks) are converted to out of 75 marks and Interview scores (out of 50 marks) are converted to out of 25 marks.
  • Note: There will be no penalty for wrong answers marked in Objective Tests. Sectional marks will not be maintained for Online Examination.

  • The text for the handwritten declaration is as follows – “I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.”
  • The above-mentioned handwritten declaration has to be in the candidate’s handwriting and in English only. If it is written and uploaded by anybody else or in any other language, the application will be considered as invalid.
  • Keep the necessary details/documents ready to make Online Payment of the requisite application fee/ intimation charges.
  • Have a valid personal email ID and mobile no., which should be kept active till the completion of this Recruitment Process. Bank may send intimation to download call letters for the Examination etc. through the mentioned e-mail ID and / or SMS. In case a candidate does not have a valid personal e-mail ID, he/she should create his/her new e-mail ID and mobile no. before applying on-line and must maintain that email account and mobile number.
  • Candidates to visit Online Application and click on the option "APPLY ONLINE" which will open a new screen.
  • To register, choose the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password. An Email & SMS indicating the Provisional Registration number and Password will also be sent.
  • In case the candidate is unable to complete the application form in one go, he / she can save the data already entered by choosing "SAVE AND NEXT" tab. Prior to submission of the online application, candidates are advised to use the "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to verify the details in the online application form and modify the same if required. Visually Impaired candidates should fill the application form carefully and verify/ get the details verified to ensure that the same are correct prior to final submission.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/ entertained after clicking the COMPLETE REGISTRATION BUTTON.
  • The Name of the candidate or his /her father/ Husband etc. should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the Certificates/ Mark sheets/Identity proof. Any change/alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Validate your details and save your application by clicking the 'Validate your details' and 'Save & Next' button.
  • Candidates can proceed to upload Photo & Signature as per the specifications given in the Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Photograph and Signature detailed under point "C".
  • Candidates can proceed to fill other details of the Application Form.
  • Click on the Preview Tab to preview and verify the entire application form before COMPLETE REGISTRATION.
  • Modify details, if required, and click on 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' ONLY after verifying and ensuring that the photograph, signature uploaded and other details filled by you are correct.
  • Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment.
  • Click on 'Submit' button.
  • The application form is integrated with the payment gateway and the payment process can be completed by following the instructions.
  • The payment can be made by using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/ Mobile Wallets.
  • After submitting your payment information in the online application form, PLEASE WAIT FOR THE INTIMATION FROM THE SERVER. DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH BUTTON IN ORDER TO AVOID DOUBLE CHARGE.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, an e-Receipt will be generated.
  • Non-generation of 'E-Receipt' indicates PAYMENT FAILURE. On failure of payment, Candidates are advised to login again using their Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the process of payment.
  • Candidates are required to take a printout of the e-Receipt and online Application Form containing fee details. Please note that if the same cannot be generated, online transaction may not have been successful.
  • For Credit Card users: All charges are listed in Indian Rupee. If you use a non-Indian credit card, your bank will convert to your local currency based on prevailing exchange rates.
  • To ensure the security of your data, please close the browser window once your transaction is completed.
  • There is facility to print application form containing fee details after payment of fees.
  • While filling in the Online Application Form the candidate will be provided with separate links for uploading Photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
  • Click on the respective link “Upload Photograph / signature / Upload left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant documents”.
  • Browse and select the location where the Scanned Photograph / signature / left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant document’s file has been saved.
  • Select the file by clicking on it
  • Click the ‘Open/Upload’
  • If the file size and format are not as prescribed, an error message will be displayed.
  • Preview of the uploaded image will help to see the quality of the image. In case of unclear / smudged, the same may be re-uploaded to the expected clarity /quality.
